title.en: Volume 277 Biographies 36: Zhang Jian, Yao Tan, Suo Xiang, Song Taichu, Lu Zhihan, Zheng Wenbao, Wang Ziyu, Liu Zong, Bian Gun, Xu Xiang, Pei Zhuang, Niu Mian, Zhang Shi, Luan Chongji, Yuan Fengji, Han Guohua, He Meng, Shen Zhili
title.raw: 卷二百七十七 列傳第三十六 張鑑 姚坦 索湘 宋太初 盧之翰 鄭文寶 王子輿 劉綜 卞袞 許驤 裴莊 牛冕 張適 欒崇吉 袁逢吉 韓國華 何蒙 慎知禮 Volume 277 Biographies 36: Zhang Jian, Yao Tan, Suo Xiang, Song Taichu, Lu Zhihan, Zheng Wenbao, Wang Ziyu, Liu Zong, Bian Gun, Xu Xiang, Pei Zhuang, Niu Mian, Zhang Shi, Luan Chongji, Yuan Fengji, Han Guohua, He Meng, Shen Zhili

sentences.zh: 張鑒，字德明，瀛州團練使藏英之孫。

translations.literal: Zhang Jian, courtesy name Deming, was a grandson of Zang Ying, regimental commander of Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jian, whose courtesy name was Deming, was the grandson of Zang Ying, the regimental commander of Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父裔，以蔭補供奉官。

translations.literal: His father Yi entered service as a palace attendant through yin privilege.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yi received appointment as a palace attendant through hereditary privilege.

sentences.zh: 鑒本將家，幼能嗜學，入衛州霖落山肄業，凡十餘年。

translations.literal: Jian came from a military family yet loved learning from youth; he entered Linluo Mountain in Weizhou to study, for more than ten years in all.
translations.idiomatic: Though from a military family, Jian loved learning from childhood. He went to Linluo Mountain in Weizhou to pursue his studies, spending more than ten years there in all.

sentences.zh: 太平興國三年，擢進士第，釋褐大理評事、監泰州紫墟榷務。

translations.literal: In the third year of Taiping Xingguo he was elevated to jinshi rank; upon leaving office robes he became an assessor of the Court of Judicial Review and superintendent of the Zixu monopoly office in Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Taiping Xingguo era (978), he passed the jinshi examination. Upon entering official service he was appointed assessor of the Court of Judicial Review and superintendent of the Zixu monopoly office in Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 升朝，為太子右讚善大夫、知婺州，就遷著作郎。

translations.literal: Upon entering court attendance he served as Right Supporter-in-Attendance to the Heir Apparent and prefect of Wuzhou, then was transferred in place to Secretary of the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: Once he entered court attendance, he served as Right Supporter-in-Attendance to the Heir Apparent and prefect of Wuzhou, and was then transferred in place to the post of Secretary of the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 還，拜監察御史。

translations.literal: Upon return he was appointed investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: After returning to the capital, he was appointed investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 奉詔決獄江左，頗雪冤滯。

translations.literal: By imperial order he adjudicated cases in the Jiangzuo region, clearing many long-standing injustices.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial order he adjudicated cases in the lower Yangtze region, clearing many long-standing injustices.

sentences.zh: 曆殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: He served successively as palace censor.
translations.idiomatic: He subsequently served as palace censor.

sentences.zh: 會命曹彬等進討幽州，問群臣以方略，鑒上疏極言不可。

translations.literal: When ordered that Cao Bin and others advance to attack Youzhou, the emperor asked the ministers for strategy; Jian memorialized forcefully that it should not be done.
translations.idiomatic: When Cao Bin and others were ordered to advance against Youzhou, the emperor sought strategy from his ministers. Jian submitted a memorial forcefully arguing that the campaign should not be undertaken.

sentences.zh: 論者以鑒燕人，沮議非忠也，太宗置不問。

translations.literal: Critics held that as a man of Yan, Jian's obstruction of the plan was disloyal; Taizong took no notice.
translations.idiomatic: Critics argued that as a native of Yan, Jian's obstruction of the campaign showed disloyalty, but Emperor Taizong paid no heed.

sentences.zh: 與趙延進同掌左藏，延進恃恩逾規，鑒廷奏之。

translations.literal: With Zhao Yanjin he jointly managed the Left Treasury; Yanjin relied on favor to overstep regulations, and Jian impeached him at court.
translations.idiomatic: He and Zhao Yanjin jointly managed the Left Treasury. Yanjin relied on imperial favor to overstep regulations, and Jian impeached him at court.

sentences.zh: 有旨罷延進，以鑒判三司度支憑由催欠司。

translations.literal: By decree Yanjin was dismissed and Jian made administrator of the Three Offices' Department of Revenue Voucher and Debt Collection Office.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial decree Yanjin was dismissed, and Jian was appointed administrator of the Three Offices' Department of Revenue Voucher and Debt Collection Office.

sentences.zh: 時三部各置憑由催欠，鑒請並為一，從之。

translations.literal: At the time each of the three departments had its own voucher and debt collection office; Jian requested they be merged into one, and his request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: At the time each of the three departments maintained its own voucher and debt collection office. Jian requested that they be merged into one office, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 王明、李惟清薦其能，用為江南轉運使。

translations.literal: Wang Ming and Li Weiqing recommended his ability, and he was appointed Jiangnan transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ming and Li Weiqing recommended him for his competence, and he was appointed transport commissioner for Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 本部有大姓為民患者，鑒以名聞。

translations.literal: Within his jurisdiction were powerful clans who harmed the people; Jian reported their names to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Within his jurisdiction were powerful clans who oppressed the people, and Jian reported their names to the throne.

sentences.zh: 太宗盡令部送魁首及妻子赴闕，以三班職名羈縻之，江左震肅。

translations.literal: Taizong ordered them all escorted to the capital, leaders and families alike, and kept them under restraint with third-rank nominal posts; the Jiangzuo region was awed into order.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong ordered the ringleaders and their families all escorted to the capital and kept under restraint with nominal third-rank posts. The lower Yangtze region was awed into good order.

sentences.zh: 又建議割瑞州清江、吉州新淦、袁州新喻三縣置臨江軍，時以為便。

translations.literal: He also proposed carving out Qingjiang of Ruizhou, Xingan of Jizhou, and Xinyu of Yuanzhou to establish Linjiang Prefecture; the plan was considered convenient at the time.
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed carving out Qingjiang County of Ruizhou, Xingan County of Jizhou, and Xinyu County of Yuanzhou to establish Linjiang Prefecture—a measure considered convenient at the time.

sentences.zh: 召還，特被慰獎。

translations.literal: Recalled to court, he received special praise and reward.
translations.idiomatic: When recalled to court, he received special commendation and reward.

sentences.zh: 梓州符昭願驕僭不法，即以鑒代之。

translations.literal: Fu Zhaoyuan of Zizhou was arrogant, presumptuous, and lawless; Jian was sent to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Zhaoyuan of Zizhou was arrogant, presumptuous, and lawless, so Jian was sent to replace him.

sentences.zh: 遷刑部員外郎、判大理寺，遷屯田郎中、判三司都催欠司，改都勾院，擢拜樞密直學士、知通進、銀臺、封駁司，又掌三班。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice minister of justice and administrator of the Court of Judicial Review, then to director of the Directorate of Agriculture and administrator of the Three Offices' General Debt Collection Office; his post was changed to the General Audit Bureau; he was promoted to academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and put in charge of the Memorial Clearance, Silver Pavilion, and Seal and Rebuttal offices, and also managed the Third Rank Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice minister of justice and administrator of the Court of Judicial Review, then to director of the Directorate of Agriculture and administrator of the Three Offices' General Debt Collection Office. His post was changed to the General Audit Bureau. He was then elevated to academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and put in charge of the Memorial Clearance, Silver Pavilion, and Seal and Rebuttal offices, and also managed the Third Rank Bureau.

sentences.zh: 上言供奉官以下不考校殿最，恐無沮勸，即詔鑒兼磨勘職。

translations.literal: He reported that palace attendants and those below were not evaluated for merit ranking, fearing there would be no restraint or encouragement; the emperor immediately ordered Jian to also hold evaluation duties.
translations.idiomatic: He pointed out that palace attendants and officials below that rank were not subject to merit evaluations, which would provide neither restraint nor incentive. The emperor immediately ordered Jian to also assume evaluation duties.

sentences.zh: 改三司為左右計，分天下為十道，鑒奏其非便。

translations.literal: The Three Offices were changed to Left and Right accounting divisions and the empire divided into ten circuits; Jian memorialized that this was inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: When the Three Offices were reorganized into Left and Right accounting divisions and the empire was divided into ten circuits, Jian memorialized that the change was impractical.

sentences.zh: 未幾，果復舊。

translations.literal: Before long, the old system was indeed restored.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, the old system was indeed restored.

sentences.zh: 淳化中，盜起西蜀，王繼恩討平之，而御軍無政，其下恃功暴橫。

translations.literal: During the Chunhua era, rebels rose in western Shu; Wang Jien suppressed them, but he governed his troops poorly and his subordinates relied on their merit to act with violence and arrogance.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chunhua era, rebels rose in western Shu. Wang Jien suppressed them, but he governed his troops poorly, and his subordinates relied on their military merit to act with violence and arrogance.

sentences.zh: 益州張詠密奏，請命近臣分屯師旅，即遣鑒與西京作坊使馮守規偕往。

translations.literal: Zhang Yong of Yizhou secretly memorialized, requesting that close ministers be sent to station troops in separate camps; Jian was immediately dispatched together with Feng Shougui, commissioner of the Western Capital Workshop Office.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yong of Yizhou secretly memorialized, requesting that close ministers be sent to station troops in separate camps. Jian was immediately dispatched together with Feng Shougui, commissioner of the Western Capital Workshop Office.

sentences.zh: 召對後苑門，面授方略。

translations.literal: He was summoned for audience at the Rear Garden Gate and personally instructed in strategy.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned for audience at the Rear Garden Gate and personally instructed in strategy.

sentences.zh: 鑒曰：“益部新復，軍旅不和，若聞使命驟至，易其戎伍，慮或猜懼，變生不測。

translations.literal: Jian said: "The Yi region has only recently been recovered and the army is ill at ease. If they hear that envoys have suddenly arrived to change their military units, they may grow suspicious and fearful, and unforeseen trouble may arise.
translations.idiomatic: Jian said, "The Yi region has only recently been recovered, and the army is ill at ease. If the troops hear that envoys have suddenly arrived to reorganize their units, they may grow suspicious and fearful, and unforeseen trouble may arise.

sentences.zh: 請假臣安撫之名。

translations.literal: I ask that I be granted the title of pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that I be granted the title of pacification commissioner."

sentences.zh: ”太宗稱善。

translations.literal: " Taizong praised the proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong praised the proposal.

sentences.zh: 鑒至蜀，繼恩猶偃蹇，不意朝廷聞其縱肆。

translations.literal: When Jian reached Shu, Jien was still insolent and did not expect the court to have heard of his excesses.
translations.idiomatic: When Jian reached Shu, Wang Jien remained insolent and did not expect the court to have heard of his excesses.

sentences.zh: 鑒之行，付以空名宣頭及廷臣數人，鑒與詠即遣部戍卒出境，繼恩麾下使臣亦多遣東還，督繼恩輩分路討捕殘寇，而鑒等招輯反側。

translations.literal: Before Jian's departure he was given blank commission documents and several court officials; Jian and Yong immediately sent garrison troops out of the province, also sent many of Jien's staff envoys back east, supervised Jien and his men in pursuing remnant bandits by separate routes, and Jian and the others won over the wavering.
translations.idiomatic: Before Jian's departure he was given blank commission documents and several court officials. Jian and Yong immediately sent garrison troops out of the province, sent many of Wang Jien's staff envoys back east, and supervised Jien and his men in pursuing remnant bandits by separate routes, while Jian and the others won over those who were wavering.

sentences.zh: 事平歸朝，未至，拜左諫議大夫、戶部使。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled and he returned to court, before he arrived he was appointed Left Remonstrance Councillor and commissioner of the Household Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled and he was returning to court, he was appointed Left Remonstrance Councillor and commissioner of the Household Bureau before he even arrived.

sentences.zh: 會五路進兵討西夏，令鑒乘傳往環州，與李繼隆議護送芻糧入靈州。

translations.literal: When the five routes advanced troops to attack Western Xia, Jian was ordered to travel by post horse to Huanzhou to discuss with Li Jilong the escort of fodder and grain into Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When troops from five routes advanced against Western Xia, Jian was ordered to travel by post horse to Huanzhou to consult with Li Jilong on escorting fodder and grain into Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 及還，上疏曰：

translations.literal: Upon his return he memorialized, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Upon his return he submitted a memorial, saying:

sentences.zh: “關輔之民，數年以來，並有科役，畜產蕩盡，室廬頓空。

translations.literal: "The people of the Guanfu region have for several years all borne corvée and tax levies; livestock and goods have been exhausted and dwellings left empty.
translations.idiomatic: "The people of the Guanfu region have for several years all borne corvée and tax levies; livestock and goods have been exhausted and dwellings left empty.

sentences.zh: 加以浦洛之行，曾經剽劫。

translations.literal: Added to this, the expedition to Puluo was once ravaged by plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Added to this, the expedition to Puluo was once ravaged by plunder.

sentences.zh: 原州之役，又致遷延。

translations.literal: The campaign at Yuanzhou also caused delays.
translations.idiomatic: The campaign at Yuanzhou also caused delays.

sentences.zh: 非獨令之弗從，實緣力所不逮。

translations.literal: It is not merely that orders were disobeyed; in truth their strength could not reach so far.
translations.idiomatic: It is not merely that orders were disobeyed; in truth their strength could not reach so far.

sentences.zh: 況復先棄糧草，見今逐處追科，本戶稅租，互遣他州送納，往返千里，費耗十倍，愁苦怨歎，充塞路岐，自春徂冬，曾無暫息，餱糧乏絕，力用殫窮。

translations.literal: Moreover, grain and fodder were abandoned beforehand, and now levies are being pursued everywhere; households' tax rents are being sent for payment to other prefectures, traveling back and forth a thousand li, with costs tenfold greater; grief, bitterness, resentment, and sighs fill the roads; from spring to winter there has been no respite; provisions are exhausted and strength utterly spent.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, grain and fodder were abandoned beforehand, and now levies are being pursued everywhere. Households' tax rents are being sent for payment to other prefectures, traveling back and forth a thousand li at ten times the cost. Grief, bitterness, resentment, and sighs fill the roads. From spring to winter there has been no respite; provisions are exhausted and strength utterly spent.

sentences.zh: 顧此疲羸，尤堪軫恤。

translations.literal: Considering these exhausted and enfeebled people, they are especially worthy of compassion.
translations.idiomatic: Considering these exhausted and enfeebled people, they are especially worthy of compassion.

sentences.zh: 今若復有差率，益致流亡，縱令驅迫，必恐撓潰。

translations.literal: If there are further requisitions now, flight will only increase; even if they are driven and compelled, collapse and rout will surely be feared.
translations.idiomatic: If there are further requisitions now, flight will only increase. Even if the people are driven and compelled, collapse and rout will surely follow.

sentences.zh: 願陛下特垂詔旨，無使重勞，因茲首春，俾務東作。

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will specially issue an edict that they not be burdened again, and with this first spring let them devote themselves to spring planting.
translations.idiomatic: I hope Your Majesty will specially issue an edict that they not be burdened again, and with this first spring let them devote themselves to spring planting.

sentences.zh: 況靈州一方，僻居絕塞，雖西陲之舊地，實中夏之蠹區。

translations.literal: Moreover, Lingzhou lies in a remote corner beyond the frontier passes; though an old land of the western border, it is in truth a drain on the Central Plains.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Lingzhou lies in a remote corner beyond the frontier passes. Though an old land of the western border, it is in truth a drain on the Central Plains.

sentences.zh: 竭物力以供須，困甲兵而援送，蕭然空壘，隻益外虞。

translations.literal: Material resources are exhausted to supply its needs, and soldiers are worn out escorting provisions; the fortresses stand empty, only increasing external alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Material resources are exhausted to supply its needs, and soldiers are worn out escorting provisions. The fortresses stand empty, only increasing external alarm.

sentences.zh: 不若以賜繼遷，使懷恩奉籍，稍息飛免之役。

translations.literal: Would it not be better to grant it to Li Jiqian, so that he cherishes grace and submits to the registers, and the corvée of rapid transport is somewhat eased?
translations.idiomatic: Would it not be better to grant it to Li Jiqian, so that he cherishes imperial grace and submits to the registers, and the corvée of rapid transport is somewhat eased?

sentences.zh: 事當深慮，理要預防。

translations.literal: Affairs should be deeply considered and principles guarded against in advance.
translations.idiomatic: Affairs should be deeply considered and guarded against in advance.

sentences.zh: 若待川決而後防，火熾而方戢，則焚溺之患深矣，雖欲拯救，其可得乎？”

translations.literal: If one waits until the river breaks its banks before guarding against flood, or until the fire blazes before putting it out, then the harm of burning and drowning will be deep indeed; even if one wishes to save the situation, how can it be done?
translations.idiomatic: If one waits until the river breaks its banks before guarding against flood, or until the fire blazes before putting it out, then the harm of burning and drowning will be deep indeed. Even if one wishes to save the situation, how can it be done?

sentences.zh: 尋詔鑒專督軍糧，以軍興法從事，饋運頗集。

translations.literal: Soon Jian was ordered to supervise military grain exclusively; proceeding under wartime law, supplies were largely gathered.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Jian was ordered to supervise military grain exclusively. Proceeding under wartime law, supplies were largely gathered.

sentences.zh: 真宗即位，遷給事中，使如故。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong acceded, he was transferred to supervising censor and his commission remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhenzong acceded, Jian was transferred to supervising censor, and his commission remained as before.

sentences.zh: 咸平初，改工部侍郎，出知廣州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Xianping era he was changed to vice minister of works and sent out as prefect of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Xianping era he was promoted to vice minister of works and appointed prefect of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 居二年，民條其政績上請刻石。

translations.literal: After two years the people listed his achievements and petitioned that they be carved in stone.
translations.idiomatic: After two years the people listed his achievements and petitioned that they be carved in stone.

sentences.zh: 三年，移知朗州。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to Langzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was transferred to serve as prefect of Langzhou.

sentences.zh: 溪洞群蠻數寇擾，鑒召酋豪，諭以威信，皆俯伏聽命。

translations.literal: The tribal chieftains of the stream grottoes repeatedly raided and harassed; Jian summoned the tribal leaders, instructed them in authority and trust, and all bowed in submission and obeyed.
translations.idiomatic: The tribal chieftains of the stream grottoes repeatedly raided and harassed. Jian summoned the tribal leaders, instructed them in authority and trust, and all bowed in submission and obeyed.

sentences.zh: 初，鑒在南海，李夷庚為通判，謝德權為巡檢，皆與之不協。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Jian was in the South Sea region, Li Yigeng served as vice prefect and Xie Dequan as inspector; both were at odds with him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Jian was in the South Sea region, Li Yigeng served as vice prefect and Xie Dequan as inspector; both were at odds with him.

sentences.zh: 二人密言鑒以貲付海賈，往來貿市，故徙小郡。

translations.literal: The two secretly reported that Jian had entrusted capital to maritime traders for commerce back and forth, and for this reason was transferred to a smaller prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The two secretly reported that Jian had entrusted capital to maritime traders for commerce back and forth, and for this reason was transferred to a smaller prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至是，鑒自陳有親故謫瓊州，每以奉米附商舶寄贍之，又言夷庚、德權憸人貪凶之狀，上意稍釋。

translations.literal: At this time Jian explained himself, saying he had relatives and friends exiled to Qiongzhou whom he regularly supplied with stipend grain sent by merchant ships; he also reported the treacherous and greedy conduct of Yigeng and Dequan, and the emperor's mind was somewhat eased.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Jian explained himself, saying he had relatives and friends exiled to Qiongzhou whom he regularly supplied with stipend grain sent by merchant ships. He also reported the treacherous and greedy conduct of Yigeng and Dequan, and the emperor's suspicions were somewhat eased.

sentences.zh: 召還，以疾徙知相州。

translations.literal: Recalled to court, he was transferred to Xiangzhou on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to court, he was transferred to Xiangzhou on account of illness.

sentences.zh: 有芝草生於監牧之室，鑒表其祥異，以為河朔弭兵款附之兆。

translations.literal: An auspicious fungus grew in the room of the pasture office; Jian memorialized the marvel, taking it as a sign that the north would lay down arms and submit.
translations.idiomatic: An auspicious fungus grew in the room of the pasture office. Jian memorialized the marvel, taking it as a sign that the north would lay down arms and submit.

sentences.zh: 優詔答之。

translations.literal: A gracious edict replied to him.
translations.idiomatic: A gracious edict replied to him.

sentences.zh: 景德初，卒，年五十八。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jingde era he died, aged fifty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jingde era he died, aged fifty-eight.

sentences.zh: 子：士廉為殿中丞，士宗太子洗馬，士程屯田員外郎。

translations.literal: His sons: Shilian served as palace secretary; Shizong as groom of the Heir Apparent; Shicheng as vice director of the Directorate of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: His sons: Shilian served as palace secretary; Shizong as groom of the Heir Apparent; and Shicheng as vice director of the Directorate of Agriculture.

sentences.zh: 姚坦，字明白，曹州濟陰人。

translations.literal: Yao Tan, courtesy name Mingbai, was a man of Jiyin in Caozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Tan, whose courtesy name was Mingbai, was a native of Jiyin in Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 開寶中，以《尚書》擢第，調補將陵尉。

translations.literal: During the Kaibao era he passed the examination on the Book of Documents and was appointed assistant magistrate of Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaibao era he passed the examination on the Book of Documents and was appointed assistant magistrate of Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 歷隰州推官、將作監丞、知潯州。

translations.literal: He served successively as judicial officer of Xizhou, director of the Directorate of Works, and prefect of Xunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as judicial officer of Xizhou, director of the Directorate of Works, and prefect of Xunzhou.

sentences.zh: 太平興國三年召還，為著作佐郎、通判唐州。

translations.literal: In the third year of Taiping Xingguo he was recalled and made assistant secretary of the Palace Library and vice prefect of Tangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Taiping Xingguo he was recalled and appointed assistant secretary of the Palace Library and vice prefect of Tangzhou.

sentences.zh: 八年，諸王出閣，詔給、諫以上，於朝班中舉年五十以上、通經有文行者，以備宮僚，乃以戶部員外郎王適、監察御史趙齊為衛王府諮議，左讚善大夫戴玄為本府翊善。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, when the princes left the palace, an edict ordered officials of remonstrance rank and above to select from the court ranks men over fifty who were versed in the classics and possessed literary accomplishment to serve as palace staff; thus Wang Shi, vice minister of revenue, and Zhao Qi, investigating censor, were made advisers to the Prince of Wei's household, and Dai Xuan, Right Supporter-in-Attendance, was made tutor of that household.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, when the princes left the palace, an edict ordered officials of remonstrance rank and above to select from the court ranks men over fifty who were versed in the classics and possessed literary accomplishment to serve as palace staff. Wang Shi, vice minister of revenue, and Zhao Qi, investigating censor, were made advisers to the Prince of Wei's household, and Dai Xuan, Right Supporter-in-Attendance, was made tutor of that household.

sentences.zh: 水部員外郎趙令圖為廣平郡王府諮議，國子博士閻象為本府翊善。

translations.literal: Zhao Lingtu, vice minister of waterways, was made adviser to the Prince of Guangping's household, and Yan Xiang, doctor of the Imperial Academy, tutor of that household.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Lingtu, vice minister of waterways, was made adviser to the Prince of Guangping's household, and Yan Xiang, doctor of the Imperial Academy, tutor of that household.

sentences.zh: 又以起居舍人楊可法、國子博士楊幼英、左讚善大夫杜新及坦並為皇子翊善，國子博士邢昺為諸王府侍講，坦仍賜緋魚。

translations.literal: Yang Kefa, attendant of the palace secretariat, Yang Youying, doctor of the Imperial Academy, Du Xin, Left Supporter-in-Attendance, and Tan were also made tutors to the princes; Xing Bing, doctor of the Imperial Academy, was made lecturer to the princes' households; Tan was also granted the red fish badge.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Kefa, attendant of the palace secretariat, Yang Youying, doctor of the Imperial Academy, Du Xin, Left Supporter-in-Attendance, and Tan were also made tutors to the princes. Xing Bing, doctor of the Imperial Academy, was made lecturer to the princes' households. Tan was also granted the red fish badge.

sentences.zh: 太宗召適等謂曰：“諸子生長深宮，未知世務，必資良士讚導，使日聞忠孝之道。

translations.literal: Taizong summoned Shi and the others and said: "The princes grew up deep within the palace and do not know the affairs of the world; they must rely on good men to guide and instruct them, so that day by day they hear the way of loyalty and filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong summoned Shi and the others and said, "The princes grew up deep within the palace and do not know the affairs of the world. They must rely on good men to guide and instruct them, so that day by day they hear the way of loyalty and filial piety.

sentences.zh: 汝等皆朕所慎簡，各宜勉之。

translations.literal: You are all men I have carefully chosen; each of you should exert yourselves.
translations.idiomatic: You are all men I have carefully chosen. Each of you should exert yourselves."

sentences.zh: ”坦歷殿中丞、倉部員外郎，賜金紫。

translations.literal: " Tan served successively as palace secretary and vice minister of the granaries, and was granted the gold and purple insignia.
translations.idiomatic: Tan served successively as palace secretary and vice minister of the granaries, and was granted the gold and purple insignia.

sentences.zh: 遷本曹郎中，轉考功，仍為益王府翊善。

translations.literal: He was transferred to director of his former bureau, then to the Directorate of Merit, and still served as tutor to the Prince of Yi's household.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to director of his former bureau, then to the Directorate of Merit, and still served as tutor to the Prince of Yi's household.

sentences.zh: 坦性木強固滯。

translations.literal: Tan was by nature stubborn and inflexible.
translations.idiomatic: Tan was by nature stubborn and inflexible.

sentences.zh: 王嘗於邸中為假山，費數百萬，既成，召賓僚樂飲，置酒共觀之。

translations.literal: The prince once built an artificial mountain in his residence at a cost of several million; when it was finished he summoned guests and officials to feast and drink, set out wine, and viewed it together.
translations.idiomatic: The prince once built an artificial mountain in his residence at a cost of several million cash. When it was finished he summoned guests and officials to feast and drink, set out wine, and viewed it together.

sentences.zh: 坦獨俯首，王強使視之，曰：“但見血山耳，安得假山！

translations.literal: Tan alone bowed his head; the prince forced him to look and he said: "I see only a mountain of blood—how can it be called an artificial mountain!
translations.idiomatic: Tan alone bowed his head. The prince forced him to look, and he said, "I see only a mountain of blood—how can this be called an artificial mountain!

sentences.zh: ”王驚問故，坦曰：“在田舍時，見州縣催科，捕人父子兄弟，送縣鞭笞，流血被體。

translations.literal: " The prince asked in alarm for the reason; Tan said: "When I was in the countryside I saw prefectures and counties collecting taxes, seizing fathers, sons, and brothers, sending them to the county for whipping until blood flowed over their bodies.
translations.idiomatic: " The prince asked in alarm for the reason. Tan said, "When I was in the countryside I saw prefectures and counties collecting taxes, seizing fathers, sons, and brothers, sending them to the county for whipping until blood flowed over their bodies.

sentences.zh: 此假山皆民租稅所為，非血山而何？

translations.literal: This artificial mountain is all built from the people's tax rents—if not a mountain of blood, then what?
translations.idiomatic: This artificial mountain is all built from the people's tax rents. If it is not a mountain of blood, then what is it?

sentences.zh: ”是時，太宗亦為假山，聞而毀之。

translations.literal: " At that time Taizong also had an artificial mountain built; on hearing this he had it destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time Emperor Taizong also had an artificial mountain built. On hearing this he had it destroyed.

sentences.zh: 王少佚豫，坦即醜詆，王頗鄙其為人。

translations.literal: When the prince was young and indulged in pleasure, Tan would at once revile him, and the prince came to despise his character.
translations.idiomatic: When the prince was young and indulged in pleasure, Tan would at once revile him, and the prince came to despise his character.

sentences.zh: 自是坦每暴揚其事，上嘗誡之曰：“元傑知書好學，亦足為賢王矣。

translations.literal: From then on Tan would publicly expose the prince's conduct; the emperor once admonished him, saying: "Yuanjie is learned and loves study; he is quite sufficient to be a worthy prince.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Tan would publicly expose the prince's conduct. The emperor once admonished him, saying, "Yuanjie is learned and loves study; he is quite sufficient to be a worthy prince.

sentences.zh: 少不中節，亦須婉辭規諷，況無大故而詆訐之，豈裨讚之道邪？

translations.literal: When he is slightly improper, you must still use tactful words to admonish him. How much less when there is no great cause should you slander and denounce him—how does that aid the way of guidance?
translations.idiomatic: When he is slightly improper, you must still use tactful words to admonish him. When there is no great cause, how can you slander and denounce him? How does that aid the way of guidance?"

sentences.zh: ”頃之，左右乃教王詐稱疾不朝。

translations.literal: " Before long, those around the prince taught him to feign illness and absent himself from court.
translations.idiomatic: " Before long, those around the prince taught him to feign illness and absent himself from court.

sentences.zh: 太宗日使視疾，逾月不瘳，甚憂之，召王乳母問狀，乳母曰：“王本無疾，徒以姚坦檢束，居常不得自便，王不樂，故成疾。

translations.literal: Taizong daily sent men to inquire after his illness; after more than a month he did not recover, and the emperor was greatly worried. He summoned the prince's wet nurse and asked the situation; the wet nurse said: "The prince is not really ill; it is only because Yao Tan restrains him so that in daily life he cannot have his way. The prince is unhappy, and so has fallen ill.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong daily sent men to inquire after his illness. After more than a month he did not recover, and the emperor was greatly worried. He summoned the prince's wet nurse and asked the situation. The wet nurse said, "The prince is not really ill. It is only because Yao Tan restrains him so that in daily life he cannot have his way. The prince is unhappy, and so has fallen ill.

sentences.zh: ”上怒曰：“吾選端士，輔王為善。

translations.literal: " The emperor said angrily: "I chose upright men to assist the prince in doing good.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said angrily, "I chose upright men to assist the prince in doing good.

sentences.zh: 王不能用其諫，而又詐疾，欲使朕去正人以自便，何可得也。

translations.literal: The prince would not heed their remonstrance and moreover feigned illness, wishing to make me remove upright men so he could have his way—how can that be allowed?
translations.idiomatic: The prince would not heed their remonstrance and moreover feigned illness, wishing to make me remove upright men so he could have his way. How can that be allowed?

sentences.zh: 且王年少，必爾輩為之謀耳。

translations.literal: Moreover the prince is young; surely it is you people who plotted this.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the prince is young. Surely it is you people who plotted this."

sentences.zh: ”因命捽至後苑，杖之數十。

translations.literal: He then ordered them dragged to the rear garden and beaten several dozen times.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered them dragged to the rear garden and beaten several dozen times.

sentences.zh: 召坦慰諭曰：“卿居王宮，能以正為群小所疾，大為不易。

translations.literal: He summoned Tan and comforted him, saying: "You dwell in the prince's palace and can uphold rectitude though hated by petty men—this is very difficult.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned Tan and comforted him, saying, "You dwell in the prince's palace and can uphold rectitude though hated by petty men—this is very difficult.

sentences.zh: 卿但如是，勿慮讒間，朕必不聽。

translations.literal: Continue as you have; do not worry about slander. I will surely not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Continue as you have. Do not worry about slander. I will surely not listen."

sentences.zh: ”王薨，改衛尉少卿，判吏部南曹。

translations.literal: When the prince died, Tan was changed to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and administrator of the Southern Bureau of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When the prince died, Tan was changed to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and administrator of the Southern Bureau of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 他日因事得對，上以其舊人，召升殿與語。

translations.literal: Another day, having occasion to answer at audience, the emperor, taking him for an old associate, summoned him to ascend the hall and converse.
translations.idiomatic: Another day, having occasion to answer at audience, the emperor, taking him for an old associate, summoned him to ascend the hall and converse.

sentences.zh: 坦言及故府，意短諸王而稱己之敢言。

translations.literal: Tan spoke frankly of his former household, belittling the princes and praising his own outspokenness.
translations.idiomatic: Tan spoke frankly of his former household, belittling the princes and praising his own outspokenness.

sentences.zh: 坦退，上謂侍臣曰：“坦在宮邸，不能以正理誨諭，事有微失，即從而揚之，此賣直取名耳。”

translations.literal: When Tan withdrew, the emperor said to his attendants: "Tan in the prince's residence could not instruct and admonish with correct principle; when there was the slightest fault he would at once expose it—this is selling integrity to win a name.
translations.idiomatic: When Tan withdrew, the emperor said to his attendants, "Tan in the prince's residence could not instruct and admonish with correct principle. When there was the slightest fault he would at once expose it. This is selling integrity to win a name."

sentences.zh: 景德初，求補郡，俾知鄧州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jingde era he requested appointment to a prefecture and was made prefect of Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jingde era he requested appointment to a prefecture and was made prefect of Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 轉運使表其治狀，詔嘉獎之。

translations.literal: The transport commissioner memorialized his record of governance, and an edict commended him.
translations.idiomatic: The transport commissioner memorialized his record of governance, and an edict commended him.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符初，復知光州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Dazhong Xiangfu era he again served as prefect of Guang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Dazhong Xiangfu era he again served as prefect of Guang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二年，卒，年七十五。

translations.literal: In the second year he died, aged seventy-five.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he died, aged seventy-five.

sentences.zh: 索湘，字巨川，滄州鹽山人。

translations.literal: Suo Xiang, courtesy name Juchuan, was a man of Yanshan in Cangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Suo Xiang, whose courtesy name was Juchuan, was a native of Yanshan in Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 開寶六年進士，釋褐鄆州司理參軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Kaibao he passed the jinshi examination; upon leaving office robes he became judicial administrator of Yunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Kaibao he passed the jinshi examination. Upon entering official service he became judicial administrator of Yunzhou.

sentences.zh: 齊州有大獄，連逮者千五百人，有司不能決。

translations.literal: In Qizhou there was a major case involving more than fifteen hundred persons implicated together, and the authorities could not decide it.
translations.idiomatic: In Qizhou there was a major case involving more than fifteen hundred persons implicated together, and the authorities could not decide it.

sentences.zh: 湘受詔推鞫，事隨以白。

translations.literal: Xiang received an order to investigate and try the case, and the matter was promptly clarified.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang received an order to investigate and try the case, and the matter was promptly clarified.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年，轉運使和峴薦其能，遷太僕寺丞，充度支巡官。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo the transport commissioner He Yan recommended his ability, and he was transferred to director of the Court of the Imperial Stud and appointed revenue inspection officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo the transport commissioner He Yan recommended his ability, and he was transferred to director of the Court of the Imperial Stud and appointed revenue inspection officer.

sentences.zh: 改太子右讚善大夫，轉殿中丞，充推官，拜監察御史。

translations.literal: He was changed to Right Supporter-in-Attendance to the Heir Apparent, then palace secretary, appointed judicial officer, and appointed investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed to Right Supporter-in-Attendance to the Heir Apparent, then palace secretary, appointed judicial officer, and appointed investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 九年，河決，壞民田，命與戶部推官元玘同按行。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Yellow River burst its banks and ruined the people's fields; he was ordered to inspect the damage together with Yuan Qi, judicial officer of the Household Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the Yellow River burst its banks and ruined the people's fields. He was ordered to inspect the damage together with Yuan Qi, judicial officer of the Household Bureau.

sentences.zh: 會詔下東封，與劉蟠同知泰山路轉運事，又為河北轉運副使。

translations.literal: When an edict was issued for the eastern Feng sacrifice, he served with Liu Pan as manager of Taishan route transport affairs, and also as vice transport commissioner of Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: When an edict was issued for the eastern Feng sacrifice, he served with Liu Pan as manager of Taishan route transport affairs, and also as vice transport commissioner of Hebei.

sentences.zh: 湘經度供饋，以能幹聞。

translations.literal: Xiang managed supplies and was known for competence.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang managed supplies and was known for his competence.

sentences.zh: 事集，加屯田員外郎。

translations.literal: When the affair was concluded he was promoted to vice director of the Directorate of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was concluded he was promoted to vice director of the Directorate of Agriculture.

sentences.zh: 明年，契丹入寇，王師衄於君子館，敵兵乘勝據中渡橋，塞土門，將趨鎮州。

translations.literal: The next year the Khitans invaded; the imperial army was repulsed at Junzi Pavilion, and the enemy troops seized the victory, occupied the Zhongdu Bridge, blocked Tumen, and were about to advance on Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the Khitans invaded. The imperial army was repulsed at Junzi Pavilion, and the enemy troops seized the victory, occupied the Zhongdu Bridge, blocked Tumen, and were about to advance on Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 諸將計議未定，湘為田重進畫謀，結大陣東行，聲言會高陽關兵，敵以為然，即擁眾邀我於平虜城。

translations.literal: The generals' plans were undecided; Xiang devised a strategy for Tian Chongjin: form a great battle line and march east, proclaiming that they would join forces with the troops at Gaoyang Pass; the enemy believed it and massed to intercept them at Pinglu Fort.
translations.idiomatic: The generals' plans were undecided. Xiang devised a strategy for Tian Chongjin: form a great battle line and march east, proclaiming that they would join forces with the troops at Gaoyang Pass. The enemy believed it and massed to intercept them at Pinglu Fort.

sentences.zh: 夜二鼓，率兵而南，徑入鎮陽，據唐河，乘其無備破砦柵。

translations.literal: At the second watch of the night he led the army south, entered Zhenyang directly, held the Tang River, and took advantage of the enemy's unpreparedness to break their stockades.
translations.idiomatic: At the second watch of the night he led the army south, entered Zhenyang directly, held the Tang River, and took advantage of the enemy's unpreparedness to break their stockades.

sentences.zh: 及敵兵覺，悉遁走。

translations.literal: When the enemy troops realized what had happened, they all fled.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy troops realized what had happened, they all fled.

sentences.zh: 雍熙中，召為鹽鐵判官，改駕部員外郎。

translations.literal: During the Yongxi era he was summoned as salt and iron administrator and changed to vice minister of the Transport Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongxi era he was summoned as salt and iron administrator and changed to vice minister of the Transport Bureau.

sentences.zh: 端拱二年，河北治方田，命副樊知古為招置營田使。

translations.literal: In the second year of the Duangong era, when Hebei was developing the equal-field system, he was ordered to serve as vice commissioner for establishing military colonies together with Fan Zhigu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Duangong era, when Hebei was developing the equal-field system, he was ordered to serve as vice commissioner for establishing military colonies together with Fan Zhigu.

sentences.zh: 會議罷，復為河北轉運使。

translations.literal: When the project was discontinued he again became transport commissioner of Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: When the project was discontinued he again became transport commissioner of Hebei.

sentences.zh: 轉虞部郎中，選為將作少監。

translations.literal: He was transferred to director of the Ministry of Works and selected as vice director of the Directorate of Imperial Manufactories.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to director of the Ministry of Works and selected as vice director of the Directorate of Imperial Manufactories.

sentences.zh: 居無何，有訟其擅易庫縑以自用者，坐授膳部員外郎、知相州。

translations.literal: Before long someone sued him for privately exchanging treasury silk for his own use; he was punished by appointment as vice minister of provisions and prefect of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long someone sued him for privately exchanging treasury silk for his own use. He was punished by appointment as vice minister of provisions and prefect of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 時有群盜聚西山下，謀斷澶州河橋，入攻磁、相州，援旗伐鼓，白晝抄劫。

translations.literal: At the time bandits gathered west of the mountain, plotting to cut the bridge over the Cizhou River and enter to attack Ci and Xiang prefectures; they raised banners, beat drums, and plundered in broad daylight.
translations.idiomatic: At the time bandits gathered west of the mountain, plotting to cut the bridge over the Cizhou River and enter to attack Ci and Xiang prefectures. They raised banners, beat drums, and plundered in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 鄰郡發兵千人捕逐，無敢近。

translations.literal: Neighboring prefectures sent a thousand troops to pursue and capture them, but none dared approach.
translations.idiomatic: Neighboring prefectures sent a thousand troops to pursue and capture them, but none dared approach.

sentences.zh: 湘擇州軍得精銳三百人，偵其入境，即掩擊而盡擒之。

translations.literal: Xiang selected three hundred elite troops from the prefectural army, detected them as they entered the border, and struck suddenly, capturing them all.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang selected three hundred elite troops from the prefectural army, detected them as they entered the border, and struck suddenly, capturing them all.

sentences.zh: 轉運使王嗣宗以狀聞，詔復舊官，命為河東轉運使。

translations.literal: Transport commissioner Wang Sizong reported the facts; an edict restored his former rank and appointed him transport commissioner of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissioner Wang Sizong reported the facts. An edict restored his former rank and appointed him transport commissioner of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 湘以忻州推官石宗道、憲州錄事胡則為幹職，命以自隨，所至州郡，勾檢其簿領焉。

translations.literal: Xiang took Xinzhou judicial officer Shi Zongdao and Xianzhou registrar Hu Ze as staff officers and ordered them to accompany him; wherever he reached a prefecture or commandery he audited the account books.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang took Xinzhou judicial officer Shi Zongdao and Xianzhou registrar Hu Ze as staff officers and ordered them to accompany him. Wherever he reached a prefecture or commandery he audited the account books.

sentences.zh: 二人後皆歷清要。

translations.literal: Both men later rose to important posts.
translations.idiomatic: Both men later rose to important posts.

sentences.zh: 明年，王超等率師趨烏白池，抵無定河。

translations.literal: The next year Wang Chao and others led troops toward Wubai Pond and reached the Wuding River.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Wang Chao and others led troops toward Wubai Pond and reached the Wuding River.

sentences.zh: 水源涸絕，軍士渴乏。

translations.literal: The water source dried up and the soldiers suffered thirst.
translations.idiomatic: The water source dried up and the soldiers suffered thirst.

sentences.zh: 時湘已輦大鍬千枚至，令鑿井，眾賴以濟。

translations.literal: At that time Xiang had already transported a thousand large spades there; he ordered wells dug and the troops were saved by this.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Xiang had already transported a thousand large spades there. He ordered wells dug, and the troops were saved by this.

sentences.zh: 真宗即位，入為右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong acceded he entered service as Right Remonstrance Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhenzong acceded he entered service as Right Remonstrance Councillor.

sentences.zh: 復充河北轉運使，屬郡民有斡釀，歲輸課甚微，而不逞輩因之為奸盜，湘奏廢之。

translations.literal: He again served as transport commissioner of Hebei; in his jurisdiction the people brewed spirits, paying very little in tax, and unruly men used this as a cover for theft; Xiang memorialized to abolish it.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as transport commissioner of Hebei. In his jurisdiction the people brewed spirits, paying very little in tax, and unruly men used this as a cover for theft. Xiang memorialized to abolish the practice.

sentences.zh: 德州舊賦民馬以給驛，又役民為步遞，湘代以官馬兵卒，人皆便之。

translations.literal: Dezhou formerly assessed the people for horses to supply the post stations and also conscripted them for foot courier service; Xiang replaced these with official horses and soldier couriers, to everyone's convenience.
translations.idiomatic: Dezhou formerly assessed the people for horses to supply the post stations and also conscripted them for foot courier service. Xiang replaced these with official horses and soldier couriers, to everyone's convenience.

sentences.zh: 會內殿崇班閻日新建議，請於靜戎、威虜兩軍置場鬻茶，收其利以資軍用。

translations.literal: When Inner Hall Attendant Yan Rixin proposed establishing markets at Jingrong and Weilu armies to sell tea and collect profit to support military expenses,
translations.idiomatic: When Inner Hall Attendant Yan Rixin proposed establishing markets at Jingrong and Weilu armies to sell tea and collect profit to support military expenses,

sentences.zh: 湘言非便，遂止。

translations.literal: Xiang said it was not advantageous and the plan was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang said it was not advantageous, and the plan was stopped.

sentences.zh: 又言事者請許榷場商旅以茶藥等物販易於北界，北界商旅許於雄、霸州市易，資其懋遷，庶息邊患。

translations.literal: Others also proposed allowing frontier-market travelers to trade tea and medicines and the like with the northern border, and northern border travelers to trade at Xiong and Bazhou markets, enriching commerce and hoping to ease border troubles.
translations.idiomatic: Others also proposed allowing frontier-market travelers to trade tea and medicines and the like with the northern border, and northern border travelers to trade at Xiong and Bazhou markets, enriching commerce and hoping to ease border troubles.

sentences.zh: 詔湘詳議以聞，乃上言曰：“北邊自興置榷場，商旅輻湊，制置深得其宜。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Xiang to discuss the matter in detail and report; he memorialized, saying: "Since the northern border established frontier markets, travelers have gathered in numbers and the arrangements have been deeply appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Xiang to discuss the matter in detail and report. He memorialized, saying, "Since the northern border established frontier markets, travelers have gathered in numbers and the arrangements have been deeply appropriate.

sentences.zh: 今若許其交相販易，則沿邊商人深入戎界，竊為非便。

translations.literal: If mutual trade is now permitted, frontier merchants will penetrate deep into the barbarian regions, which is secretly not advantageous.
translations.idiomatic: If mutual trade is now permitted, frontier merchants will penetrate deep into the barbarian regions, which is secretly not advantageous.

sentences.zh: 又北界商人若至雄、霸，其中或雜奸偽，何由辨明？

translations.literal: Moreover, if northern border merchants come to Xiong and Ba, some among them may mix in deceit—how can this be distinguished?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, if northern border merchants come to Xiong and Ba, some among them may mix in deceit. How can this be distinguished?

sentences.zh: 況邊民易動難安，蕃戎之情宜為羈製。

translations.literal: Moreover frontier people are easily stirred and hard to settle; barbarian sentiment should be kept under restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover frontier people are easily stirred and hard to settle. Barbarian sentiment should be kept under restraint.

sentences.zh: 望且仍舊為便。

translations.literal: I hope the former practice may continue, which would be convenient.
translations.idiomatic: I hope the former practice may continue, which would be convenient."

sentences.zh: ”會有詔規度復修定州新樂、蒲陰兩縣，湘以其地迫窄，非屯兵之所，遂奏罷之。

translations.literal: When an edict was issued to plan restoration of Xinle and Puyin counties in Dingzhou, Xiang, because the land was narrow and not a place to station troops, memorialized to stop it.
translations.idiomatic: When an edict was issued to plan restoration of Xinle and Puyin counties in Dingzhou, Xiang, because the land was narrow and not a place to station troops, memorialized to stop it.

sentences.zh: 湘少文而長於吏事，歷邊部，所至必廣儲畜為備豫計，出入軍旅間，頗著能名。

translations.literal: Xiang had little literary learning but excelled in administrative affairs; serving on the frontier, wherever he went he always stored supplies broadly as a precaution, moving among armies, and was quite known for ability.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang had little literary learning but excelled in administrative affairs. Serving on the frontier, wherever he went he always stored supplies broadly as a precaution. Moving among armies, he was quite known for his ability.

sentences.zh: 先是，邊州置榷場，與蕃夷互市，而自京輦物貨以充之，其中茶茗最為煩擾，復道遠多損敗。

translations.literal: Earlier, frontier prefectures established frontier markets to trade with the tribes; goods were transported from the capital to fill them, among which tea was most troublesome, and the long route caused much loss.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, frontier prefectures established frontier markets to trade with the tribes. Goods were transported from the capital to fill them, among which tea was most troublesome, and the long route caused much loss.

sentences.zh: 湘建議請許商賈緣江載茶詣邊郡入中，既免道途之耗，復有征算之益。

translations.literal: Xiang proposed allowing merchants to transport tea along the river to frontier prefectures for official purchase, avoiding route losses and gaining tax revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang proposed allowing merchants to transport tea along the river to frontier prefectures for official purchase, avoiding route losses and gaining tax revenue.

sentences.zh: 又威虜、靜戎軍歲燒緣邊草地以虞南牧，言事者又請於北砦山麓中興置銀冶，湘以為召寇，亦奏罷之。

translations.literal: Also, Weilu and Jingrong armies annually burned the grass along the frontier to guard against southern grazing; others proposed establishing a silver smelter at the foot of Beizhai Mountain in Zhongxing; Xiang, thinking this would invite raids, also memorialized to stop it.
translations.idiomatic: Also, Weilu and Jingrong armies annually burned the grass along the frontier to guard against southern grazing. Others proposed establishing a silver smelter at the foot of Beizhai Mountain in Zhongxing. Xiang, thinking this would invite raids, also memorialized to stop it.

sentences.zh: 咸平二年，入為戶部使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianping he entered service as commissioner of the Household Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianping he entered service as commissioner of the Household Bureau.

sentences.zh: 受詔詳定三司編敕，坐與王扶交相請托，擅易板籍，責授將作少監。

translations.literal: Receiving an order to compile the Three Offices code, he was punished for mutual solicitation with Wang Fu and unauthorized alteration of records, and demoted to vice director of the Directorate of Imperial Manufactories.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving an order to compile the Three Offices code, he was punished for mutual solicitation with Wang Fu and unauthorized alteration of records, and demoted to vice director of the Directorate of Imperial Manufactories.

sentences.zh: 三年，出知許州，徙荊南，復為右諫議大夫、知廣州。

translations.literal: In the third year he was sent out as prefect of Xuzhou, transferred to Jingnan, and again made Right Remonstrance Councillor and prefect of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was sent out as prefect of Xuzhou, transferred to Jingnan, and again made Right Remonstrance Councillor and prefect of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 四年，卒，詔遣其子希顏護喪傳置歸鄉里。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he died; an edict sent his son Xiyan to escort the coffin home by post relay.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died. An edict sent his son Xiyan to escort the coffin home by post relay.

sentences.zh: 宋太初

translations.literal: Song Taichu
translations.idiomatic: Song Taichu

sentences.zh: 宋太初，字永初，澤州晉城人。

translations.literal: Song Taichu, courtesy name Yongchu, was a man of Jincheng in Ze Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Song Taichu, whose courtesy name was Yongchu, was a native of Jincheng in Ze Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 太平興國三年舉進士，解褐大理評事、通判戎州，以善政聞，有詔褒美。

translations.literal: In the third year of Taiping Xingguo he passed the jinshi examination; upon leaving office robes he became an assessor of the Court of Judicial Review and vice prefect of Rongzhou, and was known for good governance; an edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Taiping Xingguo he passed the jinshi examination. Upon entering official service he became an assessor of the Court of Judicial Review and vice prefect of Rongzhou, and was known for good governance. An edict praised him.

sentences.zh: 遷將作監丞、讚善大夫、通判晉州，轉太常丞。

translations.literal: He was transferred to director of the Directorate of Works, Supporter-in-Attendance, and vice prefect of Jin Prefecture, then to director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to director of the Directorate of Works, Supporter-in-Attendance, and vice prefect of Jin Prefecture, then to director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 雍熙三年，通判成都府，賜緋魚。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongxi he served as vice prefect of Chengdu Prefecture and was granted the red fish badge.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongxi he served as vice prefect of Chengdu Prefecture and was granted the red fish badge.

sentences.zh: 會詔求直言，著《守成箴》以獻。

translations.literal: When an edict sought frank counsel, he composed the "Admonition for Maintaining Success" and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: When an edict sought frank counsel, he composed the "Admonition for Maintaining Success" and presented it.

sentences.zh: 淳化初，遷監察御史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chunhua he was transferred to investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Chunhua he was transferred to investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 時北面用兵，選為雄州通判。

translations.literal: At the time the northern front was at war; he was selected as vice prefect of Xiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the northern front was at war. He was selected as vice prefect of Xiongzhou.

sentences.zh: 入判度支勾院。

translations.literal: He entered to administer the Revenue Audit Bureau of the Three Offices.
translations.idiomatic: He entered to administer the Revenue Audit Bureau of the Three Offices.

sentences.zh: 二年，為京西轉運副使。

translations.literal: In the second year he became vice transport commissioner of the Jingxi Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he became vice transport commissioner of the Jingxi Circuit.

sentences.zh: 未幾，移河東。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to Hedong.

sentences.zh: 四年，遷正使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to chief commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was promoted to chief commissioner.

sentences.zh: 改殿中侍殷史。

translations.literal: He was changed to palace censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed to palace censor.

sentences.zh: 至道初，遷兵部員外郎，充鹽鐵副使，賜金紫。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhidao era he was transferred to vice minister of war and appointed vice commissioner of salt and iron, and granted the gold and purple insignia.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhidao era he was transferred to vice minister of war and appointed vice commissioner of salt and iron, and granted the gold and purple insignia.

sentences.zh: 時陳恕為使，太初有所規畫必諮恕，未嘗自用為功，恕甚德之。

translations.literal: At the time Chen Shu was commissioner; whenever Taichu planned something he always consulted Shu and never took credit himself; Shu was deeply grateful.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Chen Shu was commissioner. Whenever Taichu planned something he always consulted Shu and never took credit himself. Shu was deeply grateful.

sentences.zh: 會西鄙有警，轉饋艱急，改刑部郎中、充陝西轉運使。

translations.literal: When there was alarm on the western border and transport of supplies was urgent, he was changed to director of the Ministry of Justice and appointed transport commissioner of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: When there was alarm on the western border and transport of supplies was urgent, he was changed to director of the Ministry of Justice and appointed transport commissioner of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 二年，命白守榮、馬紹忠護芻糧，分三番抵靈州。

translations.literal: In the second year Bai Shourong and Ma Shaozhong were ordered to escort fodder and grain, dividing into three groups to reach Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Bai Shourong and Ma Shaozhong were ordered to escort fodder and grain, dividing into three groups to reach Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 轉運副使盧之翰違旨並往，為戎人所剽。

translations.literal: Vice transport commissioner Lu Zhihan disobeyed the order and went together; they were plundered by the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Vice transport commissioner Lu Zhihan disobeyed the order and went together. They were plundered by the barbarians.

sentences.zh: 上怒，捕太初及副使秘書丞竇比係獄。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry and had Taichu and vice commissioner Secretary Director Dou Bi imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was angry and had Taichu and vice commissioner Secretary Director Dou Bi imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 太初責懷州團練副使，之翰、比悉除名，之翰貶許州司馬，比商州司戶掾。

translations.literal: Taichu was punished as regimental vice commander of Huaizhou; Zhihan and Bi were all stripped of rank; Zhihan was demoted to marshal of Xuzhou; Bi to registrar of Shangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Taichu was punished as regimental vice commander of Huaizhou. Zhihan and Bi were all stripped of rank. Zhihan was demoted to marshal of Xuzhou and Bi to registrar of Shangzhou.

sentences.zh: 明年，起太初為祠部郎中，知梓州。

translations.literal: The next year Taichu was raised to director of the Ministry of Rites and made prefect of Zizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Taichu was raised to director of the Ministry of Rites and made prefect of Zizhou.

sentences.zh: 俄復舊秩。

translations.literal: Soon his former rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his former rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 真宗嗣位，召還，復命經度陝西饋運事。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong succeeded, he was recalled and again ordered to manage Shaanxi supply transport.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhenzong succeeded, he was recalled and again ordered to manage Shaanxi supply transport.

sentences.zh: 咸平初，拜右諫議大夫、知江陵府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianping he was appointed Right Remonstrance Councillor and prefect of Jiangling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xianping he was appointed Right Remonstrance Councillor and prefect of Jiangling Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 蠻寇擾動，太初以便宜制遏，詔獎之。

translations.literal: Barbarian bandits were active; Taichu restrained them by expedient measures, and an edict commended him.
translations.idiomatic: Barbarian bandits were active. Taichu restrained them by expedient measures, and an edict commended him.

sentences.zh: 三年，再知梓州。

translations.literal: In the third year he again served as prefect of Zizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he again served as prefect of Zizhou.

sentences.zh: 明年，益州雷有終以母老求還，詔太初就代。

translations.literal: The next year Lei Youzhong of Yizhou, because his mother was old, requested to return; an edict ordered Taichu to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Lei Youzhong of Yizhou, because his mother was old, requested to return. An edict ordered Taichu to replace him.

sentences.zh: 時分川峽為四路，各置轉運使。

translations.literal: At the time the Chuanxi region was divided into four circuits, each with its own transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Chuanxi region was divided into four circuits, each with its own transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 上以事有緩急，難於均濟，命太初為四路都轉運使，要切之務，俾同規畫。

translations.literal: The emperor, considering that urgent and slack affairs were hard to balance equally, appointed Taichu general transport commissioner of the four circuits to plan critical affairs together.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, considering that urgent and slack affairs were hard to balance equally, appointed Taichu general transport commissioner of the four circuits to plan critical affairs together.

sentences.zh: 太初與鈐轄楊懷忠頗不協，時蜀土始安，上慮其臨事矛盾，亟召太初還。

translations.literal: Taichu and commander Yang Huaizhong were quite at odds; as Shu had only recently been pacified, the emperor feared conflict in handling affairs and quickly recalled Taichu.
translations.idiomatic: Taichu and commander Yang Huaizhong were quite at odds. As Shu had only recently been pacified, the emperor feared conflict in handling affairs and quickly recalled Taichu.

sentences.zh: 會御史中丞趙昌言等坐事被劾，命權御史中丞。

translations.literal: When Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhao Changyan and others were impeached for offenses, he was appointed acting Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: When Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhao Changyan and others were impeached for offenses, he was appointed acting Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 先是，按劾有罪必豫請朝旨，太初以為失風憲體，獄成然後聞上，時論韙之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when investigating guilt the court always requested instructions beforehand; Taichu held that this lost the dignity of the censorate and only reported to the throne after the case was complete; contemporary opinion approved.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when investigating guilt the court always requested instructions beforehand. Taichu held that this lost the dignity of the censorate and only reported to the throne after the case was complete. Contemporary opinion approved.

sentences.zh: 俄出知杭州。

translations.literal: Soon he was sent out as prefect of Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was sent out as prefect of Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 太初有宿疾，以浙右卑濕不便，求近地，得廬州。

translations.literal: Taichu had a chronic illness; because the lower Zhe region was damp and inconvenient, he sought a nearer post and obtained Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Taichu had a chronic illness. Because the lower Zhe region was damp and inconvenient, he sought a nearer post and obtained Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 疾久，頗昏忘，不能治大郡，連徙汝、光二州。

translations.literal: His illness lasted long and he became quite forgetful, unable to govern a large prefecture; he was transferred in succession to Ru and Guang prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: His illness lasted long and he became quite forgetful, unable to govern a large prefecture. He was transferred in succession to Ru Prefecture and Guang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 景德四年卒，年六十二。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jingde he died, aged sixty-two.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jingde he died, aged sixty-two.

sentences.zh: 錄其弟繼讓試校書郎。

translations.literal: His younger brother Jirang was granted trial appointment as proofreader.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Jirang was granted trial appointment as proofreader.

sentences.zh: 太初性周慎，所至有幹職譽。

translations.literal: Taichu was careful and thorough by nature and wherever he served had a reputation for competence.
translations.idiomatic: Taichu was careful and thorough by nature and wherever he served had a reputation for competence.

sentences.zh: 嘗著《簡譚》三十八篇，自序略曰：“廣平生纂文史老釋之學，嘗謂《禮》之中庸，伯陽之自然，釋氏之無為，其歸一也。

translations.literal: He once composed thirty-eight chapters of "Brief Discourses," saying in the preface in summary: "Having broadly collected the learning of literature, history, Laozi, and Buddhism throughout life, I have held that the mean in the Rites, spontaneity in Bo Yang, and non-action in Buddhism all return to one.
translations.idiomatic: He once composed thirty-eight chapters of "Brief Discourses," saying in the preface in summary: "Having broadly collected the learning of literature, history, Laozi, and Buddhism throughout life, I have held that the mean in the Rites, spontaneity in Bo Yang, and non-action in Buddhism all return to one.

sentences.zh: 喜以古聖道契當世之事，而患未博也，忽外物觸於耳目，內機發於性情，因筆而簡之，以備闕忘耳。

translations.literal: I delight in matching the way of the ancient sages with affairs of the present age, yet worry my knowledge is not broad; suddenly external things touch eye and ear and inner impulses arise from temperament, and so I write briefly to guard against forgetting.
translations.idiomatic: I delight in matching the way of the ancient sages with affairs of the present age, yet worry my knowledge is not broad. Suddenly external things touch eye and ear and inner impulses arise from temperament, and so I write briefly to guard against forgetting."

sentences.zh: ”子傳慶，後為太子中舍。

translations.literal: His son Chuanqing later served as attendant of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: His son Chuanqing later served as attendant of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 盧之翰

translations.literal: Lu Zhihan
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhihan

sentences.zh: 盧之翰，字維周，祁州人。

translations.literal: Lu Zhihan, courtesy name Weizhou, was a man of Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhihan, whose courtesy name was Weizhou, was a native of Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 曾祖玄暉，鴻臚卿。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Xuanhui was Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Xuanhui was Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 祖知誨，天雄軍掌書記。

translations.literal: His grandfather Zhihui was secretary of the Tianxiong Army.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Zhihui was secretary of the Tianxiong Army.

sentences.zh: 父宏，蔡州防禦判官。

translations.literal: His father Hong was defense judge of Caizhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Hong was defense judge of Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 之翰少篤學，家貧，客遊單州，防禦使劉乙館於門下。

translations.literal: Zhihan studied diligently from youth; his family was poor and he traveled as a guest to Shan Prefecture, where Defense Commissioner Liu Yi lodged him at his gate.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihan studied diligently from youth. His family was poor and he traveled as a guest to Shan Prefecture, where Defense Commissioner Liu Yi lodged him at his gate.

sentences.zh: 乙徙錢塘，之翰隨寓其郡。

translations.literal: When Yi moved to Qiantang, Zhihan followed and lodged in that commandery.
translations.idiomatic: When Yi moved to Qiantang, Zhihan followed and lodged in that commandery.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年，舉進士，不得解，詣登聞自陳，詔聽附京兆府解試。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo he passed the jinshi examination but could not leave office robes; he went to the Palace of Imperial Audience to state his case himself, and an edict allowed him to take the qualifying examination attached to Jingzhao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo he passed the jinshi examination but could not leave office robes. He went to the Palace of Imperial Audience to state his case himself, and an edict allowed him to take the qualifying examination attached to Jingzhao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 明年登第，解褐大理評事、知臨安縣，三遷殿中丞，通判洺州。

translations.literal: The next year he passed and upon leaving office robes became an assessor of the Court of Judicial Review and magistrate of Lin'an County; after three promotions he was palace secretary and vice prefect of Ming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he passed and upon entering official service became an assessor of the Court of Judicial Review and magistrate of Lin'an County. After three promotions he was palace secretary and vice prefect of Ming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 會契丹入寇，之翰募城中丁壯，決漳、御河以固城壁，虜不能攻。

translations.literal: When the Khitans invaded, Zhihan recruited able-bodied men in the city, cut the Zhang and Yu rivers to strengthen the walls, and the barbarians could not attack.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitans invaded, Zhihan recruited able-bodied men in the city, cut the Zhang and Yu rivers to strengthen the walls, and the barbarians could not attack.

sentences.zh: 吏民詣闕求借留。

translations.literal: Officials and people went to court requesting he be retained.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and people went to court requesting he be retained.

sentences.zh: 召還，遷太常博士，為河東轉運副使，徙京西轉運副使，改工部員外郎。

translations.literal: Recalled, he was transferred to doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, vice transport commissioner of Hedong, then vice transport commissioner of the Jingxi Circuit, and changed to vice minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled, he was transferred to doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, vice transport commissioner of Hedong, then vice transport commissioner of the Jingxi Circuit, and changed to vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 建議導潩河合於淮，達許州，以便漕運。

translations.literal: He proposed diverting the Yu River to join the Huai and reach Xuzhou to facilitate canal transport.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed diverting the Yu River to join the Huai and reach Xuzhou to facilitate canal transport.

sentences.zh: 以勞加戶部員外郎。

translations.literal: For his labor he was promoted to vice minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: For his labor he was promoted to vice minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 又改陝西轉運使，遷吏部員外郎。

translations.literal: He was again changed to transport commissioner of Shaanxi and transferred to vice minister of personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was again changed to transport commissioner of Shaanxi and transferred to vice minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 至道初，李順亂蜀，命兼西川安撫轉運使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhidao era, when Li Shun rebelled in Shu, he was ordered to serve concurrently as pacification and transport commissioner of western Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhidao era, when Li Shun rebelled in Shu, he was ordered to serve concurrently as pacification and transport commissioner of western Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 賊平，還任。

translations.literal: When the rebels were pacified he returned to his post.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels were pacified he returned to his post.

sentences.zh: 之翰嘗薦李憲為大理丞，憲坐贓抵死，之翰當削三任。

translations.literal: Zhihan once recommended Li Xian as assessor of the Court of Judicial Review; Xian was executed for embezzlement and Zhihan should have been stripped of three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihan once recommended Li Xian as assessor of the Court of Judicial Review. Xian was executed for embezzlement, and Zhihan should have been stripped of three ranks.

sentences.zh: 時副使鄭文寶議城清遠軍，又禁蕃商貨鹽，之翰心知其非便，以文寶方任事，不敢異其議。

translations.literal: At the time vice commissioner Zheng Wenbao proposed fortifying Qingyuan Army and forbidding tribal merchants from trading salt; Zhihan knew in his heart this was not advantageous but, as Wenbao was then in charge, did not dare differ from his view.
translations.idiomatic: At the time vice commissioner Zheng Wenbao proposed fortifying Qingyuan Army and forbidding tribal merchants from trading salt. Zhihan knew in his heart this was not advantageous but, as Wenbao was then in charge, did not dare differ from his view.

sentences.zh: 及文寶得罪，之翰並前愆，左授國子博士，領使如故。

translations.literal: When Wenbao was punished, Zhihan was punished together for his earlier fault and demoted to doctor of the Imperial Academy, retaining his commission as before.
translations.idiomatic: When Wenbao was punished, Zhihan was punished together for his earlier fault and demoted to doctor of the Imperial Academy, retaining his commission as before.

sentences.zh: 尋復舊職。

translations.literal: Soon his former post was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his former post was restored.

sentences.zh: 會調發芻糧輸靈州，詔分三道護送，命洛苑使白守榮、馬紹忠領其事。

translations.literal: When fodder and grain were mobilized for transport to Lingzhou, an edict divided escort into three routes and ordered Luoyuan Commissioner Bai Shourong and Ma Shaozhong to lead the affair.
translations.idiomatic: When fodder and grain were mobilized for transport to Lingzhou, an edict divided escort into three routes and ordered Luoyuan Commissioner Bai Shourong and Ma Shaozhong to lead the affair.

sentences.zh: 之翰違旨擅並為一，為李繼遷邀擊於浦洛河，大失輜重。

translations.literal: Zhihan disobeyed the order and arbitrarily combined them into one; they were ambushed by Li Jiqian at the Puluo River and lost a great quantity of baggage.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihan disobeyed the order and arbitrarily combined them into one. They were ambushed by Li Jiqian at the Puluo River and lost a great quantity of baggage.

sentences.zh: 詔國子博士王用和乘傳逮捕，係獄鞫問。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Doctor of the Imperial Academy Wang Yonghe to travel by post relay to arrest and imprison him for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Doctor of the Imperial Academy Wang Yonghe to travel by post relay to arrest and imprison him for interrogation.

sentences.zh: 之翰坐除名，貶許州司馬。

translations.literal: Zhihan was stripped of rank and demoted to marshal of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihan was stripped of rank and demoted to marshal of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 明年，起為工部員外郎、同勾當陝西轉運使。

translations.literal: The next year he was raised to vice minister of works and appointed concurrently to manage Shaanxi transport.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was raised to vice minister of works and appointed concurrently to manage Shaanxi transport.

sentences.zh: 真宗即位，復吏部員外郎，充轉運使。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong acceded he again became vice minister of personnel and transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhenzong acceded he again became vice minister of personnel and transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以久次，召拜禮部郎中，賜金紫，復遣之任。

translations.literal: Because of long service he was summoned and appointed director of the Ministry of Rites, granted the gold and purple insignia, and again sent to his post.
translations.idiomatic: Because of long service he was summoned and appointed director of the Ministry of Rites, granted the gold and purple insignia, and again sent to his post.

sentences.zh: 咸平元年，以疾命國子博士張誌言代還。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianping, on account of illness Doctor of the Imperial Academy Zhang Zhiyan was ordered to replace him and return.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianping, on account of illness Doctor of the Imperial Academy Zhang Zhiyan was ordered to replace him and return.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復出為京西轉運使。

translations.literal: Before long he again went out as transport commissioner of the Jingxi Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he again went out as transport commissioner of the Jingxi Circuit.

sentences.zh: 先是，朝廷議城故原州，以張守備，之翰沮罷之，其後西鄙不寧，修葺為鎮戎軍，之翰坐橫議非便，黜知歸州，便道之官，限五日即發。

translations.literal: Earlier the court had discussed rebuilding old Yuanzhou for defense; Zhihan obstructed and stopped it. Afterwards the western border was unsettled and it was repaired as Zhenrong Army; Zhihan was punished for reckless opposition and demoted to prefect of Guizhou, proceeding directly to office with orders to depart within five days.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the court had discussed rebuilding old Yuanzhou for defense. Zhihan obstructed and stopped it. Afterwards the western border was unsettled and it was repaired as Zhenrong Army. Zhihan was punished for reckless opposition and demoted to prefect of Guizhou, proceeding directly to office with orders to depart within five days.

sentences.zh: 三年，授廣南西路轉運使。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed transport commissioner of the Guangnan West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was appointed transport commissioner of the Guangnan West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 會廣州索湘卒，就改太常少卿、知州事。

translations.literal: When Suo Xiang of Guangzhou died, he was changed to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and given charge of prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Suo Xiang of Guangzhou died, he was changed to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and given charge of prefectural affairs.

sentences.zh: 之翰無廉稱，又與轉運使淩策不協，陰發其事。
