translations.literal: Zhihan had no reputation for integrity and was also at odds with transport commissioner Ling Ce, who secretly exposed the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihan had no reputation for integrity and was also at odds with transport commissioner Ling Ce, who secretly exposed the matter.

sentences.zh: 五年，徙知永州，未行，卒，年五十七。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to Yongzhou; before he departed he died, aged fifty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to Yongzhou. Before he departed he died, aged fifty-seven.

sentences.zh: 鄭文寶

translations.literal: Zheng Wenbao
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Wenbao

sentences.zh: 鄭文寶，字仲賢，右千牛衛大將軍彥華之子。

translations.literal: Zheng Wenbao, courtesy name Zhongxian, was a son of Major General Yanhua of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Wenbao, whose courtesy name was Zhongxian, was a son of Major General Yanhua of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard.

sentences.zh: 彥華初事李煜，文寶以蔭授奉禮郎，掌煜子清源公仲寓書籍，遷校書郎。

translations.literal: Yanhua initially served Li Yu; Wenbao entered service through yin privilege as ceremonial officer and managed the books of Yu's son Zhongyu, Prince of Qingyuan, and was transferred to proofreader.
translations.idiomatic: Yanhua initially served Li Yu. Wenbao entered service through yin privilege as ceremonial officer and managed the books of Yu's son Zhongyu, Prince of Qingyuan, and was transferred to proofreader.

sentences.zh: 入宋，煜以環衛奉朝請，文寶欲一見，慮衛者難之，乃被蓑荷笠，以漁者見，陳聖主寬宥之意，宜謹節奉上，勿為他慮。

translations.literal: Entering Song, Yu was given the guard appointment to attend court; Wenbao wished to see him once but feared the guards would make it difficult, so wearing a rain cape and carrying a bamboo hat he appeared as a fisherman, met Yu, and explained the grace and leniency of the sage ruler, advising careful obedience and not to worry otherwise.
translations.idiomatic: Entering Song, Yu was given the guard appointment to attend court. Wenbao wished to see him once but feared the guards would make it difficult, so wearing a rain cape and carrying a bamboo hat he appeared as a fisherman, met Yu, and explained the grace and leniency of the sage ruler, advising careful obedience and not to worry otherwise.

sentences.zh: 煜忠之。

translations.literal: Yu trusted him.
translations.idiomatic: Yu trusted him.

sentences.zh: 後補廣文館生，深為李昉所知。

translations.literal: Later he was appointed student of the Broad Culture Hall and was deeply known by Li Fang.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was appointed student of the Broad Culture Hall and was deeply known by Li Fang.

sentences.zh: 太平興國八年，登進士第，除修武主簿。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Taiping Xingguo he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed chief clerk of Xiuwu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Taiping Xingguo he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed chief clerk of Xiuwu.

sentences.zh: 遷大理評事、知梓州錄事參軍事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to assessor of the Court of Judicial Review and registrar of Zizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to assessor of the Court of Judicial Review and registrar of Zizhou.

sentences.zh: 州將表薦，轉光祿寺丞。

translations.literal: The prefect recommended him and he was transferred to director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: The prefect recommended him and he was transferred to director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 留一歲，代歸。

translations.literal: After one year his replacement returned.
translations.idiomatic: After one year his replacement returned.

sentences.zh: 獻所著文，召試翰林，改著作佐郎、通判潁州。

translations.literal: He presented his writings; summoned for examination at the Hanlin Academy, he was changed to assistant secretary of the Palace Library and vice prefect of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He presented his writings. Summoned for examination at the Hanlin Academy, he was changed to assistant secretary of the Palace Library and vice prefect of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁外艱，起知州事。

translations.literal: Upon the death of his father he was raised to manage prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Upon the death of his father he was raised to manage prefectural affairs.

sentences.zh: 召拜殿中丞，使川、陝均稅。

translations.literal: Summoned and appointed palace secretary, he was sent to Sichuan and Shaanxi to equalize taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned and appointed palace secretary, he was sent to Sichuan and Shaanxi to equalize taxes.

sentences.zh: 次渝、涪，聞夔州廣武卒謀亂，乃乘舸泛江，一夕數百里，以計平之。

translations.literal: Stopping at Yu and Fu, he heard that Guangwu troops of Kuizhou plotted rebellion; he took a boat down the river, several hundred li in one night, and by stratagem pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Stopping at Yu and Fu, he heard that Guangwu troops of Kuizhou plotted rebellion. He took a boat down the river, several hundred li in one night, and by stratagem pacified them.

sentences.zh: 授陝西轉運副使，許便宜從事。

translations.literal: He was appointed vice transport commissioner of Shaanxi with permission to act as expedient required.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice transport commissioner of Shaanxi with permission to act as expedient required.

sentences.zh: 會歲歉，誘豪民出粟三萬斛，活饑民八萬六千口。

translations.literal: When famine came that year he induced wealthy families to release thirty thousand hu of grain and saved eighty-six thousand starving people.
translations.idiomatic: When famine came that year he induced wealthy families to release thirty thousand hu of grain and saved eighty-six thousand starving people.

sentences.zh: 既而李順亂西蜀，秦隴賊趙包聚徒數千，將趨劍閣以附之。

translations.literal: Soon Li Shun rebelled in western Shu; in Qin and Long the bandit Zhao Bao gathered several thousand followers and was about to advance on Jiange to join him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Li Shun rebelled in western Shu. In Qin and Long the bandit Zhao Bao gathered several thousand followers and was about to advance on Jiange to join him.

sentences.zh: 文寶移書蜀郡，分兵討襲，獲其渠魁，餘黨殲焉。

translations.literal: Wenbao sent letters to Shu commanderies, divided troops to attack and raid, captured the ringleaders, and the remaining followers were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Wenbao sent letters to Shu commanderies, divided troops to attack and raid, captured the ringleaders, and the remaining followers were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 文寶前後自環慶部糧越旱海入靈武者十二次，曉達蕃情，習其語，經由部落，每宿酋長帳中，其人或呼為父。

translations.literal: Wenbao twelve times personally transported grain from Huan and Qing across the dry sea into Lingwu; he understood tribal conditions well, knew their language, and when passing through tribes often lodged in chieftains' tents; some called him father.
translations.idiomatic: Wenbao twelve times personally transported grain from Huan and Qing across the dry sea into Lingwu. He understood tribal conditions well, knew their language, and when passing through tribes often lodged in chieftains' tents. Some called him father.

sentences.zh: 遷太常博士。

translations.literal: He was transferred to doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 內侍方保吉出使陝右，頗恣橫，且言文寶與陳堯叟交遊，為薦其弟堯佐。

translations.literal: Inner Attendant Fang Baoji went on mission to Shaanxi and acted with great arrogance, also saying Wenbao associated with Chen Yaosou and recommended his younger brother Yaozuo.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Attendant Fang Baoji went on mission to Shaanxi and acted with great arrogance, also saying Wenbao associated with Chen Yaosou and recommended his younger brother Yaozuo.

sentences.zh: 驛召令辨對，途中上書自明。

translations.literal: Summoned by post relay to answer the charge, on the road he memorialized to clarify himself.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned by post relay to answer the charge, on the road he memorialized to clarify himself.

sentences.zh: 太宗察其事，坐保吉罪，厚賜文寶而遣之，俄又召至闕下，文寶奏對辯捷，上深眷遇。

translations.literal: Taizong investigated the matter, punished Baoji, richly rewarded Wenbao and sent him away; soon he was again summoned to court; Wenbao answered at audience with quick eloquence and the emperor deeply favored him.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong investigated the matter, punished Baoji, richly rewarded Wenbao and sent him away. Soon he was again summoned to court. Wenbao answered at audience with quick eloquence and the emperor deeply favored him.

sentences.zh: 俄加工部員外郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to vice minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted to vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 時龍猛卒戍環慶，七年不得代，思歸，謀亂。

translations.literal: At the time the Longmeng troops garrisoned Huan and Qing; for seven years they received no replacement and, longing to return, plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Longmeng troops garrisoned Huan and Qing. For seven years they received no replacement and, longing to return, plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 文寶矯詔以庫金給將士，且自劾，請代償，詔蠲其所費。

translations.literal: Wenbao forged an edict to distribute treasury gold to the officers and soldiers and also impeached himself, requesting to make restitution; an edict remitted the expense.
translations.idiomatic: Wenbao forged an edict to distribute treasury gold to the officers and soldiers and also impeached himself, requesting to make restitution. An edict remitted the expense.

sentences.zh: 先是，諸羌部落樹藝殊少，但用池鹽與邊民交易穀麥，會饋免趨靈州，為繼遷所鈔。

translations.literal: Earlier, among the various Qiang tribes agriculture was very sparse; they relied only on trading pool salt with frontier people for grain and millet; when corvée transport rushed to Lingzhou it was plundered by Jiqian.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, among the various Qiang tribes agriculture was very sparse. They relied only on trading pool salt with frontier people for grain and millet. When corvée transport rushed to Lingzhou it was plundered by Li Jiqian.

sentences.zh: 文寶建議以為“銀、夏之北，千里不毛，但以販青白鹽為命爾。

translations.literal: Wenbao proposed, saying: "North of Yin and Xia, for a thousand li there is no vegetation; they rely only on trading green-white salt for their livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Wenbao proposed, saying, "North of Yin and Xia, for a thousand li there is no vegetation. They rely only on trading green-white salt for their livelihood.

sentences.zh: 請禁之，許商人販安邑、解縣兩池鹽於陝西以濟民食。

translations.literal: I ask that it be forbidden and merchants allowed to sell Anyi and Jie County pool salt in Shaanxi to supply the people's food.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that it be forbidden and merchants allowed to sell Anyi and Jie County pool salt in Shaanxi to supply the people's food.

sentences.zh: 官獲其利，而戎益困，繼遷可不戰而屈”。

translations.literal: The state would gain profit and the barbarians would be further distressed; Jiqian could be subdued without fighting."
translations.idiomatic: The state would gain profit and the barbarians would be further distressed. Li Jiqian could be subdued without fighting."

sentences.zh: 乃詔自陝以西有敢私市者，皆抵死，募告者差定其罪。

translations.literal: An edict was then issued that west of Shaanxi anyone who privately traded would be executed, and informers were recruited with graded punishments for the accused.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was then issued that west of Shaanxi anyone who privately traded would be executed, and informers were recruited with graded punishments for the accused.

sentences.zh: 行之數月，犯者益眾。

translations.literal: After several months offenders increased.
translations.idiomatic: After several months offenders increased.

sentences.zh: 戎人乏食，相率寇邊，屠小康堡。

translations.literal: The barbarians lacked food and together raided the border, slaughtering Xiaokang Fort.
translations.idiomatic: The barbarians lacked food and together raided the border, slaughtering Xiaokang Fort.

sentences.zh: 內屬萬餘帳亦叛。

translations.literal: More than ten thousand registered households also rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten thousand registered households also rebelled.

sentences.zh: 商人販兩池鹽少利，多取他徑出唐、鄧、襄、汝間邀善價，吏不能禁。

translations.literal: Merchants selling the two pool salts found little profit and mostly took other routes through Tang, Deng, Xiang, and Ru to seek good prices; officials could not stop them.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants selling the two pool salts found little profit and mostly took other routes through Tang, Deng, Xiang, and Ru to seek good prices. Officials could not stop them.

sentences.zh: 關、隴民無鹽以食，境上騷擾。

translations.literal: People of Guan and Long had no salt for food and the frontier was disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: People of Guan and Long had no salt for food and the frontier was disturbed.

sentences.zh: 上知其事，遣知制誥錢若水馳傳視之，悉除其禁，召諸族撫諭之，乃定。

translations.literal: The emperor learned of the affair and sent Drafting Officer Qian Ruoshui by post relay to inspect; all prohibitions were removed and the various tribes were summoned and comforted; then it was settled.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor learned of the affair and sent Drafting Officer Qian Ruoshui by post relay to inspect. All prohibitions were removed and the various tribes were summoned and comforted. Then it was settled.

sentences.zh: 朝廷議城古威州，遣內侍馮從順訪於文寶，文寶言：

translations.literal: The court discussed fortifying ancient Weizhou and sent Inner Attendant Feng Congshun to consult Wenbao; Wenbao said:
translations.idiomatic: The court discussed fortifying ancient Weizhou and sent Inner Attendant Feng Congshun to consult Wenbao. Wenbao said:

sentences.zh: “威州在清遠軍西北八十里，樂山之西。

translations.literal: "Weizhou lies eighty li northwest of Qingyuan Army, west of Leshan.
translations.idiomatic: "Weizhou lies eighty li northwest of Qingyuan Army, west of Leshan.

sentences.zh: 唐大中時，靈武朱叔明收長樂州，邠寧張君緒收六關，即其地也。

translations.literal: In the Da Zhong era of Tang, Zhu Shuming of Lingwu recovered Changle Prefecture and Zhang Junxu of Binning recovered the Six Passes—that was this place.
translations.idiomatic: In the Da Zhong era of Tang, Zhu Shuming of Lingwu recovered Changle Prefecture and Zhang Junxu of Binning recovered the Six Passes—that was this place.

sentences.zh: 故壘未圯，水甘土沃，有良木薪秸之利。

translations.literal: The old ramparts are not yet destroyed; the water is sweet and the soil fertile; there are benefits of good timber and fuel.
translations.idiomatic: The old ramparts are not yet destroyed. The water is sweet and the soil fertile. There are benefits of good timber and fuel.

sentences.zh: 約葫蘆、臨洮二河，壓明沙、蕭關兩戍，東控五原，北固峽口，足以襟帶西涼，咽喉靈武，城之便。

translations.literal: It commands the Hulu and Lintao rivers and presses Mingsha and Xiaoguan garrisons; east it controls Wuyuan and north it secures Xiakou—enough to hold western Liang and choke Lingwu; fortifying it would be advantageous.
translations.idiomatic: It commands the Hulu and Lintao rivers and presses Mingsha and Xiaoguan garrisons. East it controls Wuyuan and north it secures Xiakou—enough to hold western Liang and choke Lingwu. Fortifying it would be advantageous.

sentences.zh: 然環州至伯魚，伯魚抵青岡，青岡拒清遠皆兩舍，而清遠當群山之口，扼塞門之要，芻車野宿，行旅頓絕。

translations.literal: Yet from Huanzhou to Boyu, Boyu to Qinggang, and Qinggang to Qingyuan are each two days' march; Qingyuan stands at the mouth of the mountains and holds the vital Yaimen Pass; fodder carts camp in the open and travelers halt entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Yet from Huanzhou to Boyu, Boyu to Qinggang, and Qinggang to Qingyuan are each two days' march. Qingyuan stands at the mouth of the mountains and holds the vital Yaimen Pass. Fodder carts camp in the open and travelers halt entirely.

sentences.zh: 威州隔城東隅，豎石盤互，不可浚池。

translations.literal: Weizhou is separated by stone ramparts on the east corner of the city and moats cannot be dredged.
translations.idiomatic: Weizhou is separated by stone ramparts on the east corner of the city and moats cannot be dredged.

sentences.zh: 城中舊乏井脈，又飛烏泉去城尚千餘步，一旦緣邊警急，賊引平夏勝兵三千，據清遠之衝，乘高守險，數百人守環州甜水谷、獨家原，傳箭野狸十族，脅從山中熟戶，党項孰敢不從，又分千騎守磧北清遠軍之口，即自環至靈七百里之地，非國家所有，豈威州可禦哉？

translations.literal: The city formerly lacked wells; moreover Feiwu Spring is still more than a thousand paces from the city. Once there is frontier alarm, if the enemy leads three thousand Pingxia elite troops to hold the vital Qingyuan crossing, seize the heights and defend the passes, several hundred men guard Huanzhou Tianshui Valley and Dujia Plain, signal arrows summon the ten Ye Li tribes, coerce the mountain dwelling tribes to follow, and a thousand cavalry guard the Qingyuan crossing north of the desert—then the seven hundred li from Huan to Ling would no longer belong to the state. How could Weizhou be defended?
translations.idiomatic: The city formerly lacked wells. Moreover Feiwu Spring is still more than a thousand paces from the city. Once there is frontier alarm, if the enemy leads three thousand Pingxia elite troops to hold the vital Qingyuan crossing, seize the heights and defend the passes, several hundred men guard Huanzhou Tianshui Valley and Dujia Plain, signal arrows summon the ten Ye Li tribes, coerce the mountain dwelling tribes to follow, and a thousand cavalry guard the Qingyuan crossing north of the desert—then the seven hundred li from Huan to Ling would no longer belong to the state. How could Weizhou be defended?

sentences.zh: 請先建伯魚、青岡、清遠三城，為頓師歸重之地。

translations.literal: I ask first to build Boyu, Qinggang, and Qingyuan as places to station troops and store supplies.
translations.idiomatic: I ask first to build Boyu, Qinggang, and Qingyuan as places to station troops and store supplies.

sentences.zh: 古人有言：‘金城湯池，非粟不能守。

translations.literal: The ancients said: 'A golden city and boiling moat cannot be held without grain.'
translations.idiomatic: The ancients said, 'A golden city and boiling moat cannot be held without grain.'

sentences.zh: ’俟二年間，秦民息肩，臣請建營田積粟實邊之策，修五原故城，專三池鹽利，以金帛啖党項酋豪子弟，使為朝廷用。

translations.literal: Wait two years until the people of Qin rest their shoulders; then I ask to establish military colonies and accumulate grain to strengthen the frontier, repair the old Wuyuan city, monopolize the profit of the three pool salts, and use gold and silk to win over the sons and brothers of Dangxiang chieftains to serve the court.
translations.idiomatic: Wait two years until the people of Qin rest their shoulders. Then I ask to establish military colonies and accumulate grain to strengthen the frontier, repair the old Wuyuan city, monopolize the profit of the three pool salts, and use gold and silk to win over the sons and brothers of Dangxiang chieftains to serve the court.

sentences.zh: 不唯安朔方，制豎子，至於經營安西，綏復河湟，此其漸也。”

translations.literal: Not only would this secure Shuofang and control the barbarian child; as for managing the Anxi region and recovering He and Huang—this would be the beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Not only would this secure Shuofang and control the barbarian child. As for managing the Anxi region and recovering He and Huang—this would be the beginning.

sentences.zh: 詔從其議。

translations.literal: An edict followed his proposal.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed his proposal.

sentences.zh: 文寶至賀蘭山下，見唐室營田舊制，建議興復，可得秔稻萬餘斛，減歲運之費。

translations.literal: Wenbao reached Helan Mountain, saw the old Tang military colony system, and proposed restoring it, obtaining more than ten thousand hu of rice and reducing annual transport costs.
translations.idiomatic: Wenbao reached Helan Mountain, saw the old Tang military colony system, and proposed restoring it, obtaining more than ten thousand hu of rice and reducing annual transport costs.

sentences.zh: 清遠據積石嶺，在旱海中，去靈、環皆三四百里，素無水泉。

translations.literal: Qingyuan stands on Jishi Ridge in the dry sea; from Ling and Huan it is three or four hundred li each way and there are naturally no springs.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyuan stands on Jishi Ridge in the dry sea. From Ling and Huan it is three or four hundred li each way and there are naturally no springs.

sentences.zh: 文寶發民負水數百里外，留屯數千人，又募民以榆槐雜樹及貓狗鴉鳥至者，厚給其直。

translations.literal: Wenbao mobilized the people to carry water from several hundred li away, kept several thousand men stationed, and also recruited people to bring elm, locust, mixed trees, and even cats, dogs, crows, and birds, paying them generously.
translations.idiomatic: Wenbao mobilized the people to carry water from several hundred li away, kept several thousand men stationed, and also recruited people to bring elm, locust, mixed trees, and even cats, dogs, crows, and birds, paying them generously.

sentences.zh: 地舄鹵，樹皆立枯。

translations.literal: The soil was saline; the trees all withered standing.
translations.idiomatic: The soil was saline. The trees all withered standing.

sentences.zh: 西民甚苦其役，而城之不能守，卒為山水所壞。

translations.literal: The western people suffered greatly from the corvée and the fort could not be held; in the end it was destroyed by mountain floods.
translations.idiomatic: The western people suffered greatly from the corvée and the fort could not be held. In the end it was destroyed by mountain floods.

sentences.zh: 又令寧、慶州為水磑，亦為山水漂去。

translations.literal: He also ordered Ning and Qing prefectures to build water mills; these too were swept away by mountain floods.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered Ning and Qing prefectures to build water mills. These too were swept away by mountain floods.

sentences.zh: 繼遷酋長有嵬囉嵬悉俄者，文寶以金帛誘之，與手書要約，留其長子為質，令陰圖繼遷，即遣去。

translations.literal: Among Jiqian's chieftains was Weiluo Weixi'e; Wenbao tempted him with gold and silk and wrote a covenant in his own hand, keeping his eldest son as hostage and ordering him to secretly plot against Jiqian, then sent him away.
translations.idiomatic: Among Li Jiqian's chieftains was Weiluo Weixi'e. Wenbao tempted him with gold and silk and wrote a covenant in his own hand, keeping his eldest son as hostage and ordering him to secretly plot against Jiqian, then sent him away.

sentences.zh: 謂之曰：“事成，朝廷授汝以刺史。

translations.literal: He told him: "If the affair succeeds, the court will appoint you prefect."
translations.idiomatic: He told him, "If the affair succeeds, the court will appoint you prefect."

sentences.zh: ”文寶又預漆木為函，以備馳獻繼遷之首。

translations.literal: Wenbao also prepared a lacquered wooden box in advance to present Jiqian's head by rapid dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: Wenbao also prepared a lacquered wooden box in advance to present Li Jiqian's head by rapid dispatch.

sentences.zh: 又發民曳石碑石詣清遠軍，將圖紀功。

translations.literal: He also mobilized the people to drag stone tablets to Qingyuan Army intending to record merit.
translations.idiomatic: He also mobilized the people to drag stone tablets to Qingyuan Army intending to record merit.

sentences.zh: 而嵬囉等盡以事告繼遷，繼遷上表請罪。

translations.literal: But Weiluo and the others reported everything to Jiqian; Jiqian submitted a memorial requesting punishment.
translations.idiomatic: But Weiluo and the others reported everything to Jiqian. Li Jiqian submitted a memorial requesting punishment.

sentences.zh: 上怒文寶，猶含容之。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry with Wenbao but still tolerated him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was angry with Wenbao but still tolerated him.

sentences.zh: 既而文寶復請禁鹽，邊民冒法抵罪者甚眾。

translations.literal: Later Wenbao again requested prohibition of salt; many frontier people violated the law and were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Later Wenbao again requested prohibition of salt. Many frontier people violated the law and were punished.

sentences.zh: 太常博士席羲叟決獄陝西，廉知其事，以語中丞李昌齡，昌齡以聞。

translations.literal: Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Xi Xiesou adjudicated cases in Shaanxi, learned of the affair in an investigation, and told Vice Censor-in-Chief Li Changling; Changling reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Xi Xiesou adjudicated cases in Shaanxi, learned of the affair in an investigation, and told Vice Censor-in-Chief Li Changling. Changling reported it.

sentences.zh: 文寶又奏減解州鹽價，未滿歲，虧課二十萬貫，復為三司所發。

translations.literal: Wenbao also memorialized to reduce Jiezhou salt prices; within the year revenue fell short by two hundred thousand strings and he was again impeached by the Three Offices.
translations.idiomatic: Wenbao also memorialized to reduce Jiezhou salt prices. Within the year revenue fell short by two hundred thousand strings and he was again impeached by the Three Offices.

sentences.zh: 乃命鹽鐵副使宋太初為都轉運使，代文寶還，下御史臺鞫問，具伏。

translations.literal: Song Taichu was then appointed general transport commissioner to replace Wenbao and return; he was handed over to the Censorate for interrogation and fully confessed.
translations.idiomatic: Song Taichu was then appointed general transport commissioner to replace Wenbao and return. He was handed over to the Censorate for interrogation and fully confessed.

sentences.zh: 下詔切責，貶藍山令。

translations.literal: An edict sharply rebuked him and he was demoted to magistrate of Lanshan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sharply rebuked him and he was demoted to magistrate of Lanshan.

sentences.zh: 未幾，移枝江令。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to magistrate of Zhijiang.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to magistrate of Zhijiang.

sentences.zh: 真宗即位，徙京山。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong acceded he was transferred to Jingshan.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhenzong acceded he was transferred to Jingshan.

sentences.zh: 咸平中召還，授殿中丞，掌京南榷貨。

translations.literal: During Xianping he was recalled and appointed palace secretary in charge of capital-south monopoly goods.
translations.idiomatic: During Xianping he was recalled and appointed palace secretary in charge of capital-south monopoly goods.

sentences.zh: 時慶州發兵護芻糧詣靈州，文寶素知山川險易，上言必為繼遷所敗。

translations.literal: When Qingzhou mobilized troops to escort fodder to Lingzhou, Wenbao, knowing the mountains and rivers well, memorialized that they would surely be defeated by Jiqian.
translations.idiomatic: When Qingzhou mobilized troops to escort fodder to Lingzhou, Wenbao, knowing the mountains and rivers well, memorialized that they would surely be defeated by Li Jiqian.

sentences.zh: 未幾，果如其奏。

translations.literal: Before long it happened exactly as he memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: Before long it happened exactly as he memorialized.

sentences.zh: 轉運使陳緯沒於賊，繼遷進陷清遠軍。

translations.literal: Transport commissioner Chen Wei perished at the hands of the enemy and Jiqian advanced to take Qingyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissioner Chen Wei perished at the hands of the enemy and Li Jiqian advanced to take Qingyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 時文寶丁內艱，服未闋，即命相府召詢其策略。

translations.literal: At the time Wenbao was in mourning for his mother and had not yet completed the period; he was immediately ordered to the chief councilor's office to consult on strategy.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Wenbao was in mourning for his mother and had not yet completed the mourning period. He was immediately ordered to the chief councilor's office to consult on strategy.

sentences.zh: 文寶因獻《河西隴右圖》，敘其地利本末，且言靈州不可棄。

translations.literal: Wenbao thereupon presented the "Map of Hexi and Longyou," narrating the geographical advantages from beginning to end, and also said Lingzhou must not be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Wenbao thereupon presented the "Map of Hexi and Longyou," narrating the geographical advantages from beginning to end, and also said Lingzhou must not be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 時方遣大將王超援靈武，即復文寶工部員外郎，為隨軍轉運使。

translations.literal: At the time a great general Wang Chao was being sent to aid Lingwu; Wenbao was immediately restored to vice minister of works and made accompanying army transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the great general Wang Chao was being sent to aid Lingwu. Wenbao was immediately restored to vice minister of works and made accompanying army transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 至環州，或言靈州已陷，文寶乃易其服，引單騎，冒大雪，間道抵清遠故城，盡得其實，遂奏班師，就除本路轉運使，上疏請再葺清遠軍。

translations.literal: Reaching Huanzhou, some said Lingzhou had fallen; Wenbao changed his clothes, took a single horse alone, braved heavy snow, and by a hidden route reached the old Qingyuan city, learned the full truth, memorialized to withdraw the army, and was appointed transport commissioner of that circuit; he memorialized to rebuild Qingyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Huanzhou, some said Lingzhou had fallen. Wenbao changed his clothes, took a single horse alone, braved heavy snow, and by a hidden route reached the old Qingyuan city, learned the full truth, memorialized to withdraw the army, and was appointed transport commissioner of that circuit. He memorialized to rebuild Qingyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 都部署王漢忠言其好生事，遂徒河東轉運使。

translations.literal: Chief commander Wang Hanzhong said he loved to stir up affairs and he was transferred to Hedong transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Chief commander Wang Hanzhong said he loved to stir up affairs and he was transferred to Hedong transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 粕上言管內廣銳兵萬餘，難得資糧，請徙置近南諸州，又欲令強壯戶市馬，備征役。

translations.literal: He memorialized that within his jurisdiction there were more than ten thousand Guangrui troops hard to supply; he asked to transfer them to nearer southern prefectures and also wished to order strong households to buy horses for military service.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that within his jurisdiction there were more than ten thousand Guangrui troops hard to supply. He asked to transfer them to nearer southern prefectures and also wished to order strong households to buy horses for military service.

sentences.zh: 宰相李沆等以為廣銳州兵，皆本州守城，置營必慮安土重遷，徙之即致紛擾。

translations.literal: Chief councilor Li Hang and others held that Guangrui prefectural troops all guarded their home prefectures; establishing camps would fear attachment to native soil and transfer would cause disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: Chief councilor Li Hang and others held that Guangrui prefectural troops all guarded their home prefectures. Establishing camps would fear attachment to native soil and transfer would cause disturbance.

sentences.zh: 又強壯散處鄉落，無所拘轄，勒其市馬，亦恐非便。

translations.literal: Moreover strong men were scattered in villages with no restraint; forcing them to buy horses also might not be convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover strong men were scattered in villages with no restraint. Forcing them to buy horses also might not be convenient.

sentences.zh: 上復令文寶條對，文寶固執前議，且言土人久留，恐或生事。

translations.literal: The emperor again ordered Wenbao to itemize replies; Wenbao stubbornly maintained his earlier view and also said that if people stayed long they might cause trouble.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again ordered Wenbao to itemize replies. Wenbao stubbornly maintained his earlier view and also said that if people stayed long they might cause trouble.

sentences.zh: 上曰：“前令團並軍伍，改置營壁，欲其互移本貫，行之已久。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Earlier troops were grouped and reorganized and camps changed so they would mutually shift native registers; this has long been in effect."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Earlier troops were grouped and reorganized and camps changed so they would mutually shift native registers. This has long been in effect."

sentences.zh: ”而文寶確陳其利，因命錢若水詳度以聞。

translations.literal: Wenbao firmly stated the advantages and Qian Ruoshui was ordered to assess and report.
translations.idiomatic: Wenbao firmly stated the advantages and Qian Ruoshui was ordered to assess and report.

sentences.zh: 若水所對與沆等同，遂罷之。

translations.literal: Ruoshui's reply agreed with Hang and the others and the plan was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Ruoshui's reply agreed with Hang and the others and the plan was stopped.

sentences.zh: 先是，麟、府屯重兵，皆河東輸饋，雖地里甚邇，而限河津之阻。

translations.literal: Earlier, Lin and Fu stationed heavy troops all supplied from Hedong; though the distance was very close, the river crossing blocked the way.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Lin and Fu stationed heavy troops all supplied from Hedong. Though the distance was very close, the river crossing blocked the way.

sentences.zh: 土人利於河東民罕至，則芻粟增價。

translations.literal: Local people profited because Hedong people rarely came and fodder and grain prices rose.
translations.idiomatic: Local people profited because Hedong people rarely came and fodder and grain prices rose.

sentences.zh: 上嘗訪使邊者，言河才闊數十步，乃詔文寶於府州、定羌軍經度置浮橋，人以為便。

translations.literal: The emperor once asked border envoys who said the river was only several tens of paces wide; an edict ordered Wenbao to plan floating bridges at Fuzhou and Dingqiang Army; people considered it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once asked border envoys who said the river was only several tens of paces wide. An edict ordered Wenbao to plan floating bridges at Fuzhou and Dingqiang Army. People considered it convenient.

sentences.zh: 會繼遷圍麟州，令乘傳晨夜赴之，圍解，遷刑部員外郎，賜金紫。

translations.literal: When Jiqian besieged Lin Prefecture he was ordered to travel day and night by post relay; when the siege was lifted he was transferred to vice minister of justice and granted the gold and purple insignia.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Jiqian besieged Lin Prefecture he was ordered to travel day and night by post relay. When the siege was lifted he was transferred to vice minister of justice and granted the gold and purple insignia.

sentences.zh: 頃之，寇準薦其熟西事，可備驅策，因復任陝西轉運使。

translations.literal: Soon Kou Zhun recommended him as knowing western affairs and fit for driving use; he was again appointed Shaanxi transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Kou Zhun recommended him as knowing western affairs and fit for driving use. He was again appointed Shaanxi transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 嘗出手劄，密戒令邊事與僚屬計議，勿得過有須索，重擾於下。

translations.literal: He once handed out a personal note secretly warning that frontier affairs should be planned with staff and there must not be excessive demands heavily disturbing subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: He once handed out a personal note secretly warning that frontier affairs should be planned with staff and there must not be excessive demands heavily disturbing subordinates.

sentences.zh: 後有言其張皇者，詔徙京西，以朱台符代之。

translations.literal: Later when someone said he was alarmist, an edict transferred him to the Jingxi Circuit and Zhu Taifu replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Later when someone said he was alarmist, an edict transferred him to the Jingxi Circuit and Zhu Taifu replaced him.

sentences.zh: 文寶好談方略，以功名為己任。

translations.literal: Wenbao loved to discuss strategy and took merit and fame as his own task.
translations.idiomatic: Wenbao loved to discuss strategy and took merit and fame as his own task.

sentences.zh: 久在西邊，參預兵計，心有餘而識不足，又不護細行，所延薦屬吏至多，而未嘗擇也。

translations.literal: Long on the western frontier participating in military planning, he had will but insufficient insight and also did not guard minor conduct; those he recommended and appointed as staff were extremely numerous and he never selected them.
translations.idiomatic: Long on the western frontier participating in military planning, he had will but insufficient insight and also did not guard minor conduct. Those he recommended and appointed as staff were extremely numerous and he never selected them.

sentences.zh: 晚年病廢，從子為邑，多撓縣政。

translations.literal: In his later years illness disabled him; a nephew served as magistrate and often interfered in county government.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years illness disabled him. A nephew served as magistrate and often interfered in county government.

sentences.zh: 能為詩，善篆書，工鼓琴。

translations.literal: He could compose poetry, was skilled at seal script, and excelled at playing the zither.
translations.idiomatic: He could compose poetry, was skilled at seal script, and excelled at playing the zither.

sentences.zh: 有集二十卷，又撰《談苑》二十卷、《江表志》三卷。

translations.literal: He had a collection of twenty chapters and also compiled "Collected Conversations" in twenty chapters and "Records of the Jiang Region" in three chapters.
translations.idiomatic: He had a collection of twenty chapters and also compiled "Collected Conversations" in twenty chapters and "Records of the Jiang Region" in three chapters.

sentences.zh: 王子輿

translations.literal: Wang Ziyu
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ziyu

sentences.zh: 王子輿，字希孟，密州莒人。

translations.literal: Wang Ziyu, courtesy name Ximeng, was a man of Ju in Mizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ziyu, whose courtesy name was Ximeng, was a native of Ju in Mizhou.

sentences.zh: 曾祖甲，以義勇為鄉人所推。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Jia was pushed by the village for his righteousness and courage.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Jia was pushed by the village for his righteousness and courage.

sentences.zh: 唐末，淄、青、徐、兗皆南結吳人以拒梁，梁得三鎮，吳人北侵益急，沂、密尤被其害。

translations.literal: At the end of Tang, Zi, Qing, Xu, and Yan all allied south with Wu to resist Liang; when Liang gained the three garrisons Wu's northern raids grew ever fiercer and Yi and Mi were especially harmed.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Tang, Zi, Qing, Xu, and Yan all allied south with Wu to resist Liang. When Liang gained the three garrisons Wu's northern raids grew ever fiercer and Yi and Mi were especially harmed.

sentences.zh: 州民聚為八砦以扞寇，遂署甲為八砦都指揮使。

translations.literal: The people of the prefecture gathered into eight stockades to resist bandits and Jia was appointed commander of the eight stockades.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the prefecture gathered into eight stockades to resist bandits and Jia was appointed commander of the eight stockades.

sentences.zh: 祖徽，襲父職，晉末，賊帥趙重進掠高密，徽戰沒。

translations.literal: His grandfather Hui inherited his father's post; at the end of Later Jin the bandit chief Zhao Chongjin plundered Gaomi and Hui died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Hui inherited his father's post. At the end of Later Jin the bandit chief Zhao Chongjin plundered Gaomi and Hui died in battle.

sentences.zh: 父璉，復嗣其事。

translations.literal: His father Lian again succeeded to the affair.
translations.idiomatic: His father Lian again succeeded to the affair.

sentences.zh: 周世宗平淮南，始去兵即農，厚自封殖。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shizong pacified Huainan he first laid down arms and took up farming, amply enriching himself.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizong pacified Huainan he first laid down arms and took up farming, amply enriching himself.

sentences.zh: 子輿少業文詞，太平興國八年舉進士，解褐北海主簿。

translations.literal: Ziyu in youth pursued literary composition; in the eighth year of Taiping Xingguo he passed the jinshi examination and upon leaving office robes became chief clerk of Beihai.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyu in youth pursued literary composition. In the eighth year of Taiping Xingguo he passed the jinshi examination and upon entering official service became chief clerk of Beihai.

sentences.zh: 歷大理評事，知臨海縣，改光祿寺丞。

translations.literal: He served as assessor of the Court of Judicial Review and magistrate of Linhai County and was changed to director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: He served as assessor of the Court of Judicial Review and magistrate of Linhai County and was changed to director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 使西蜀決獄還，知興國軍。

translations.literal: Sent to western Shu to adjudicate cases and returning, he became prefect of Xingguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: Sent to western Shu to adjudicate cases and returning, he became prefect of Xingguo Army.

sentences.zh: 淳化中，雷有終為江、浙、荊湖茶鹽制置使，奏子輿為判官。

translations.literal: During Chunhua, Lei Youzhong was commissioner for Jiang, Zhe, and Jinghu tea and salt and memorialized Ziyu as administrative aide.
translations.idiomatic: During Chunhua, Lei Youzhong was commissioner for Jiang, Zhe, and Jinghu tea and salt and memorialized Ziyu as administrative aide.

sentences.zh: 轉太子中允，改著作郎，江、淮、兩浙制置茶鹽，就轉太常博士。

translations.literal: Transferred to attendant of the Heir Apparent, changed to secretary, and for Jiang, Huai, and the two Zhes tea and salt was transferred to doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to attendant of the Heir Apparent, changed to secretary, and for Jiang, Huai, and the two Zhes tea and salt was transferred to doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 真宗即位，遷殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong acceded he was transferred to palace censor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhenzong acceded he was transferred to palace censor.

sentences.zh: 因入對，與三司論列利害，以子輿為長。

translations.literal: Entering for audience he debated advantages and disadvantages with the Three Offices and Ziyu was regarded as superior.
translations.idiomatic: Entering for audience he debated advantages and disadvantages with the Three Offices and Ziyu was regarded as superior.

sentences.zh: 轉度支員外郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 子輿以每事上計司，移報稽滯，求兼省職，乃命為鹽鐵判官，仍領制置，增歲課五十餘萬貫。

translations.literal: Ziyu, because each affair was reported to the accounting office and replies were delayed, requested concurrent provincial office and was appointed salt and iron administrator while still heading the commission, increasing annual revenue by more than five hundred thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyu, because each affair was reported to the accounting office and replies were delayed, requested concurrent provincial office and was appointed salt and iron administrator while still heading the commission, increasing annual revenue by more than five hundred thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 咸平三年，就命兼充淮南轉運使。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianping he was appointed concurrently transport commissioner of Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianping he was appointed concurrently transport commissioner of Huainan.

sentences.zh: 子輿精於吏事，久掌茶鹽漕運，周知利害，裁量經製，公私便之。

translations.literal: Ziyu was expert in administrative affairs; long managing tea, salt, and canal transport he thoroughly knew advantages and disadvantages, measured and regulated institutions, and both public and private were served.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyu was expert in administrative affairs. Long managing tea, salt, and canal transport he thoroughly knew advantages and disadvantages, measured and regulated institutions, and both public and private were served.

sentences.zh: 所至郡縣，以公事申請者，文牒紛委，頃刻待報，子輿皆即決遣，曾無凝滯。

translations.literal: Wherever he reached prefectures and counties, when official business was submitted documents piled up awaiting reply within moments; Ziyu decided and dispatched them all at once without delay.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he reached prefectures and counties, when official business was submitted documents piled up awaiting reply within moments. Ziyu decided and dispatched them all at once without delay.

sentences.zh: 明年，表求代，詔許自擇。

translations.literal: The next year he memorialized requesting a replacement; an edict allowed him to choose his own.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he memorialized requesting a replacement. An edict allowed him to choose his own.

sentences.zh: 子輿以卞袞、劉師道名聞，即命袞與師道為轉運使。

translations.literal: Ziyu, because Bian Gun and Liu Shidao were known by name, immediately appointed Gun and Shidao as transport commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyu, because Bian Gun and Liu Shidao were known by name, immediately appointed Gun and Shidao as transport commissioners.

sentences.zh: 召子輿，拜右諫議大夫、戶部使。

translations.literal: Ziyu was summoned and appointed Right Remonstrance Councillor and commissioner of the Household Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyu was summoned and appointed Right Remonstrance Councillor and commissioner of the Household Bureau.

sentences.zh: 五年二月，方奏事便殿，俄疾作仆地，命中使掖之以出，至第卒。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year, while memorializing in the side hall he suddenly fell ill and collapsed; the emperor ordered inner attendants to support him out; he died at his residence.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifth year, while memorializing in the side hall he suddenly fell ill and collapsed. The emperor ordered inner attendants to support him out. He died at his residence.

sentences.zh: 以子道宗方幼，命三司判官朱台符檢校其家。

translations.literal: Because his son Daozong was still young, Three Offices administrator Zhu Taifu was ordered to inspect his household.
translations.idiomatic: Because his son Daozong was still young, Three Offices administrator Zhu Taifu was ordered to inspect his household.

sentences.zh: 子輿止一子，而三女皆幼。

translations.literal: Ziyu had only one son and three daughters all still young.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyu had only one son and three daughters all still young.

sentences.zh: 道宗尋卒，家寓楚州。

translations.literal: Daozong soon died; the family lodged in Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Daozong soon died. The family lodged in Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 子輿妻劉還父母家，子輿旅櫬在京師，景德中，官借船移柩，還葬其里，鬻京師居第，以錢寄楚州官庫，以備三女資送。

translations.literal: Ziyu's wife Liu returned to her parents' home; Ziyu's coffin sojourned in the capital; during Jingde officials lent a boat to move the bier and return it for burial in his village; the capital residence was sold and the money deposited in the Chuzhou official treasury to provide for the three daughters.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyu's wife Liu returned to her parents' home. Ziyu's coffin sojourned in the capital. During Jingde officials lent a boat to move the bier and return it for burial in his village. The capital residence was sold and the money deposited in the Chuzhou official treasury to provide for the three daughters.

sentences.zh: 從其從弟之請也。

translations.literal: This followed the request of his younger cousin.
translations.idiomatic: This followed the request of his younger cousin.

sentences.zh: 劉綜，字居正，河中虞鄉人。

translations.literal: Liu Zong, courtesy name Juzheng, was a man of Yuxiang in Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zong, whose courtesy name was Juzheng, was a native of Yuxiang in Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 少依外兄通遠軍使董遵誨，遵誨嘗遣貢馬。

translations.literal: In youth he relied on his maternal uncle Tongyuan Army commissioner Dong Zunhui; Zunhui once sent tribute horses.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he relied on his maternal uncle Tongyuan Army commissioner Dong Zunhui. Zunhui once sent tribute horses.

sentences.zh: 太祖嘉其敏辯，將授三班之職。

translations.literal: Taizu praised his quick eloquence and was about to grant third-rank office.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizu praised his quick eloquence and was about to grant third-rank office.

sentences.zh: 綜自陳素習詞業，願應科舉。

translations.literal: Zong himself stated he was accustomed to literary studies and wished to take the examination.
translations.idiomatic: Zong himself stated he was accustomed to literary studies and wished to take the examination.

sentences.zh: 及還，上解真珠盤龍衣以賜遵誨，綜辭曰：“遵誨人臣，安敢當此賜！

translations.literal: Upon return the emperor removed his pearl dragon robe to bestow on Zunhui; Zong declined, saying: "Zunhui is a subject—how dare he receive this gift!
translations.idiomatic: Upon return the emperor removed his pearl dragon robe to bestow on Zunhui. Zong declined, saying, "Zunhui is a subject—how dare he receive this gift!

sentences.zh: ”上曰：“吾委遵誨以方面，不以此為疑也。”

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "I entrust Zunhui with a frontier region and do not suspect him on this account."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "I entrust Zunhui with a frontier region and do not suspect him on this account."

sentences.zh: 雍熙二年，舉進士第，解褐邛州軍事推官。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongxi he passed the jinshi examination and upon leaving office robes became judicial officer of Qiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongxi he passed the jinshi examination and upon entering official service became judicial officer of Qiongzhou.

sentences.zh: 就改永康軍判官，遷大理評事、通判眉州，轉太僕寺丞。

translations.literal: He was changed in place to judge of Yongkang Army, transferred to assessor of the Court of Judicial Review and vice prefect of Meizhou, and transferred to director of the Court of Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed in place to judge of Yongkang Army, transferred to assessor of the Court of Judicial Review and vice prefect of Meizhou, and transferred to director of the Court of Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 代還，對便殿，因言：“蜀地富庶，安寧已久，益州長吏，望慎擇其人。

translations.literal: Upon replacement and return, answering at the side hall, he thereupon said: "Shu is rich and has long been at peace; the chief official of Yizhou—I hope he will be carefully chosen."
translations.idiomatic: Upon replacement and return, answering at the side hall, he thereupon said, "Shu is rich and has long been at peace. The chief official of Yizhou—I hope he will be carefully chosen."

sentences.zh: ”上嘉之，改太子中允。

translations.literal: The emperor commended this and changed him to attendant of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended this and changed him to attendant of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 未幾，李順果為亂，復召見，面賜緋魚。

translations.literal: Before long Li Shun indeed rebelled; he was again summoned and personally granted the red fish badge.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Li Shun indeed rebelled. He was again summoned and personally granted the red fish badge.

sentences.zh: 尋為三門發運司水陸轉運使，通判大名府。

translations.literal: Soon he became transport commissioner of the Three Gates Dispatch Office by land and water and vice prefect of Daming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became transport commissioner of the Three Gates Dispatch Office by land and water and vice prefect of Daming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 連丁家難，起知建安軍。

translations.literal: He successively mourned family deaths and was raised to prefect of Jian'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: He successively mourned family deaths and was raised to prefect of Jian'an Army.

sentences.zh: 先是，天長軍及揚州六合縣民輸賦非便，綜奏請降天長軍為縣，隸揚州，以六合縣隸建安軍，自是民力均濟。

translations.literal: Earlier Tianchang Army and Liuhe County of Yangzhou found tax delivery inconvenient; Zong memorialized requesting Tianchang Army be reduced to a county subordinate to Yangzhou and Liuhe County subordinated to Jian'an Army; from then on the people's labor was evenly balanced.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Tianchang Army and Liuhe County of Yangzhou found tax delivery inconvenient. Zong memorialized requesting Tianchang Army be reduced to a county subordinate to Yangzhou and Liuhe County subordinated to Jian'an Army. From then on the people's labor was evenly balanced.

sentences.zh: 時淮南轉運使王嗣宗兼發運事，規畫多迂滯。

translations.literal: At the time Huainan transport commissioner Wang Sizong concurrently managed dispatch affairs and his planning was often circuitous and sluggish.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Huainan transport commissioner Wang Sizong concurrently managed dispatch affairs and his planning was often circuitous and sluggish.

sentences.zh: 綜因上言請復置都大發運司，專幹其職。

translations.literal: Zong thereupon memorialized requesting restoration of the post of general dispatch commissioner to manage the duty exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: Zong thereupon memorialized requesting restoration of the post of general dispatch commissioner to manage the duty exclusively.

sentences.zh: 至道二年，遷太常丞，職事修舉，多稱薦之者。

translations.literal: In the second year of the Zhidao era he was transferred to director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; his duties were well performed and many recommended him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Zhidao era he was transferred to director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices. His duties were well performed and many recommended him.

sentences.zh: 咸平初，命代王欽若判三司都理欠憑由司，出為河北轉運副使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianping he was ordered to replace Wang Qinruo as administrator of the Three Offices General Debt Collection Office and sent out as vice transport commissioner of Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xianping he was ordered to replace Wang Qinruo as administrator of the Three Offices General Debt Collection Office and sent out as vice transport commissioner of Hebei.

sentences.zh: 嘗言：“州縣幕職官，以昏耄放罷者，其間有實廉謹之士，或幼累無托，或居止無定，全藉祿廩以濟朝夕，一旦停罷，則饑寒無依，以傷和氣。

translations.literal: He once said: "Prefectural and county staff officials dismissed for senility—in among them are truly honest and prudent men, or those with young burdens and no support, or unsettled residence, all relying on salary to manage from day to day; once stopped they have no refuge from hunger and cold, harming harmonious qi.
translations.idiomatic: He once said, "Prefectural and county staff officials dismissed for senility—in among them are truly honest and prudent men, or those with young burdens and no support, or unsettled residence, all relying on salary to manage from day to day. Once stopped they have no refuge from hunger and cold, harming harmonious qi.

sentences.zh: 望自今並除致仕官。

translations.literal: I hope from now all may be granted retired office."
translations.idiomatic: I hope from now all may be granted retired office."

sentences.zh: ”又言：“法官斷獄，皆引律令之文，以定輕重之罪，及其奏御，復云慮未得中，別取進止，殊非一成不變之道，且復煩於聖斷。

translations.literal: He also said: "When judges decide cases they all cite statutory text to fix lighter and heavier guilt; when reporting to the throne they again say they fear it is not quite right and separately seek further decision—this is truly not the way of one standard unchanged and again troubles the sage decision."
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "When judges decide cases they all cite statutory text to fix lighter and heavier guilt. When reporting to the throne they again say they fear it is not quite right and separately seek further decision—this is truly not the way of one standard unchanged and again troubles the sage decision."

sentences.zh: 望自今降旨約束，不得復然。

translations.literal: I hope from now edicts may constrain this and it may not happen again."
translations.idiomatic: I hope from now edicts may constrain this and it may not happen again."

sentences.zh: ”時河北承兵寇之後，民戶凋弊，吏部所銓幕職州縣官皆四方之人，不習風俗，且有懷土之思，以是政事多因循不舉。

translations.literal: At the time Hebei after military calamity had declining households; staff officials selected by the Ministry of Personnel were all men from distant places unfamiliar with local customs and many had longing for home; therefore government was often perfunctory and not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Hebei after military calamity had declining households. Staff officials selected by the Ministry of Personnel were all men from distant places unfamiliar with local customs and many had longing for home. Therefore government was often perfunctory and not carried out.

sentences.zh: 綜建議請自今並以河朔人充之，冀其安居，勤於職事。

translations.literal: Zong proposed that from now all be filled by men of the Hebei region so they would settle and diligently perform duties.
translations.idiomatic: Zong proposed that from now all be filled by men of the Hebei region so they would settle and diligently perform duties.

sentences.zh: 夏人擾西邊，環慶大屯士馬，詔徙綜為陝西轉運副使，轉太常博士。

translations.literal: When the Tangut people harassed the western border, Huan and Qing greatly stationed troops and horses; an edict transferred Zong to vice transport commissioner of Shaanxi and transferred him to doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tangut people harassed the western border, Huan and Qing greatly stationed troops and horses. An edict transferred Zong to vice transport commissioner of Shaanxi and transferred him to doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 時梁鼎議禁解鹽，官自貨鬻，乃命綜與杜承睿制置青白鹽事。

translations.literal: At the time Liang Ding proposed forbidding Jie salt and having the state sell it directly; Zong and Du Chengrui were ordered to manage green-white salt affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Liang Ding proposed forbidding Jie salt and having the state sell it directly. Zong and Du Chengrui were ordered to manage green-white salt affairs.

sentences.zh: 綜條上利害，力言非便，卒罷其事。

translations.literal: Zong itemized advantages and disadvantages and forcefully said it was not advantageous; in the end the affair was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Zong itemized advantages and disadvantages and forcefully said it was not advantageous. In the end the affair was stopped.

sentences.zh: 時靈州孤危，獻言者或請棄之，綜上言曰：“國家財力雄富，士卒精銳，而未能剪除凶孽者，誠以賞罰未行，而所任非其材故也。

translations.literal: At the time Lingzhou stood isolated and in peril; some who offered counsel asked to abandon it; Zong memorialized, saying: "The state's wealth and strength are abundant and soldiers elite, yet we cannot cut down the vicious enemy—truly because rewards and punishments are not applied and those appointed are not the right men.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Lingzhou stood isolated and in peril. Some who offered counsel asked to abandon it. Zong memorialized, saying, "The state's wealth and strength are abundant and soldiers elite, yet we cannot cut down the vicious enemy—truly because rewards and punishments are not applied and those appointed are not the right men.

sentences.zh: 今或輕從群議，欲棄靈川，是中賊之奸計矣。

translations.literal: Now if we lightly follow group opinion and wish to abandon Lingchuan, this is exactly the enemy's treacherous plan."
translations.idiomatic: Now if we lightly follow group opinion and wish to abandon Lingchuan, this is exactly the enemy's treacherous plan."

sentences.zh: 且靈州民淳土沃，為西陲巨屏，所宜固守，以為扞蔽。

translations.literal: Moreover the people of Lingzhou are simple and the soil fertile; it is a great screen of the western border and should be firmly held as a defensive barrier.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the people of Lingzhou are simple and the soil fertile. It is a great screen of the western border and should be firmly held as a defensive barrier.

sentences.zh: 然後於浦洛河建軍城，屯兵積糧為之應援，此暫勞永逸之勢也。

translations.literal: Then establish a garrison city at the Puluo River, station troops and accumulate grain as support—this is the advantage of temporary labor for lasting ease.
translations.idiomatic: Then establish a garrison city at the Puluo River, station troops and accumulate grain as support—this is the advantage of temporary labor for lasting ease.

sentences.zh: 況鎮戎軍與靈州相接，今若棄之，則原、渭等州益須設備，較其勞費十倍而多，則利害之理昭然可驗矣。

translations.literal: Moreover Zhenrong Army connects with Lingzhou; if it is now abandoned then Yuan, Wei, and other prefectures would need even more defense; comparing the labor and expense it would be more than tenfold—the principle of advantage and harm is clearly verified.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Zhenrong Army connects with Lingzhou. If it is now abandoned then Yuan, Wei, and other prefectures would need even more defense. Comparing the labor and expense it would be more than tenfold—the principle of advantage and harm is clearly verified.

sentences.zh: ”俄充轉運使。

translations.literal: Soon he served as transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he served as transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四年，又獻議於鎮戎軍置屯田務，又錄唐《安國鎮制置城壕鎮戎古記》石本以進，詔從其請。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he again offered a proposal to establish a military colony office at Zhenrong Army and also submitted a stone rubbing of the Tang "Record of An Guo Garrison Moat and Zhenrong Ancient Fort" and an edict followed his request.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he again offered a proposal to establish a military colony office at Zhenrong Army and also submitted a stone rubbing of the Tang "Record of An Guo Garrison Moat and Zhenrong Ancient Fort." An edict followed his request.

sentences.zh: 俄詣闕，奏事稱旨，賜金紫、緡錢五十萬，復遣蒞職。

translations.literal: Soon he went to court; his memorial pleased the emperor; he was granted gold and purple and fifty thousand strings of cash and again sent to his post.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he went to court. His memorial pleased the emperor. He was granted gold and purple and fifty thousand strings of cash and again sent to his post.

sentences.zh: 又嘗言：“天下州郡長吏，審官皆據資例而授，未為得人。

translations.literal: He also once said: "Prefects throughout the empire—the Ministry of Review all appoint by seniority and qualification and do not obtain the right men.
translations.idiomatic: He also once said, "Prefects throughout the empire—the Ministry of Review all appoint by seniority and qualification and do not obtain the right men.

sentences.zh: 自今西川、荊湖、江、浙、福建、廣南知州，或地居津要，或戶口繁庶之處，望親加選任。

translations.literal: From now for Sichuan, Jinghu, Jiang, Zhe, Fujian, and Guangnan prefects—or places at vital crossings or with numerous households—I hope they may be personally selected.
translations.idiomatic: From now for Sichuan, Jinghu, Jiang, Zhe, Fujian, and Guangnan prefects—or places at vital crossings or with numerous households—I hope they may be personally selected.

sentences.zh: 其執政舊臣及給、舍以上知州處，亦擇官通判。

translations.literal: For places where former chief ministers and remonstrance officials and above serve as prefect, vice prefects should also be carefully chosen.
translations.idiomatic: For places where former chief ministers and remonstrance officials and above serve as prefect, vice prefects should also be carefully chosen.

sentences.zh: 又京朝官當任遠官者，率以父母未葬為辭，意求規免。

translations.literal: Moreover when capital officials should take distant posts they mostly plead that parents are not yet buried, intending to seek exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover when capital officials should take distant posts they mostly plead that parents are not yet buried, intending to seek exemption.

sentences.zh: 請自今父母委未葬者，許請告營辦。

translations.literal: I ask that from now those whose parents are not yet buried may request leave to arrange burial.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that from now those whose parents are not yet buried may request leave to arrange burial.

sentences.zh: 審官投狀，並明言父母已葬，方許依例考課，違者並罷其官。

translations.literal: When submitting credentials to the Ministry of Review they must clearly state parents are already buried before routine evaluation is allowed; violators will all be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: When submitting credentials to the Ministry of Review they must clearly state parents are already buried before routine evaluation is allowed. Violators will all be dismissed."

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 五年，拜工部員外郎兼侍御史知雜事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed vice minister of works and concurrent supervising censor with mixed duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed vice minister of works and concurrent supervising censor with mixed duties.

sentences.zh: 六年，遷起居舍人，再為河北轉運使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was transferred to attendant of the palace secretariat and again became transport commissioner of Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was transferred to attendant of the palace secretariat and again became transport commissioner of Hebei.

sentences.zh: 時兩河用兵，邊事煩急，轉漕之任，尤所倚辦。

translations.literal: At the time the two He regions were at war and frontier affairs were urgent; the duty of canal transport was especially relied upon.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the two He regions were at war and frontier affairs were urgent. The duty of canal transport was especially relied upon.

sentences.zh: 綜繼領其職，號為詳練。

translations.literal: Zong successively held this post and was known as thorough and practiced.
translations.idiomatic: Zong successively held this post and was known as thorough and practiced.

sentences.zh: 至是眷矚甚厚，警急之際，輒資其奏處。

translations.literal: At this time imperial favor was very deep; in emergencies his memorials were constantly relied upon for disposition.
translations.idiomatic: At this time imperial favor was very deep. In emergencies his memorials were constantly relied upon for disposition.

sentences.zh: 契丹請和，乃遣近臣諭以擢用之意。

translations.literal: When the Khitans requested peace, a close minister was sent to explain the intent of promotion.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitans requested peace, a close minister was sent to explain the intent of promotion.

sentences.zh: 景德三年，召拜戶部員外郎、樞密直學士、勾當三班院。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingde he was summoned and appointed vice minister of revenue, academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and administrator of the Third Rank Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jingde he was summoned and appointed vice minister of revenue, academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and administrator of the Third Rank Bureau.

sentences.zh: 綜言：“御史員數至少，每奉朝請，劾制獄，多以他官承之，甚紊彝製。

translations.literal: Zong said: "Censor numbers are extremely few; each time attending court and impeaching and deciding cases, other officials mostly fill in—this greatly confuses proper institutions.
translations.idiomatic: Zong said, "Censor numbers are extremely few. Each time attending court and impeaching and deciding cases, other officials mostly fill in—this greatly confuses proper institutions.

sentences.zh: 望詔兩制以上各舉材堪御史者充，三院共置十員。

translations.literal: I hope an edict may order drafting officials and above each to recommend men fit to be censors, ten in all for the three bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: I hope an edict may order drafting officials and above each to recommend men fit to be censors, ten in all for the three bureaus.

sentences.zh: 若出使按獄，所經州郡，官吏能否，生民利病，刑獄枉濫，悉得察舉。

translations.literal: If sent on mission to investigate cases, in prefectures and commanderies passed through, officials' ability, people's benefit and harm, and wrongful imprisonment may all be investigated and reported.
translations.idiomatic: If sent on mission to investigate cases, in prefectures and commanderies passed through, officials' ability, people's benefit and harm, and wrongful imprisonment may all be investigated and reported."

sentences.zh: ”四年，西幸，道出河陽境上，時節度王顯被疾還京，以綜權知孟州事。

translations.literal: " In the fourth year, on the western tour passing through Heyang territory, when military commissioner Wang Xian was ill and returned to the capital, Zong was appointed acting prefect of Mengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fourth year, on the western tour passing through Heyang territory, when military commissioner Wang Xian was ill and returned to the capital, Zong was appointed acting prefect of Mengzhou.

sentences.zh: 未幾召還，復出知幷州，以政績聞。

translations.literal: Before long he was recalled and again sent out as prefect of Bingzhou, known for achievements in government.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was recalled and again sent out as prefect of Bingzhou, known for achievements in government.

sentences.zh: 州民乞留，優詔嘉獎。

translations.literal: The people of the prefecture begged he be retained; a gracious edict commended him.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the prefecture begged he be retained. A gracious edict commended him.

sentences.zh: 歸朝，知審官院，改吏、禮二部郎中，充職，兼知通進、銀臺、封駁司。

translations.literal: Returning to court he managed the Ministry of Review, was changed to director of the Ministries of Personnel and Rites, fulfilled duties, and concurrently managed the Memorial Clearance, Silver Pavilion, and Seal and Rebuttal offices.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to court he managed the Ministry of Review, was changed to director of the Ministries of Personnel and Rites, fulfilled duties, and concurrently managed the Memorial Clearance, Silver Pavilion, and Seal and Rebuttal offices.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符四年，館伴契丹使，因作《大雪歌》以獻。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Dazhong Xiangfu he hosted Khitan envoys and composed the "Song of Great Snow" to present.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Dazhong Xiangfu he hosted Khitan envoys and composed the "Song of Great Snow" to present.

sentences.zh: 即命同知貢舉，以李宗諤代為館伴使。

translations.literal: He was immediately ordered to jointly manage the examinations and Li Zong'e replaced him as hosting envoy.
translations.idiomatic: He was immediately ordered to jointly manage the examinations and Li Zong'e replaced him as hosting envoy.

sentences.zh: 俄權知開封府。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed acting prefect of Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed acting prefect of Kaifeng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 綜以貴要交結富民，為之請求，或托為親屬，奏授試秩，緣此謁見官司，頗紊公政，因建議請加抑止。

translations.literal: Zong associated with the wealthy for requests, or claimed them as relatives, memorializing trial ranks; thereby visiting offices and greatly disturbing public government; he therefore proposed increased restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Zong associated with the wealthy for requests, or claimed them as relatives, memorializing trial ranks. Thereby visiting offices he greatly disturbed public government. He therefore proposed increased restraint.

sentences.zh: 又文武官居遠任，而家屬寓京師，其子孫弟侄無賴者，望嚴行約束，並其交遊輩劾罪，從之。

translations.literal: Also when civil and military officials held distant posts and families lodged in the capital, their sons, brothers, and nephews who were unruly—I hope strict restraint and impeachment of their associates; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Also when civil and military officials held distant posts and families lodged in the capital, their sons, brothers, and nephews who were unruly—I hope strict restraint and impeachment of their associates. The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 七年，以老疾求典河中，真宗以太寧宮廟長吏奉祠，綜艱於拜起，慮不克恭事，命知廬州。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, on account of old age and illness he requested charge of Hezhong; Zhenzong because Taichong Palace temple chief officials performed sacrifice, and Zong found bowing difficult and feared he could not respectfully serve, ordered him prefect of Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on account of old age and illness he requested charge of Hezhong. Emperor Zhenzong, because Taichong Palace temple chief officials performed sacrifice and Zong found bowing difficult and feared he could not respectfully serve, ordered him prefect of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 明年，罷學士，授右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: The next year he was removed as academician and granted Right Remonstrance Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was removed as academician and granted Right Remonstrance Councillor.

sentences.zh: 八年卒，年六十一。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he died, aged sixty-one.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he died, aged sixty-one.

sentences.zh: 綜強敏有吏材，所至抑挫豪右，振舉文法，時稱幹治。

translations.literal: Zong was forceful, sharp, and had administrative talent; wherever he went he suppressed powerful families and raised legal standards; contemporaries called him capable in governance.
translations.idiomatic: Zong was forceful, sharp, and had administrative talent. Wherever he went he suppressed powerful families and raised legal standards. Contemporaries called him capable in governance.

sentences.zh: 然尚氣好勝，不為物論所許。

translations.literal: Yet he valued spirit and loved victory and was not approved by public opinion.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he valued spirit and loved victory and was not approved by public opinion.

sentences.zh: 子建中、正中，並讚善大夫。

translations.literal: His sons Jianzhong and Zhengzhong both served as Supporters-in-Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Jianzhong and Zhengzhong both served as Supporters-in-Attendance.

sentences.zh: 弟綽，淳化三年進士，官刑部郎中。

translations.literal: His younger brother Chuo passed the jinshi in the third year of Chunhua and served as director of the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Chuo passed the jinshi in the third year of Chunhua and served as director of the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 卞袞，字垂象，益州成都人。

translations.literal: Bian Gun, courtesy name Chuixiang, was a man of Chengdu in Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bian Gun, whose courtesy name was Chuixiang, was a native of Chengdu in Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 父震，工為詩。

translations.literal: His father Zhen was skilled at composing poetry.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zhen was skilled at composing poetry.

sentences.zh: 舉蜀進士，渝州刺史南光海辟為判官。

translations.literal: Passing the Shu jinshi examination, Yu Prefecture prefect Nan Guanghai engaged him as administrative aide.
translations.idiomatic: Passing the Shu jinshi examination, Yu Prefecture prefect Nan Guanghai engaged him as administrative aide.

sentences.zh: 蜀平，仍舊職。

translations.literal: When Shu was pacified he retained his former post.
translations.idiomatic: When Shu was pacified he retained his former post.

sentences.zh: 會賊杜承褒率眾圍城，援兵不至，震躬率士卒，且戰且拒，為流矢所中，創甚，不能臨軍。

translations.literal: When the bandit Du Chengbao led masses to besiege the city and relief did not arrive, Zhen personally led soldiers fighting and resisting; struck by a stray arrow his wound was severe and he could not command the army.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandit Du Chengbao led masses to besiege the city and relief did not arrive, Zhen personally led soldiers fighting and resisting. Struck by a stray arrow his wound was severe and he could not command the army.

sentences.zh: 而州兵重傷，卷甲宵遁，刺史陳文襲不能遏，賊遂入據郡城，以偽官厚賄誘震，震皆斬其使。

translations.literal: Prefectural troops were heavily wounded, rolled armor and fled by night; prefect Chen Wenxi could not stop them; the bandits entered and occupied the commandery city; with false office and rich bribes they tempted Zhen and Zhen beheaded their envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural troops were heavily wounded, rolled armor and fled by night. Prefect Chen Wenxi could not stop them. The bandits entered and occupied the commandery city. With false office and rich bribes they tempted Zhen and Zhen beheaded their envoys.

sentences.zh: 賊有東章者，本州兵校也。

translations.literal: Among the bandits was one Dong Zhang, originally a prefectural military officer.
translations.idiomatic: Among the bandits was one Dong Zhang, originally a prefectural military officer.

sentences.zh: 因遣人述朝廷威德，諭以禍福，章懼且信，因伏兵擊其黨類。

translations.literal: He therefore sent men to explain the court's authority and virtue and instruct on fortune and calamity; Zhang feared and believed, set an ambush and struck their faction.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore sent men to explain the court's authority and virtue and instruct on fortune and calamity. Zhang feared and believed, set an ambush and struck their faction.

sentences.zh: 承褒之眾素不為備，即時大潰，震與文襲分部餘卒夾攻之，賊眾遂平。

translations.literal: Chengbao's masses were never prepared and immediately routed in great disorder; Zhen and Wenxi divided remaining troops and attacked from both sides; the bandit masses were then pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Chengbao's masses were never prepared and immediately routed in great disorder. Zhen and Wenxi divided remaining troops and attacked from both sides. The bandit masses were then pacified.

sentences.zh: 文襲坐陷失州城，削籍為民。

translations.literal: Wenxi was punished for losing the commandery city and stripped of register to become a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Wenxi was punished for losing the commandery city and stripped of register to become a commoner.

sentences.zh: 震以前功得贖，以虢州錄事參軍卒。

translations.literal: Zhen redeemed himself for earlier merit and died as registrar of Guozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen redeemed himself for earlier merit and died as registrar of Guozhou.

sentences.zh: 太平興國八年，袞登進士第，累遷大理評事、知將樂縣，改光祿寺丞、通判泗州。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Taiping Xingguo Gun passed the jinshi examination; he was promoted to assessor of the Court of Judicial Review and magistrate of Jiangle County, changed to director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and vice prefect of Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Taiping Xingguo Gun passed the jinshi examination. He was promoted to assessor of the Court of Judicial Review and magistrate of Jiangle County, changed to director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and vice prefect of Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 遷著作佐郎、廣南轉運司承受公事，俄通判宣州。

translations.literal: Transferred to assistant secretary of the Palace Library and receiver of official business for the Guangnan transport commission; soon vice prefect of Xuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to assistant secretary of the Palace Library and receiver of official business for the Guangnan transport commission. Soon vice prefect of Xuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 淳化中，上命采庶僚中廉幹者，給御書印紙，俾書課最，仍賜實奉以旌異之，袞預焉。

translations.literal: During Chunhua the emperor ordered selection of incorrupt and capable among various officials, granting imperial calligraphy seal paper to record merit evaluations and still bestowing solid salary to mark distinction; Gun was among them.
translations.idiomatic: During Chunhua the emperor ordered selection of incorrupt and capable among various officials, granting imperial calligraphy seal paper to record merit evaluations and still bestowing solid salary to mark distinction. Gun was among them.

sentences.zh: 改太常丞。

translations.literal: Changed to director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Changed to director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 咸平初，遷監察御史，為淮南轉運副使、同荊湖發運使，以幹職聞，就加殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianping he was transferred to investigating censor, vice transport commissioner of Huainan and concurrent Jinghu dispatch commissioner; known for competent service he was promoted to palace censor.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xianping he was transferred to investigating censor, vice transport commissioner of Huainan and concurrent Jinghu dispatch commissioner. Known for competent service he was promoted to palace censor.

sentences.zh: 入判三司開拆司，再為淮南轉運使兼發運使。

translations.literal: He entered to administer the Three Offices Opening and Inspection Bureau and again became Huainan transport commissioner concurrently dispatch commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He entered to administer the Three Offices Opening and Inspection Bureau and again became Huainan transport commissioner concurrently dispatch commissioner.

sentences.zh: 咸平六年，並三司使之職而分置副貳，以袞為刑部員外郎，充鹽鐵副使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xianping the three commissioner posts were merged and deputies separately established; Gun was made vice minister of justice and salt and iron vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Xianping the three commissioner posts were merged and deputies separately established. Gun was made vice minister of justice and salt and iron vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 景德初，疽發於背卒，年四十五。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jingde an abscess broke out on his back and he died, aged forty-five.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jingde an abscess broke out on his back and he died, aged forty-five.

sentences.zh: 錄其弟扆為臨潁主簿，子鹹為將作監主簿。

translations.literal: His younger brother Yi was granted chief clerk of Linying; his son Xian was granted chief clerk of the Directorate of Imperial Manufactories.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Yi was granted chief clerk of Linying. His son Xian was granted chief clerk of the Directorate of Imperial Manufactories.

sentences.zh: 袞明敏有吏幹，累掌財賦，清心治局，號為稱職。

translations.literal: Gun was bright and sharp with administrative talent; repeatedly managing finances he cleared his heart and governed the office and was called competent.
translations.idiomatic: Gun was bright and sharp with administrative talent. Repeatedly managing finances he cleared his heart and governed the office and was called competent.

sentences.zh: 然性慘毒，掊克嚴峻，專事捶楚，至有‘大蟲’之號。

translations.literal: Yet by nature he was cruel and poisonous, extortion severe, specializing in beating and flogging, even gaining the name 'Great Worm.'
