translations.idiomatic: Yet by nature he was cruel and poisonous, extortion severe, specializing in beating and flogging, even gaining the name 'Great Worm.'

sentences.zh: 真宗嘗謂近臣曰：“袞公忠盡瘁，無所畏避，人罕能及，然頃在外任，頗傷殘酷，所至州縣，纖微之過，無所容貸。

translations.literal: Zhenzong once told close ministers: "Gun is loyal and exhausts himself, fearing nothing—few can match him; yet recently in external posts he was quite injurious and cruel; in prefectures and counties reached, the slightest fault found no pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhenzong once told close ministers, "Gun is loyal and exhausts himself, fearing nothing—few can match him. Yet recently in external posts he was quite injurious and cruel. In prefectures and counties reached, the slightest fault found no pardon.

sentences.zh: 大凡督察部下，糾逖愆違，非有大故，所宜矜恕，官吏自當畏威懷恩，不敢貳過，公家之事亦無不濟。

translations.literal: Generally in supervising subordinates and correcting faults and violations, unless there is great cause one should show forbearance; officials naturally will fear authority and cherish grace and not dare repeat faults; public affairs also will all succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Generally in supervising subordinates and correcting faults and violations, unless there is great cause one should show forbearance. Officials naturally will fear authority and cherish grace and not dare repeat faults. Public affairs also will all succeed.

sentences.zh: 乃知為吏之方，適中為善也。”

translations.literal: Thus one knows the way of being an official—the mean is good.
translations.idiomatic: Thus one knows the way of being an official—the mean is good.

sentences.zh: 許驤，字允升，世家薊州。

translations.literal: Xu Xiang, courtesy name Yunsheng, was a family of Ji Prefecture for generations.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Xiang, whose courtesy name was Yunsheng, was a family of Ji Prefecture for generations.

sentences.zh: 祖信，父唐，世以財雄邊郡。

translations.literal: His grandfather Xin; his father Tang—for generations used wealth to dominate the frontier commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Xin. His father Tang—for generations used wealth to dominate the frontier commanderies.

sentences.zh: 後唐之季，唐知契丹將擾邊，白其父曰：“今國政廢弛，狄人必乘釁而動，則朔、易之地，民罹其災。

translations.literal: At the end of Later Tang, Tang knew the Khitans would disturb the border and told his father: "Now state government is lax and the barbarians will surely seize the opportunity to move; then the people of Shuo and Yi lands will suffer disaster.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Later Tang, Tang knew the Khitans would disturb the border and told his father, "Now state government is lax and the barbarians will surely seize the opportunity to move. Then the people of Shuo and Yi lands will suffer disaster.

sentences.zh: 苟不即去，且為所虜矣。

translations.literal: If we do not leave at once we will be captured by them.
translations.idiomatic: If we do not leave at once we will be captured by them.

sentences.zh: ”信以資產富殖，不樂他徙，唐遂潛齎百金而南。

translations.literal: " Xin, because assets were rich and flourishing, was unwilling to move elsewhere; Tang therefore secretly carried a hundred in gold south.
translations.idiomatic: Xin, because assets were rich and flourishing, was unwilling to move elsewhere. Tang therefore secretly carried a hundred in gold south.

sentences.zh: 未幾，晉祖革命，果以燕、薊賂契丹，唐歸路遂絕。

translations.literal: Before long Emperor Gaozu of Jin revolutionized the state; indeed Yan and Ji were ceded to the Khitans and Tang's route home was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Emperor Gaozu of Jin revolutionized the state. Indeed Yan and Ji were ceded to the Khitans and Tang's route home was cut off.

sentences.zh: 嘗擁商貲於汴、洛間，見進士綴行而出，竊歎曰：“生子當令如此！

translations.literal: He once carried merchant goods between Bian and Luo; seeing jinshi walking in file he sighed secretly: "To have a son like this!
translations.idiomatic: He once carried merchant goods between Bian and Luo. Seeing jinshi walking in file he sighed secretly, "To have a son like this!

sentences.zh: ”因不復行賈，卜居睢陽，娶李氏女，生驤，風骨秀異。

translations.literal: " He therefore no longer traveled as merchant, settled in Suiyang, married Lady Li, and begat Xiang with elegant bearing.
translations.idiomatic: " He therefore no longer traveled as merchant, settled in Suiyang, married Lady Li, and begat Xiang with elegant bearing.

sentences.zh: 唐曰：“ 成吾志矣！”

translations.literal: Tang said: "My ambition is fulfilled!
translations.idiomatic: Tang said, "My ambition is fulfilled!

sentences.zh: 郡人戚同文以經術聚徒，唐攜驤詣之，且曰：“唐，頃者不辭父母，死有餘恨，今拜先生，即吾父矣。

translations.literal: Fellow townsman Qi Tongwen gathered disciples by classical learning; Tang took Xiang to him and said: "Tang, earlier not taking leave of parents, dies with remaining regret; now bowing to the master, he is my father.
translations.idiomatic: Fellow townsman Qi Tongwen gathered disciples by classical learning. Tang took Xiang to him and said, "Tang, earlier not taking leave of parents, dies with remaining regret. Now bowing to the master, he is my father.

sentences.zh: 又自念不學，思教子以興宗緒，此子雖幼，願先生成之。

translations.literal: Also thinking himself unlearned, he wished to teach his son to revive the clan line; though this child is young, I hope the master will complete him."
translations.idiomatic: Also thinking himself unlearned, he wished to teach his son to revive the clan line. Though this child is young, I hope the master will complete him."

sentences.zh: ”驤十三，能屬文，善詞賦。

translations.literal: At thirteen Xiang could compose prose and was skilled at rhapsodies.
translations.idiomatic: At thirteen Xiang could compose prose and was skilled at rhapsodies.

sentences.zh: 唐不識字，而罄家產為驤交當時秀彥。

translations.literal: Tang could not read characters yet exhausted family property to introduce Xiang to contemporary outstanding men.
translations.idiomatic: Tang could not read characters yet exhausted family property to introduce Xiang to contemporary outstanding men.

sentences.zh: 驤太平興國初詣貢部，與呂蒙正齊名，太宗尹京，頗知之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taiping Xingguo Xiang went to the tribute department and was equally famous with Lü Mengzheng; Taizong as capital intendant knew him quite well.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taiping Xingguo Xiang went to the tribute department and was equally famous with Lü Mengzheng. Emperor Taizong as capital intendant knew him quite well.

sentences.zh: 及廷試，擢甲科，解褐將作監丞、通判益州，賜錢二十萬。

translations.literal: At the palace examination he was elevated to first rank; upon leaving office robes he became director of the Directorate of Imperial Manufactories and vice prefect of Yizhou, granted two hundred thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: At the palace examination he was elevated to first rank. Upon entering official service he became director of the Directorate of Imperial Manufactories and vice prefect of Yizhou, granted two hundred thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 遷右讚善大夫。

translations.literal: Transferred to Right Supporter-in-Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Right Supporter-in-Attendance.

sentences.zh: 五年，轉右拾遺、直史館，改右補闕。

translations.literal: In the fifth year transferred to Right Collector of Lost Writings and compiler of the Historiography Institute; changed to Right Supplementation Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year transferred to Right Collector of Lost Writings and compiler of the Historiography Institute. Changed to Right Supplementation Censor.

sentences.zh: 六年，出為陝府西北路轉運副使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year sent out as vice transport commissioner of the Shaanfu Northwest Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year sent out as vice transport commissioner of the Shaanfu Northwest Circuit.

sentences.zh: 會罷副使，徙知鄜州。

translations.literal: When the vice commissioner post was abolished he was transferred to prefect of Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the vice commissioner post was abolished he was transferred to prefect of Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 召還，為比部員外郎。

translations.literal: Recalled, he became vice minister of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled, he became vice minister of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 歷知宣、升二州。

translations.literal: He served successively as prefect of Xuan and Sheng prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as prefect of Xuan and Sheng prefectures.

sentences.zh: 雍熙二年，改江南轉運副使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongxi he was changed to vice transport commissioner of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongxi he was changed to vice transport commissioner of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 洪、吉上供運船水損物，主吏懼罪，故覆舟，鞫獄者按以欺盜，當流死者數百人。

translations.literal: Hong and Ji tribute transport ships suffered water damage to goods; the chief clerk feared guilt and therefore capsized the boats; investigators judged it fraud and theft and several hundred were sentenced to exile or death.
translations.idiomatic: Hong and Ji tribute transport ships suffered water damage to goods. The chief clerk feared guilt and therefore capsized the boats. Investigators judged it fraud and theft and several hundred were sentenced to exile or death.

sentences.zh: 驤馳往訊問，得其情實以聞，多獲輕典，優詔褒之。

translations.literal: Xiang rushed to inquire, learned the true circumstances and reported; many received lighter sentences; a gracious edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang rushed to inquire, learned the true circumstances and reported. Many received lighter sentences. A gracious edict praised him.

sentences.zh: 又上言：“劫盜配流，遇赦得原，還本鄉，讎告捕者，多所殺害，自今請以隸軍。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Robbers sentenced to exile, when amnestied are restored and return to their home villages and often kill those who captured them; from now I ask they be assigned to the army."
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized, "Robbers sentenced to exile, when amnestied are restored and return to their home villages and often kill those who captured them. From now I ask they be assigned to the army."

sentences.zh: ”詔可。

translations.literal: An edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved.

sentences.zh: 遷正使。

translations.literal: Transferred to chief commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to chief commissioner.

sentences.zh: 端拱初，拜主客郎中，俄徙知福州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Duangong appointed director of the Ministry of Guest Affairs; soon transferred to prefect of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Duangong appointed director of the Ministry of Guest Affairs. Soon transferred to prefect of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 累表求還，不俟報，入朝，召對便殿，延問良久。

translations.literal: Repeatedly memorializing to return, not waiting for reply he entered court; summoned to answer at the side hall and questioned at length.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly memorializing to return, not waiting for reply he entered court. Summoned to answer at the side hall and questioned at length.

sentences.zh: 改兵部郎中，領西川轉運使，以久處外任為辭，擢授右諫議大夫，就命知益州。

translations.literal: Changed to director of the Ministry of War, heading western Sichuan transport; pleading long service in external posts he was elevated to Right Remonstrance Councillor and immediately appointed prefect of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Changed to director of the Ministry of War, heading western Sichuan transport. Pleading long service in external posts he was elevated to Right Remonstrance Councillor and immediately appointed prefect of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 召歸，上言：“蜀民浮窳易搖，宜擇忠厚者撫之，為預備。

translations.literal: Recalled, he memorialized: "Shu people are floating, lazy, and easily shaken; trustworthy and honest men should be chosen to pacify them as preparation."
translations.idiomatic: Recalled, he memorialized, "Shu people are floating, lazy, and easily shaken. Trustworthy and honest men should be chosen to pacify them as preparation."

sentences.zh: ”既而李順叛，眾頗伏其先見。

translations.literal: Soon Li Shun rebelled and many submitted to his foresight.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Li Shun rebelled and many submitted to his foresight.

sentences.zh: 命知審官院，遷御史中丞，以疾固讓，不許。

translations.literal: Ordered to manage the Ministry of Review; transferred to Vice Censor-in-Chief; on account of illness he firmly declined and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to manage the Ministry of Review. Transferred to Vice Censor-in-Chief. On account of illness he firmly declined and was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 占謝日，命坐勞問，出良藥賜之曰：“此朕所服得驗者。

translations.literal: On the day of thanksgiving at audience he was ordered to sit and asked after his health; good medicine was produced and bestowed with the words: "This is what I have taken with effect."
translations.idiomatic: On the day of thanksgiving at audience he was ordered to sit and asked after his health. Good medicine was produced and bestowed with the words, "This is what I have taken with effect."

sentences.zh: ”後驤以久病不能振職。

translations.literal: Later Xiang because of long illness could not perform duties vigorously.
translations.idiomatic: Later Xiang because of long illness could not perform duties vigorously.

sentences.zh: 真宗即位，改兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong acceded he was changed to vice minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhenzong acceded he was changed to vice minister of war.

sentences.zh: 屢求小郡養疾，因入朝失儀，為御史所糾，特詔不問，命知單州。

translations.literal: Repeatedly requesting a small prefecture to nurse illness; because of impropriety at court audience he was impeached by censors; a special edict ordered no inquiry and he was appointed prefect of Danzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly requesting a small prefecture to nurse illness. Because of impropriety at court audience he was impeached by censors. A special edict ordered no inquiry and he was appointed prefect of Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 咸平二年卒，年五十七。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianping he died, aged fifty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianping he died, aged fifty-seven.

sentences.zh: 贈工部尚書。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously granted Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 賜其子宗壽出身。

translations.literal: His son Zongshou was granted entry into office.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zongshou was granted entry into office.

sentences.zh: 驤雖無他才略，而人以儒厚長者稱之。

translations.literal: Though Xiang had no other talent or strategy, people called him a Confucian, generous elder.
translations.idiomatic: Though Xiang had no other talent or strategy, people called him a Confucian, generous elder.

sentences.zh: 宗壽後為殿中丞。

translations.literal: Zongshou later served as palace secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Zongshou later served as palace secretary.

sentences.zh: 裴莊，字端己，閬州閬中人。

translations.literal: Pei Zhuang, courtesy name Duanji, was a man of Langzhong in Lang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Zhuang, whose courtesy name was Duanji, was a native of Langzhong in Lang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 曾祖琛，後唐昭州刺史。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Chen was Later Tang prefect of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Chen was Later Tang prefect of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 祖遠，河東觀察支使。

translations.literal: His grandfather Yuan was staff officer of the Hedong Observation Commission.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yuan was staff officer of the Hedong Observation Commission.

sentences.zh: 父全福，鄠縣令。

translations.literal: His father Quanfu was magistrate of E County.
translations.idiomatic: His father Quanfu was magistrate of E County.

sentences.zh: 莊在蜀，以明經登第。

translations.literal: Zhuang in Shu passed the mingjing examination.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuang in Shu passed the mingjing examination.

sentences.zh: 歸宋，歷虹縣尉、高陵主簿，本府召權司理掾。

translations.literal: Entering Song he served as magistrate of Hong County and chief clerk of Gaoling; the prefecture summoned him as acting judicial administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Entering Song he served as magistrate of Hong County and chief clerk of Gaoling. The prefecture summoned him as acting judicial administrator.

sentences.zh: 轉運使雷德驤以威望自任，嘗巡按至境，官屬皆出迎候。

translations.literal: Transport commissioner Lei Dexuan relied on his prestige; once on inspection reaching the territory all officials went out to welcome.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissioner Lei Dexuan relied on his prestige. Once on inspection reaching the territory all officials went out to welcome.

sentences.zh: 莊獨視事本局，徐謁道周，德驤稱其有守。

translations.literal: Zhuang alone handled affairs at his bureau and slowly paid respects by the roadside; Dexuan praised his self-restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuang alone handled affairs at his bureau and slowly paid respects by the roadside. Dexuan praised his self-restraint.

sentences.zh: 徙權忻州錄事參軍。

translations.literal: Transferred to acting registrar of Xin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to acting registrar of Xin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 先是，并州侍積軍儲，條制甚峻，掌出納者常十餘人，及莊代之，獨任其事。

translations.literal: Earlier, Bingzhou garrison accumulated military stores with very strict regulations; those managing receipts and disbursements were often more than ten men; when Zhuang replaced them he alone handled the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Bingzhou garrison accumulated military stores with very strict regulations. Those managing receipts and disbursements were often more than ten men. When Zhuang replaced them he alone handled the affair.

sentences.zh: 擢授絳州防禦推官，提點並、嵐二州緡帛芻糧，改遼州判官，仍蒞舊局

translations.literal: Promoted to defense judicial officer of Jiang Prefecture, supervising silk, cloth, fodder, and grain of Bing and Lan prefectures; changed to judge of Liao Prefecture while still managing the former office.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to defense judicial officer of Jiang Prefecture, supervising silk, cloth, fodder, and grain of Bing and Lan prefectures. Changed to judge of Liao Prefecture while still managing the former office.

sentences.zh: 雍熙三年，命將巡邊，以莊掌隨軍糧料。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongxi, when generals toured the border, Zhuang was appointed to manage accompanying army provisions.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongxi, when generals toured the border, Zhuang was appointed to manage accompanying army provisions.

sentences.zh: 內客省使楊守一稱薦之，授大理寺丞。

translations.literal: Inner Palace Attendant Yang Shouyi recommended him and he was appointed assessor of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Palace Attendant Yang Shouyi recommended him and he was appointed assessor of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 時遷雲、朔降戶於汝、洛，遣莊安輯之。

translations.literal: At the time surrendered households of Yun and Shuo were relocated to Ru and Luo; Zhuang was sent to settle them.
translations.idiomatic: At the time surrendered households of Yun and Shuo were relocated to Ru and Luo. Zhuang was sent to settle them.

sentences.zh: 俄通判忻州，未上道，會魏咸信出鎮澶州，改命為通判。

translations.literal: Soon vice prefect of Xin Prefecture; before departing, when Wei Xianxin went out to garrison Cizhou the appointment was changed to vice prefect there.
translations.idiomatic: Soon vice prefect of Xin Prefecture. Before departing, when Wei Xianxin went out to garrison Cizhou the appointment was changed to vice prefect there.

sentences.zh: 未逾年，咸信表其能，遷太子中允。

translations.literal: Within the year Xianxin memorialized his ability and he was transferred to attendant of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Within the year Xianxin memorialized his ability and he was transferred to attendant of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 端拱初，潘美鎮真定，又辟為通判。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Duangong Pan Mei garrisoned Zhending and again engaged him as vice prefect.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Duangong Pan Mei garrisoned Zhending and again engaged him as vice prefect.

sentences.zh: 時契丹掠趙、深，邊將無功，莊上書以為“周世宗誅樊愛能、何徽二將，遂取淮南，克巴蜀。

translations.literal: At the time the Khitans plundered Zhao and Shen and frontier generals achieved nothing; Zhuang memorialized, saying: "Emperor Shizong of Zhou executed generals Fan Aineng and He Hui and then took Huainan and conquered Ba-Shu.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Khitans plundered Zhao and Shen and frontier generals achieved nothing. Zhuang memorialized, saying, "Emperor Shizong of Zhou executed generals Fan Aineng and He Hui and then took Huainan and conquered Ba-Shu.

sentences.zh: 願陛下申明紀律，無使玩寇。

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will clarify discipline and not let troops treat the enemy lightly.
translations.idiomatic: I hope Your Majesty will clarify discipline and not let troops treat the enemy lightly.

sentences.zh: ”又言：“緣邊砦柵戍兵既寡，戎人易以襲取，咸請廢罷，以益州兵。

translations.literal: " He also said: "Frontier stockade garrison troops are already few and barbarians easily take them; all request abolition to augment Yizhou troops."
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Frontier stockade garrison troops are already few and barbarians easily take them. All request abolition to augment Yizhou troops."

sentences.zh: ”會詔建方田，莊復上言：“大役兵師，慮生事於邊鄙。

translations.literal: When an edict established equal fields Zhuang again memorialized: "Great mobilization of troops—I fear trouble will arise on the frontier."
translations.idiomatic: When an edict established equal fields Zhuang again memorialized, "Great mobilization of troops—I fear trouble will arise on the frontier."

sentences.zh: ”上善之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 淳化三年，召訪以邊事，稱旨，面賜緋魚，令授清資官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chunhua summoned to consult on frontier affairs; pleasing the emperor he was personally granted the red fish badge and ordered granted a clear-rank office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chunhua summoned to consult on frontier affairs. Pleasing the emperor he was personally granted the red fish badge and ordered granted a clear-rank office.

sentences.zh: 翌日，拜監察御史、荊湖南路轉運使。

translations.literal: The next day appointed investigating censor and transport commissioner of the Jinghu South Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The next day appointed investigating censor and transport commissioner of the Jinghu South Circuit.

sentences.zh: 未行，改三司鹽鐵判官。

translations.literal: Before departing changed to salt and iron administrator of the Three Offices.
translations.idiomatic: Before departing changed to salt and iron administrator of the Three Offices.

sentences.zh: 上疏請給兩省官諫紙，又引故事，禁屠月勿報重刑。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting remonstrance paper for officials of the two provinces and also cited precedent forbidding heavy punishments in the slaughter month.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized requesting remonstrance paper for officials of the two provinces and also cited precedent forbidding heavy punishments in the slaughter month.

sentences.zh: 會劉式建議請廢緣江榷務，莊力言其非便。

translations.literal: When Liu Shi proposed abolishing river-bank monopoly offices Zhuang forcefully said it was not advantageous.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Shi proposed abolishing river-bank monopoly offices Zhuang forcefully said it was not advantageous.

sentences.zh: 出為荊湖北路轉運使。

translations.literal: Sent out as transport commissioner of the Jinghu North Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Sent out as transport commissioner of the Jinghu North Circuit.

sentences.zh: 五年，李順亂蜀，命與雷有終並兼峽路隨軍轉運、同知兵馬事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year when Li Shun rebelled in Shu he was ordered together with Lei Youzhong to concurrently serve as accompanying army transport commissioner of the Gorges route and jointly manage military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year when Li Shun rebelled in Shu he was ordered together with Lei Youzhong to concurrently serve as accompanying army transport commissioner of the Gorges route and jointly manage military affairs.

sentences.zh: 或言莊本蜀人，不宜此任，上益倚信之，許以便宜。

translations.literal: Some said Zhuang was originally a man of Shu and unsuited to this post; the emperor trusted him all the more and permitted expedient action.
translations.idiomatic: Some said Zhuang was originally a man of Shu and unsuited to this post. The emperor trusted him all the more and permitted expedient action.

sentences.zh: 事平，轉殿中侍御史，歷工部、司封二員外郎，特召問討賊方略。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled he was transferred to palace censor, served successively as vice minister of works and director of the Ministry of Seals, and was specially summoned to ask strategy for suppressing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled he was transferred to palace censor, served successively as vice minister of works and director of the Ministry of Seals, and was specially summoned to ask strategy for suppressing bandits.

sentences.zh: 咸平二年，命巡撫江南。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianping ordered to pacify Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianping ordered to pacify Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 使還，言池州、興國軍得良吏，餘無足稱者。

translations.literal: Returning from mission he said Chizhou and Xingguo Army had good officials; the rest were not worth mentioning.
translations.idiomatic: Returning from mission he said Chizhou and Xingguo Army had good officials. The rest were not worth mentioning.

sentences.zh: 且言：“朝廷所命知州、通判，率以資考而授，至有因循偷安，無政術而繼得親民者。

translations.literal: He also said: "Prefects and vice prefects appointed by the court are mostly granted by seniority and qualification; some are perfunctory and complacent without governing skill yet succeed in governing the people.
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Prefects and vice prefects appointed by the court are mostly granted by seniority and qualification. Some are perfunctory and complacent without governing skill yet succeed in governing the people.

sentences.zh: 其素蘊公器有政績者，偶緣公坐，則黜司冗務，真偽莫辨，僥幸滋甚。

translations.literal: Those who truly possess public capacity and achievements, if by chance punished for public offenses, are demoted to trivial duties; true and false cannot be distinguished and opportunism increases.
translations.idiomatic: Those who truly possess public capacity and achievements, if by chance punished for public offenses, are demoted to trivial duties. True and false cannot be distinguished and opportunism increases.

sentences.zh: 自今望慎選其人，勿以資格補授，有政績者加以恩禮。”

translations.literal: From now I hope people will be carefully chosen, not appointed by qualification alone; those with achievements should receive grace and honor.
translations.idiomatic: From now I hope people will be carefully chosen, not appointed by qualification alone. Those with achievements should receive grace and honor."

sentences.zh: 是年秋，契丹犯塞，命為河北轉運使。

translations.literal: That autumn when the Khitans violated the frontier he was appointed transport commissioner of Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn when the Khitans violated the frontier he was appointed transport commissioner of Hebei.

sentences.zh: 時傅潛統大軍駐定州北，莊屢條奏其無謀略，慮或失機。

translations.literal: At the time Fu Qian commanded the great army stationed north of Dingzhou; Zhuang repeatedly memorialized that he lacked strategy and feared missing opportunity.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Fu Qian commanded the great army stationed north of Dingzhou. Zhuang repeatedly memorialized that he lacked strategy and feared missing opportunity.

sentences.zh: 會王顯掌樞密，顯與潛俱起攀附，頗庇之。

translations.literal: When Wang Xian managed the Bureau of Military Affairs, Xian and Qian both rose by flattery and quite shielded him.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Xian managed the Bureau of Military Affairs, Xian and Qian both rose by flattery and quite shielded him.

sentences.zh: 莊奏至，多不報。

translations.literal: Zhuang's memorials mostly received no reply.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuang's memorials mostly received no reply.

sentences.zh: 徙知越州。

translations.literal: Transferred to prefect of Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to prefect of Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 俄傅潛得罪，莊因上言：“顯、潛皆非材，致誤邊事，請行嚴誅，以肅群議。

translations.literal: Soon Fu Qian was punished; Zhuang thereupon memorialized: "Xian and Qian are both unfit and caused error in frontier affairs; I ask strict punishment to awe public opinion."
translations.idiomatic: Soon Fu Qian was punished. Zhuang thereupon memorialized, "Xian and Qian are both unfit and caused error in frontier affairs. I ask strict punishment to awe public opinion."

sentences.zh: ”未幾，徙知宣州。

translations.literal: Before long transferred to prefect of Xuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long transferred to prefect of Xuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 會詔百辟上封直言，莊條列四事：一曰去暴征，二曰省煩刑，三曰擇吏職，四曰敦稼政。

translations.literal: When an edict ordered all officials to submit sealed frank counsel Zhuang listed four items: first remove violent taxation, second reduce troublesome punishments, third select official duties, fourth encourage agricultural government.
translations.idiomatic: When an edict ordered all officials to submit sealed frank counsel Zhuang listed four items: first remove violent taxation, second reduce troublesome punishments, third select official duties, fourth encourage agricultural government.

sentences.zh: 疏奏，詔令開陳其所宜行先後，莊對甚悉。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted an edict ordered him to set forth what should be done first and last; Zhuang answered very fully.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted an edict ordered him to set forth what should be done first and last. Zhuang answered very fully.

sentences.zh: 改司封郎中。

translations.literal: Changed to director of the Ministry of Seals.
translations.idiomatic: Changed to director of the Ministry of Seals.

sentences.zh: 景德初，命安撫兩浙，奏能吏二十人，慢官者五人，多所升黜。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jingde ordered to pacify the two Zhes; he memorialized twenty capable officials and five negligent officials; many were promoted or demoted.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jingde ordered to pacify the two Zhes. He memorialized twenty capable officials and five negligent officials. Many were promoted or demoted.

sentences.zh: 又知潞、邢二州。

translations.literal: Also served as prefect of Lu and Xing prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Also served as prefect of Lu and Xing prefectures.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符初東封，改鴻臚少卿，入判登聞鼓院。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong Xiangfu for the eastern Feng he was changed to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Banquets and entered to administer the Petition Drum Court.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dazhong Xiangfu for the eastern Feng he was changed to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Banquets and entered to administer the Petition Drum Court.

sentences.zh: 祀汾陰，遷太僕少卿，為北嶽加號冊禮副使，撰《北行記》三卷以獻。

translations.literal: For the Fen sacrifice he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Stud, deputy envoy for the Northern Peak title-bestowal ceremony, and compiled "Record of the Northern Journey" in three chapters to present.
translations.idiomatic: For the Fen sacrifice he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Stud, deputy envoy for the Northern Peak title-bestowal ceremony, and compiled "Record of the Northern Journey" in three chapters to present.

sentences.zh: 六年，出知襄州。

translations.literal: In the sixth year sent out as prefect of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year sent out as prefect of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 明年，車駕幸南京，莊以逮事太宗恩例，授太府卿，權判西京留司御史臺。

translations.literal: The next year when the imperial carriage visited Nanjing, Zhuang by grace for long service under Taizong was appointed Director of the Imperial Storehouse and acting administrator of the Western Capital Residual Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: The next year when the imperial carriage visited Nanjing, Zhuang by grace for long service under Taizong was appointed Director of the Imperial Storehouse and acting administrator of the Western Capital Residual Censorate.

sentences.zh: 天禧二年，入判刑部，以疾分司西京。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianxi he entered to administer the Ministry of Justice; on account of illness he served in the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianxi he entered to administer the Ministry of Justice. On account of illness he served in the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 郊祀，改光祿卿，求歸上都，以便醫藥。

translations.literal: For the suburban sacrifice changed to Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments; he requested return to the upper capital for medical treatment.
translations.idiomatic: For the suburban sacrifice changed to Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments. He requested return to the upper capital for medical treatment.

sentences.zh: 卒，年八十一。

translations.literal: He died, aged eighty-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died, aged eighty-one.

sentences.zh: 錄其孫慶孫，試將作監主簿。

translations.literal: His grandson Qingsun was granted trial appointment as chief clerk of the Directorate of Imperial Manufactories.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Qingsun was granted trial appointment as chief clerk of the Directorate of Imperial Manufactories.

sentences.zh: 莊有吏幹，頗無清操，慷慨敢言，太宗獎其忠讜，多所聽納。

translations.literal: Zhuang had administrative talent but quite lacked clean conduct; generous and daring in speech, Taizong rewarded his loyal candor and listened to much.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuang had administrative talent but quite lacked clean conduct. Generous and daring in speech, Taizong rewarded his loyal candor and listened to much.

sentences.zh: 好為規畫，然寡學術。

translations.literal: He loved to make plans yet lacked learning.
translations.idiomatic: He loved to make plans yet lacked learning.

sentences.zh: 嘗建議請置廣聽院西垣學士，聞者嗤之。

translations.literal: He once proposed establishing Broad Listening Court western-wall academicians; hearers scoffed.
translations.idiomatic: He once proposed establishing Broad Listening Court western-wall academicians. Hearers scoffed.

sentences.zh: 晚年退居，製棺櫝以自隨。

translations.literal: In later years retired he made a coffin and carried it with him.
translations.idiomatic: In later years retired he made a coffin and carried it with him.

sentences.zh: 喜接賓客，終日無倦。

translations.literal: He loved receiving guests and was never weary all day.
translations.idiomatic: He loved receiving guests and was never weary all day.

sentences.zh: 子奐，咸平三年進士，屯田郎中；

translations.literal: His son Huan passed the jinshi in the third year of Xianping and served as director of the Directorate of Agriculture;
translations.idiomatic: His son Huan passed the jinshi in the third year of Xianping and served as director of the Directorate of Agriculture.

sentences.zh: 稷，左班殿直、閣門祗候。

translations.literal: Ji served as Left Guard Attendant and Gate Keeper.
translations.idiomatic: Ji served as Left Guard Attendant and Gate Keeper.

sentences.zh: 牛冕，字君儀，徐州彭城人。

translations.literal: Niu Mian, courtesy name Junyi, was a man of Pengcheng in Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Niu Mian, whose courtesy name was Junyi, was a native of Pengcheng in Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 太平興國三年進士，解褐將作監丞、通判郴州，徙和州。

translations.literal: Passed the jinshi in the third year of Taiping Xingguo; upon leaving office robes director of the Directorate of Imperial Manufactories and vice prefect of Chen Prefecture; transferred to He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Passed the jinshi in the third year of Taiping Xingguo. Upon entering official service he became director of the Directorate of Imperial Manufactories and vice prefect of Chen Prefecture. Transferred to He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 加左讚善大夫，遷太常丞、知滁州，以勤政聞。

translations.literal: Promoted to Left Supporter-in-Attendance, transferred to director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and prefect of Chuzhou, known for diligent government.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to Left Supporter-in-Attendance, transferred to director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and prefect of Chuzhou, known for diligent government.

sentences.zh: 召歸，轉監察御史。

translations.literal: Recalled, transferred to investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled, transferred to investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 端拱元年，召試文章，遷左正言、直史館。

translations.literal: In the first year of Duangong summoned for literary examination; transferred to Left Rectifier and compiler of the Historiography Institute.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Duangong summoned for literary examination. Transferred to Left Rectifier and compiler of the Historiography Institute.

sentences.zh: 出知潤州，徙泉州，未至，就命為福建轉運使，加左司諫。

translations.literal: Sent out as prefect of Runzhou; transferred to Quanzhou; before arriving immediately appointed Fujian transport commissioner and promoted to Left Remonstrance Officer.
translations.idiomatic: Sent out as prefect of Runzhou. Transferred to Quanzhou. Before arriving immediately appointed Fujian transport commissioner and promoted to Left Remonstrance Officer.

sentences.zh: 建議廢邵武軍歸化金坑，土人便之。

translations.literal: Proposed abolishing Shaowu Army's Guihua gold mine; local people found it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Proposed abolishing Shaowu Army's Guihua gold mine. Local people found it convenient.

sentences.zh: 至道初，召入，進秩兵部員外郎，知潭州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhidao era recalled; promoted to vice minister of war and prefect of Tan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhidao era recalled. Promoted to vice minister of war and prefect of Tan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至郡才數日，復召拜兼侍御史知雜事。

translations.literal: Only several days at the commandery he was again summoned and appointed concurrent supervising censor with mixed duties.
translations.idiomatic: Only several days at the commandery he was again summoned and appointed concurrent supervising censor with mixed duties.

sentences.zh: 真宗在東宮，冕嘗奉使賜生辰禮幣，即位尚記其名，改工部郎中。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong was Eastern Palace Mian once served on mission bestowing birthday gifts; on acceding he still remembered his name and changed him to director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhenzong was Eastern Palace Mian once served on mission bestowing birthday gifts. On acceding he still remembered his name and changed him to director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 永熙陵復土，會闕中丞，命為儀仗使。

translations.literal: When Yongxi Mausoleum was reburied, as vice censor was lacking he was appointed master of ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: When Yongxi Mausoleum was reburied, as vice censor was lacking he was appointed master of ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 時三司各設官局，多不均濟。

translations.literal: At the time each of the Three Offices established separate bureaus, many unevenly balanced.
translations.idiomatic: At the time each of the Three Offices established separate bureaus, many unevenly balanced.

sentences.zh: 冕請合為一使，分設其貳，則事務不煩而辦，其後卒用冕議。

translations.literal: Mian requested merging into one commissioner with deputies separately established; then affairs would not be troublesome yet be handled; afterwards Mian's proposal was finally used.
translations.idiomatic: Mian requested merging into one commissioner with deputies separately established. Then affairs would not be troublesome yet be handled. Afterwards Mian's proposal was finally used.

sentences.zh: 咸平元年，選知益州，仍拜右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianping selected as prefect of Yizhou and still appointed Right Remonstrance Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianping selected as prefect of Yizhou and still appointed Right Remonstrance Councillor.

sentences.zh: 兩川自李順平後，民罹困苦，未安其業，朝廷緩於矜恤，故戍卒乘符昭壽之虐，嘯集為亂。

translations.literal: The two Chuan regions after Li Shun's pacification—the people suffered hardship and had not settled in their occupations; the court was slow in compassion; therefore garrison soldiers taking advantage of Fu Zhaoshou's cruelty gathered in riot.
translations.idiomatic: The two Chuan regions after Li Shun's pacification—the people suffered hardship and had not settled in their occupations. The court was slow in compassion. Therefore garrison soldiers taking advantage of Fu Zhaoshou's cruelty gathered in riot.

sentences.zh: 冕與轉運使張適委城奔漢州，詔遣赴闕，至京兆，劾其罪，並削籍，冕流儋州，適為連州參軍。

translations.literal: Mian and transport commissioner Zhang Shi abandoned the city and fled to Han Prefecture; an edict ordered them to court; reaching Jingzhao their crimes were impeached; both stripped of register; Mian exiled to Dan Prefecture; Shi made adjutant of Lian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mian and transport commissioner Zhang Shi abandoned the city and fled to Han Prefecture. An edict ordered them to court. Reaching Jingzhao their crimes were impeached. Both stripped of register. Mian exiled to Dan Prefecture. Shi made adjutant of Lian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 冕遇赦，移欽、英二州，歷鄂、海二州別駕、淮南節度副使。

translations.literal: Mian meeting amnesty was transferred to Qin and Ying prefectures; served successively as vice prefect of E and Hai prefectures and Huainan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Mian meeting amnesty was transferred to Qin and Ying prefectures. Served successively as vice prefect of E and Hai prefectures and Huainan military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符初，真宗語宰相曰：“冕素純善，黜棄久矣，量宜甄敘。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong Xiangfu Zhenzong told the chief councilor: "Mian was always pure and good; dismissed long ago—measure and appropriately restore him."
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dazhong Xiangfu Emperor Zhenzong told the chief councilor, "Mian was always pure and good. Dismissed long ago—measure and appropriately restore him."

sentences.zh: ”即起知漣水軍，俄復為祠部員外郎，卒，年六十四。

translations.literal: Immediately raised to prefect of Lianshui Army; soon restored as vice director of the Ministry of Rites; died aged sixty-four.
translations.idiomatic: Immediately raised to prefect of Lianshui Army. Soon restored as vice director of the Ministry of Rites. Died aged sixty-four.

sentences.zh: 子昭儉，至殿中丞。

translations.literal: His son Zhaojian rose to palace secretary.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhaojian rose to palace secretary.

sentences.zh: 張適者，太平興國五年進士。

translations.literal: Zhang Shi passed the jinshi in the fifth year of Taiping Xingguo.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shi passed the jinshi in the fifth year of Taiping Xingguo.

sentences.zh: 任藩郡，有治績，以廉敏稱。

translations.literal: Serving in frontier commanderies he had records of governance and was called incorrupt and sharp.
translations.idiomatic: Serving in frontier commanderies he had records of governance and was called incorrupt and sharp.

sentences.zh: 為水部員外郎、知鄜州。

translations.literal: Vice minister of waterways and prefect of Zhen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Vice minister of waterways and prefect of Zhen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 獲對，太宗喜其詞氣俊邁，賜緋魚。

translations.literal: Granted audience; Taizong delighted in his vigorous eloquence and granted the red fish badge.
translations.idiomatic: Granted audience. Taizong delighted in his vigorous eloquence and granted the red fish badge.

sentences.zh: 旋改京東轉運副使，加直集賢院，一日三被寵渥，時人榮之。

translations.literal: Soon changed to vice transport commissioner of the Jingdong Circuit, added compiler of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies; in one day thrice receiving imperial favor; contemporaries honored it.
translations.idiomatic: Soon changed to vice transport commissioner of the Jingdong Circuit, added compiler of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies. In one day thrice receiving imperial favor. Contemporaries honored it.

sentences.zh: 徙西川轉運使，坐貶，後起為彰信軍節度副使、知淮陽軍，卒。

translations.literal: Transferred to western Sichuan transport commissioner; punished and demoted; later raised as military commissioner of Zhangxin Army and prefect of Huaiyang Army; died.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to western Sichuan transport commissioner. Punished and demoted. Later raised as military commissioner of Zhangxin Army and prefect of Huaiyang Army. Died.

sentences.zh: 欒崇吉

translations.literal: Luan Chongji
translations.idiomatic: Luan Chongji

sentences.zh: 欒崇吉，字世昌，開封封丘人。

translations.literal: Luan Chongji, courtesy name Shichang, was a man of Fengqiu in Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Luan Chongji, whose courtesy name was Shichang, was a native of Fengqiu in Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 少為吏部令史，上書言事，調補臨淄主簿。

translations.literal: In youth he was a clerk of the Ministry of Personnel; memorializing on affairs he was transferred to chief clerk of Linzi.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was a clerk of the Ministry of Personnel. Memorializing on affairs he was transferred to chief clerk of Linzi.

sentences.zh: 會令坐贓敗，即命崇吉代之。

translations.literal: When the magistrate was punished for embezzlement Chongji was immediately ordered to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: When the magistrate was punished for embezzlement Chongji was immediately ordered to replace him.

sentences.zh: 復以書判優等，改舒州團練判官，未行，留為中書刑房堂後官，改太子右讚善大夫，出掌揚州榷務。

translations.literal: Again because document judgment was superior grade changed to regimental judge of Shuzhou; before departing retained as Central Secretariat Criminal Section rear official; changed to Right Supporter-in-Attendance; sent out to manage Yangzhou monopoly affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Again because document judgment was superior grade changed to regimental judge of Shuzhou. Before departing retained as Central Secretariat Criminal Section rear official. Changed to Right Supporter-in-Attendance. Sent out to manage Yangzhou monopoly affairs.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷殿中丞，復為堂後官兼提點五房公事。

translations.literal: Before long transferred to palace secretary; again rear official concurrently supervising the five bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Before long transferred to palace secretary. Again rear official concurrently supervising the five bureaus.

sentences.zh: 崇吉明習文法，清白勤事。

translations.literal: Chongji clearly knew written law, was clean and diligent in affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Chongji clearly knew written law and was clean and diligent in affairs.

sentences.zh: 至道初，擢度支員外郎、度支副使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhidao era promoted to vice minister of revenue and vice commissioner of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhidao era promoted to vice minister of revenue and vice commissioner of revenue.

sentences.zh: 時以堂後官著作佐郎楊文質為秘書丞、提點五房事，上召見，謂曰：“汝見擢用欒崇吉否？

translations.literal: At the time rear official and assistant secretary Yang Wenzhi was Secretariat Director supervising the five bureaus; the emperor summoned and said: "Do you see Luan Chongji promoted? You should encourage yourselves."
translations.idiomatic: At the time rear official and assistant secretary Yang Wenzhi was Secretariat Director supervising the five bureaus. The emperor summoned and said, "Do you see Luan Chongji promoted? You should encourage yourselves."

sentences.zh: 當自勖勵。

translations.literal: Encourage yourselves.
translations.idiomatic: Encourage yourselves.

sentences.zh: ”崇吉俄加祠部郎中。

translations.literal: Chongji soon added director of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Chongji soon added director of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 真宗時，累擢為江南轉運使。

translations.literal: During Zhenzong's time repeatedly promoted to Jiangnan transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: During Zhenzong's time repeatedly promoted to Jiangnan transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 代還，判刑部兼鼓司、登聞院。

translations.literal: Upon replacement returned to administer the Ministry of Justice concurrently Drum Bureau and Petition Court.
translations.idiomatic: Upon replacement returned to administer the Ministry of Justice concurrently Drum Bureau and Petition Court.

sentences.zh: 後遷司農少卿、知洪州。

translations.literal: Later transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Granaries and prefect of Hong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Later transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Granaries and prefect of Hong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 有司歲斂民財造舟，崇吉至，奏罷之。

translations.literal: Official bureaus annually collected people's wealth to build boats; when Chongji arrived he memorialized to stop it.
translations.idiomatic: Official bureaus annually collected people's wealth to build boats. When Chongji arrived he memorialized to stop it.

sentences.zh: 以疾徙濠州，遷衛尉少卿，以將作監致仕，卒。

translations.literal: On account of illness transferred to Haozhou; transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Guards; retired as director of the Directorate of Imperial Manufactories; died.
translations.idiomatic: On account of illness transferred to Haozhou. Transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Guards. Retired as director of the Directorate of Imperial Manufactories. Died.

sentences.zh: 子二人：源，虞部員外郎。

translations.literal: Two sons: Yuan, vice director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Two sons: Yuan, vice director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 沂，殿中丞。

translations.literal: Yi, palace secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Yi, palace secretary.

sentences.zh: 袁逢吉

translations.literal: Yuan Fengji
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Fengji

sentences.zh: 袁逢吉，字延之，開封鄢陵人。

translations.literal: Yuan Fengji, courtesy name Yanzhi, was a man of Yanling in Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Fengji, whose courtesy name was Yanzhi, was a native of Yanling in Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 曾祖儀，仕唐，以軍功至黃州刺史。

translations.literal: Great-grandfather Yi served Tang and by military merit rose to prefect of Huang.
translations.idiomatic: Great-grandfather Yi served Tang and by military merit rose to prefect of Huang.

sentences.zh: 祖光甫，尉氏令。

translations.literal: Grandfather Guangfu was magistrate of Weishi.
translations.idiomatic: Grandfather Guangfu was magistrate of Weishi.

sentences.zh: 父蟾，大理評事。

translations.literal: Father Chan was assessor of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Father Chan was assessor of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 逢吉四歲，能誦《爾雅》、《孝經》，七歲兼通《論語》、《尚書》。

translations.literal: At four years Fengji could recite the Erya and Classic of Filial Piety; at seven he also mastered the Analects and Book of Documents.
translations.idiomatic: At four years Fengji could recite the Erya and Classic of Filial Piety. At seven he also mastered the Analects and Book of Documents.

sentences.zh: 周太祖召見，發篇試之，賜束帛以賞其精習。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizu of Zhou summoned him; opening a chapter he tested him and bestowed silk to reward his mastery.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizu of Zhou summoned him. Opening a chapter he tested him and bestowed silk to reward his mastery.

sentences.zh: 開寶八年，擢《三傳》第，釋褐清江尉。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Kaibao he passed the Three Commentaries examination; upon leaving office robes magistrate of Qingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Kaibao he passed the Three Commentaries examination. Upon entering official service he became magistrate of Qingjiang.

sentences.zh: 知州王明薦其能，就除豐城令。

translations.literal: Prefect Wang Ming recommended his ability and he was appointed magistrate of Fengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Wang Ming recommended his ability and he was appointed magistrate of Fengcheng.

sentences.zh: 明年，又與轉運使張去華條上治狀，以《春秋》博士召。

translations.literal: The next year together with transport commissioner Zhang Quhua he listed records of governance and was summoned as doctor of the Spring and Autumn Annals.
translations.idiomatic: The next year together with transport commissioner Zhang Quhua he listed records of governance and was summoned as doctor of the Spring and Autumn Annals.

sentences.zh: 端拱初，遷國子博士、度支推官。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Duangong transferred to doctor of the Imperial Academy and revenue judicial officer.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Duangong transferred to doctor of the Imperial Academy and revenue judicial officer.

sentences.zh: 又判戶部勾院、度支、憑由理欠司。

translations.literal: Also administered the Household Audit Bureau, Revenue, and Voucher and Debt Collection Office.
translations.idiomatic: Also administered the Household Audit Bureau, Revenue, and Voucher and Debt Collection Office.

sentences.zh: 淳化中，改戶部判官。

translations.literal: During Chunhua changed to Household administrator.
translations.idiomatic: During Chunhua changed to Household administrator.

sentences.zh: 歷水部、司門員外郎。

translations.literal: Served successively as vice minister of waterways and director of the Ministry of Gateways.
translations.idiomatic: Served successively as vice minister of waterways and director of the Ministry of Gateways.

sentences.zh: 出為西京轉運使，轉水部郎中。

translations.literal: Sent out as transport commissioner of the Western Capital; transferred to director of the Ministry of Waterways.
translations.idiomatic: Sent out as transport commissioner of the Western Capital. Transferred to director of the Ministry of Waterways.

sentences.zh: 宰相呂蒙正稱其有經術，宜任學官。

translations.literal: Chief councilor Lü Mengzheng said he had classical learning and should serve as academic official.
translations.idiomatic: Chief councilor Lü Mengzheng said he had classical learning and should serve as academic official.

sentences.zh: 會蜀叛，方籍其吏資授西川轉運使。

translations.literal: When Shu rebelled his official credentials were being registered and he was appointed western Sichuan transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Shu rebelled his official credentials were being registered and he was appointed western Sichuan transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 至道初，徙荊湖北路。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhidao era transferred to the Jinghu North Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhidao era transferred to the Jinghu North Circuit.

sentences.zh: 時賊方平，夔、峽猶聚官軍，供饋出於荊楚，逢吉憚涉遠，不赴軍前計度，坐乏糧餉，罷職知夔州。

translations.literal: At the time rebels were just pacified; Kui and Xia still gathered official armies; supplies came from Jing and Chu; Fengji feared the long journey and did not go to the army front to plan; punished for lack of provisions and dismissed to prefect of Kuizhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the time rebels were just pacified. Kui and Xia still gathered official armies. Supplies came from Jing and Chu. Fengji feared the long journey and did not go to the army front to plan. Punished for lack of provisions and dismissed to prefect of Kuizhou.

sentences.zh: 會遣使川、陝采訪，因條上知州、通判有治跡者七人，逢吉與朱協、李虛己、薛顏、邵曄、查道、劉檢預焉，皆賜詔褒諭。

translations.literal: When envoys were sent to Sichuan and Shaanxi to investigate he therefore listed seven prefects and vice prefects with records of governance; Fengji with Zhu Xie, Li Xuji, Xue Yan, Shao Ye, Zha Dao, and Liu Jian were among them; all were granted edicts of praise.
translations.idiomatic: When envoys were sent to Sichuan and Shaanxi to investigate he therefore listed seven prefects and vice prefects with records of governance. Fengji with Zhu Xie, Li Xuji, Xue Yan, Shao Ye, Zha Dao, and Liu Jian were among them. All were granted edicts of praise.

sentences.zh: 歷司門、庫部二郎中。

translations.literal: Served successively as director of the Ministries of Gateways and Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Served successively as director of the Ministries of Gateways and Treasury.

sentences.zh: 咸平中，復為京東轉運使，連知福、江、陳、襄四州。

translations.literal: During Xianping again became transport commissioner of the Jingdong Circuit; successively prefect of Fu, Jiang, Chen, and Xiang prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: During Xianping again became transport commissioner of the Jingdong Circuit. Successively prefect of Fu, Jiang, Chen, and Xiang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符中，權西京留司御史臺，徙知汝州，以逮事太祖，拜鴻臚少卿。

translations.literal: During Dazhong Xiangfu acting administrator of the Western Capital Residual Censorate; transferred to prefect of Ru Prefecture; because he had served Taizu appointed Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Banquets.
translations.idiomatic: During Dazhong Xiangfu acting administrator of the Western Capital Residual Censorate. Transferred to prefect of Ru Prefecture. Because he had served Taizu appointed Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Banquets.

sentences.zh: 七年，卒，年六十九。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he died, aged sixty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he died, aged sixty-nine.

sentences.zh: 逢吉性修謹，練達時務。

translations.literal: Fengji was by nature careful and practiced, skilled in current affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Fengji was by nature careful and practiced, skilled in current affairs.

sentences.zh: 初，鄆州牧馬草地侵民田數百頃，牒訴連上，凡五遣使按視，不決。

translations.literal: Earlier Yan Prefecture pasture land encroached on people's fields for several hundred qing; petitions repeatedly submitted; five times envoys were sent to inspect without decision.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Yan Prefecture pasture land encroached on people's fields for several hundred qing. Petitions repeatedly submitted. Five times envoys were sent to inspect without decision.

sentences.zh: 逢吉受命往，則悉還所侵田，民咸德之。

translations.literal: Fengji receiving the order went and fully returned the encroached fields; the people all thanked him.
translations.idiomatic: Fengji receiving the order went and fully returned the encroached fields. The people all thanked him.

sentences.zh: 兄及甫，歷京東、峽路轉運副使，至駕部郎中。

translations.literal: Elder brother Jifu served successively as vice transport commissioner of the Jingdong and Gorges circuits and rose to director of the Transport Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Elder brother Jifu served successively as vice transport commissioner of the Jingdong and Gorges circuits and rose to director of the Transport Bureau.

sentences.zh: 逢吉子成務，至比部員外郎、京東轉運副使。

translations.literal: Fengji's son Chengwu rose to vice minister of the Ministry of Revenue and vice transport commissioner of the Jingdong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Fengji's son Chengwu rose to vice minister of the Ministry of Revenue and vice transport commissioner of the Jingdong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 從子楚材，至虞部員外郎。

translations.literal: Nephew Chucai rose to vice director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Nephew Chucai rose to vice director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 韓國華

translations.literal: Han Guohua
translations.idiomatic: Han Guohua

sentences.zh: 韓國華，字光弼，相州安陽人。

translations.literal: Han Guohua, courtesy name Guangbi, was a man of Anyang in Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Han Guohua, whose courtesy name was Guangbi, was a native of Anyang in Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 太平興國二年舉進士，解褐大理評事、通判瀘州，就遷右讚善大夫。

translations.literal: Passed the jinshi in the second year of Taiping Xingguo; upon leaving office robes assessor of the Court of Judicial Review and vice prefect of Lu Prefecture; transferred in place to Right Supporter-in-Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Passed the jinshi in the second year of Taiping Xingguo. Upon entering official service he became assessor of the Court of Judicial Review and vice prefect of Lu Prefecture. Transferred in place to Right Supporter-in-Attendance.

sentences.zh: 代還，除彰德軍節度判官。

translations.literal: Upon replacement returned; appointed military judge of Zhangde Army.
translations.idiomatic: Upon replacement returned. Appointed military judge of Zhangde Army.

sentences.zh: 遷著作佐郎、監察御史。

translations.literal: Transferred to assistant secretary of the Palace Library and investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to assistant secretary of the Palace Library and investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 雍熙中，假太常少卿使高麗。

translations.literal: During Yongxi temporarily appointed Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices as envoy to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: During Yongxi temporarily appointed Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices as envoy to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 時太宗將北征，以高麗接遼境，屢為其所侵，命齎詔諭之，且令發兵西會。

translations.literal: At the time Taizong was about to campaign north; because Goryeo bordered Liao territory and was repeatedly invaded, he was ordered to carry an edict to instruct them and also order them to send troops west to join.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Taizong was about to campaign north. Because Goryeo bordered Liao territory and was repeatedly invaded, he was ordered to carry an edict to instruct them and also order them to send troops west to join.

sentences.zh: 既至，其俗頗獷驁，恃險遷延，未即奉詔。

translations.literal: Upon arrival their customs were quite fierce and proud; relying on terrain they delayed and did not immediately obey the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Upon arrival their customs were quite fierce and proud. Relying on terrain they delayed and did not immediately obey the edict.

sentences.zh: 國華移檄，諭以朝廷威德，宜亟守臣節，否則天兵東下，無以逃責。

translations.literal: Guohua issued a proclamation explaining the court's authority and virtue; they should quickly maintain subject loyalty; otherwise when heavenly troops come east there will be no escaping blame.
translations.idiomatic: Guohua issued a proclamation explaining the court's authority and virtue. They should quickly maintain subject loyalty. Otherwise when heavenly troops come east there will be no escaping blame.

sentences.zh: 於是俯伏聽命。

translations.literal: Thereupon they bowed in submission and obeyed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon they bowed in submission and obeyed.

sentences.zh: 使還，賜緋魚。

translations.literal: Returning from mission granted the red fish badge.
translations.idiomatic: Returning from mission granted the red fish badge.

sentences.zh: 雍熙三年，改右拾遺、直史館，判鼓司、登聞院，俄充三司開拆推官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongxi changed to Right Collector of Lost Writings and compiler of the Historiography Institute; administered Drum Bureau and Petition Court; soon filled Three Offices Opening and Inspection judicial officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongxi changed to Right Collector of Lost Writings and compiler of the Historiography Institute. Administered Drum Bureau and Petition Court. Soon filled Three Offices Opening and Inspection judicial officer.

sentences.zh: 四年，判本司，遷左司諫，充鹽鐵判官。

translations.literal: In the fourth year administered this bureau; transferred to Left Remonstrance Officer; appointed salt and iron administrator.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year administered this bureau. Transferred to Left Remonstrance Officer. Appointed salt and iron administrator.

sentences.zh: 淳化二年，契丹請和，朝議疑其非實，遣國華使河朔以察之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunhua the Khitans requested peace; court discussion doubted it was genuine and sent Guohua to Hebei to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chunhua the Khitans requested peace. Court discussion doubted it was genuine and sent Guohua to Hebei to investigate.

sentences.zh: 既至，盡得其詐以聞。

translations.literal: Upon arrival he fully learned their deception and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Upon arrival he fully learned their deception and reported.

sentences.zh: 每歲後苑賞花，三館學士皆得預。

translations.literal: Each year when the rear garden viewed flowers academicians of the Three Institutes all participated.
translations.idiomatic: Each year when the rear garden viewed flowers academicians of the Three Institutes all participated.

sentences.zh: 三年春，國華與潘太初因對，自言任兩省清官兼計司職，不得侍曲宴，願兼館職，即日命並直昭文館。

translations.literal: In the third spring Guohua and Pan Taichu at audience themselves said they held clear offices of the two provinces concurrently with accounting bureau duties and could not attend the curved banquet; they wished concurrent institute posts; the same day both were ordered compilers of the Zhaowen Institute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third spring Guohua and Pan Taichu at audience themselves said they held clear offices of the two provinces concurrently with accounting bureau duties and could not attend the curved banquet. They wished concurrent institute posts. The same day both were ordered compilers of the Zhaowen Institute.

sentences.zh: 後二日，陪預苑宴。

translations.literal: Two days later they accompanied the garden banquet.
translations.idiomatic: Two days later they accompanied the garden banquet.

sentences.zh: 三司屬官兼直館，自國華等始。

translations.literal: Three Offices subordinate officials concurrently compiling at the institute began with Guohua and others.
translations.idiomatic: Three Offices subordinate officials concurrently compiling at the institute began with Guohua and others.

sentences.zh: 未幾，授刑部員外郎，歷判三司勾院，復為鹽鐵判官，又為左計判官，尋都判三勾，賜金紫，改兵部員外郎、屯田郎中、京東轉運使，徙陝西路。

translations.literal: Before long appointed vice minister of justice; served successively administering Three Offices Audit Bureau; again salt and iron administrator; also Left Accounting administrator; soon chief administrator of the three audits; granted gold and purple; changed to vice minister of war, director of the Directorate of Agriculture, transport commissioner of the Jingdong Circuit; transferred to the Shaanxi Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Before long appointed vice minister of justice. Served successively administering Three Offices Audit Bureau. Again salt and iron administrator. Also Left Accounting administrator. Soon chief administrator of the three audits. Granted gold and purple. Changed to vice minister of war, director of the Directorate of Agriculture, transport commissioner of the Jingdong Circuit. Transferred to the Shaanxi Circuit.

sentences.zh: 舊制，川、陝官奉緡，悉支鐵錢，資用多乏，國華奏增其數。

translations.literal: Formerly Sichuan and Shaanxi official salary strings were all paid in iron cash and resources were often lacking; Guohua memorialized to increase the amount.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Sichuan and Shaanxi official salary strings were all paid in iron cash and resources were often lacking. Guohua memorialized to increase the amount.

sentences.zh: 加都官郎中，入判大理寺，改職方郎中。

translations.literal: Added director of the Ministry of Justice; entered to administer the Court of Judicial Review; changed to director of the Ministry of Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Added director of the Ministry of Justice. Entered to administer the Court of Judicial Review. Changed to director of the Ministry of Appointments.

sentences.zh: 以詳定失中，命梁顥代之。

translations.literal: For detailed assessment error Liang Hao replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: For detailed assessment error Liang Hao replaced him.

sentences.zh: 知河陽、潞州，轉運使言其善綏輯，供億幹辦，詔獎之。

translations.literal: Prefect of Heyang and Lu Prefecture; transport commissioner said he was good at pacification and supply preparation; an edict commended him.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect of Heyang and Lu Prefecture. Transport commissioner said he was good at pacification and supply preparation. An edict commended him.

sentences.zh: 景德中，假秘書監使契丹，又為江南巡撫，入權開封府判官。

translations.literal: During Jingde temporarily Secretariat Director as envoy to the Khitans; also Jiangnan pacification commissioner; entered as acting Kaifeng Prefecture judge.
translations.idiomatic: During Jingde temporarily Secretariat Director as envoy to the Khitans. Also Jiangnan pacification commissioner. Entered as acting Kaifeng Prefecture judge.

sentences.zh: 真宗朝陵，魏咸信自曹州召入扈從，命國華權州事。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong visited the mausoleum Wei Xianxin was recalled from Caozhou to accompany; Guohua was ordered acting prefect.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhenzong visited the mausoleum Wei Xianxin was recalled from Caozhou to accompany. Guohua was ordered acting prefect.

sentences.zh: 俄改太常少卿、出知泉州。

translations.literal: Soon changed to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and sent out as prefect of Quan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon changed to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and sent out as prefect of Quan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符初，遷右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong Xiangfu transferred to Right Remonstrance Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dazhong Xiangfu transferred to Right Remonstrance Councillor.

sentences.zh: 四年，代還，至建州，卒於傳舍，年五十五。

translations.literal: In the fourth year upon replacement returning, reaching Jian Prefecture he died at the post station, aged fifty-five.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year upon replacement returning, reaching Jian Prefecture he died at the post station, aged fifty-five.

sentences.zh: 賜其子充出身。

translations.literal: His son Chong was granted entry into office.
translations.idiomatic: His son Chong was granted entry into office.

sentences.zh: 國華偉儀觀，性純直，有時譽。

translations.literal: Guohua had a grand appearance; pure and straight by nature; he had contemporary reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Guohua had a grand appearance, pure and straight by nature. He had contemporary reputation.

sentences.zh: 子：琚、璩、琦，並進士及第。

translations.literal: Sons: Ju, Qu, and Qi—all passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Sons: Ju, Qu, and Qi—all passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 琦相英宗、神宗，自有傳。

translations.literal: Qi served Emperors Ying and Shen and has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Qi served Emperors Ying and Shen and has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 何蒙，字叔昭，洪州人。

translations.literal: He Meng, courtesy name Shuzhao, was a man of Hong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He Meng, whose courtesy name was Shuzhao, was a native of Hong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 少精《春秋左氏傳》。

translations.literal: In youth he mastered the Zuo Tradition of the Spring and Autumn Annals.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he mastered the Zuo Tradition of the Spring and Autumn Annals.

sentences.zh: 李煜時，舉進士不第，因獻書言事，署錄事參軍。

translations.literal: During Li Yu's time he failed the jinshi examination; because he presented a book stating affairs he was appointed registrar.
translations.idiomatic: During Li Yu's time he failed the jinshi examination. Because he presented a book stating affairs he was appointed registrar.

sentences.zh: 入宋，授洺州推官。

translations.literal: Entering Song appointed judicial officer of Ming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Entering Song appointed judicial officer of Ming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 太平興國五年，調遂寧令。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Taiping Xingguo transferred to magistrate of Suining.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Taiping Xingguo transferred to magistrate of Suining.

sentences.zh: 時太宗親征契丹還，作詩以獻。

translations.literal: At the time Taizong personally campaigned against the Khitans and returned; he composed poetry to present.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Taizong personally campaigned against the Khitans and returned. He composed poetry to present.

sentences.zh: 召見賞歎，授右讚善大夫，三遷至水部員外郎、通判廬州。

translations.literal: Summoned and praised; appointed Right Supporter-in-Attendance; three promotions to vice minister of waterways and vice prefect of Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned and praised. Appointed Right Supporter-in-Attendance. Three promotions to vice minister of waterways and vice prefect of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 時郡中火燔廨舍，榷務俱盡。

translations.literal: At the time a fire burned the yamen buildings and monopoly offices were all destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: At the time a fire burned the yamen buildings and monopoly offices were all destroyed.

sentences.zh: 蒙假民器，貸鄰郡曲米為酒，既而課增倍。

translations.literal: Meng borrowed people's utensils, borrowed neighboring prefectures' fermented grain to make wine, and soon tax revenue doubled.
translations.idiomatic: Meng borrowed people's utensils, borrowed neighboring prefectures' fermented grain to make wine, and soon tax revenue doubled.

sentences.zh: 戶部使上其狀，詔賚緡錢獎之。

translations.literal: The Household commissioner reported the facts; an edict bestowed strings of cash to reward him.
translations.idiomatic: The Household commissioner reported the facts. An edict bestowed strings of cash to reward him.

sentences.zh: 稍遷司門。

translations.literal: Soon transferred to the Ministry of Gateways.
translations.idiomatic: Soon transferred to the Ministry of Gateways.

sentences.zh: 巡撫使潘慎修薦其材敏，驛召至京，因面對，訪以江、淮茶法，蒙條奏利害稱旨，賜緋魚及錢十萬。

translations.literal: Pacification commissioner Pan Shenxiu recommended his talent and sharpness; summoned by post relay to the capital; because of audience consultation on Jiang-Huai tea law Meng itemized advantages and disadvantages pleasing the intent; granted red fish badge and one hundred thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissioner Pan Shenxiu recommended his talent and sharpness. Summoned by post relay to the capital. Because of audience consultation on Jiang-Huai tea law Meng itemized advantages and disadvantages pleasing the intent. Granted red fish badge and one hundred thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 後二日復對，又上淮南酒榷便宜，特改庫部，復賜錢二十萬，因命至淮右提總其事，自是歲有羨利。

translations.literal: Two days later again at audience he also memorialized convenient measures for Huainan wine monopoly; specially changed to the Treasury Ministry; again bestowed two hundred thousand cash; therefore ordered to the Huai right to supervise the affair; from then yearly there was surplus profit.
translations.idiomatic: Two days later again at audience he also memorialized convenient measures for Huainan wine monopoly. Specially changed to the Treasury Ministry. Again bestowed two hundred thousand cash. Therefore ordered to the Huai right to supervise the affair. From then yearly there was surplus profit.

sentences.zh: 使還，知溫州，未行，留提舉在京諸司庫務。

translations.literal: Returning from mission prefect of Wen Prefecture; before departing retained to supervise capital various bureau storehouses.
translations.idiomatic: Returning from mission prefect of Wen Prefecture. Before departing retained to supervise capital various bureau storehouses.

sentences.zh: 求外任，復命知溫州。

translations.literal: Requesting external post again ordered prefect of Wen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Requesting external post again ordered prefect of Wen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 坐舉人不當，削一官。

translations.literal: Punished for improper recommendation and stripped of one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Punished for improper recommendation and stripped of one rank.

sentences.zh: 真宗即位，復前資，因上言請開淮南鹽禁。

translations.literal: When Zhenzong acceded former rank restored; thereupon memorialized requesting opening Huainan salt prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhenzong acceded former rank restored. Thereupon memorialized requesting opening Huainan salt prohibition.

sentences.zh: 時卞袞、楊允恭輩方以禁鹽為便，共排抑之，出知梧州。

translations.literal: At the time Bian Gun, Yang Yunong, and others regarded salt prohibition as convenient and jointly suppressed him; sent out as prefect of Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Bian Gun, Yang Yunong, and others regarded salt prohibition as convenient and jointly suppressed him. Sent out as prefect of Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 頃之，改水部郎中，上所著《兵機要類》十卷。

translations.literal: Soon changed to director of the Ministry of Waterways; presented his compiled "Essentials of Military Stratagems" in ten chapters.
translations.idiomatic: Soon changed to director of the Ministry of Waterways. Presented his compiled "Essentials of Military Stratagems" in ten chapters.

sentences.zh: 時審官擬知漢陽軍，及引對，改知鄂州。

translations.literal: At the time the Ministry of Review proposed prefect of Hanyang Army; at audience changed to prefect of E Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Ministry of Review proposed prefect of Hanyang Army. At audience changed to prefect of E Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符初，轉庫部。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong Xiangfu transferred to the Treasury Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dazhong Xiangfu transferred to the Treasury Ministry.

sentences.zh: 四年，加太府少卿。

translations.literal: In the fourth year promoted to Vice Minister of the Imperial Storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year promoted to Vice Minister of the Imperial Storehouse.

sentences.zh: 未幾，知太平州，又知袁州。

translations.literal: Before long prefect of Taiping Prefecture; also prefect of Yuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Before long prefect of Taiping Prefecture. Also prefect of Yuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 州民多采金，蒙建議請以代租稅。

translations.literal: Prefectural people often mined gold; Meng proposed using it in place of tax rents.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural people often mined gold. Meng proposed using it in place of tax rents.

sentences.zh: 上曰：“若此則農廢業矣。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "If so then farming would be abandoned."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "If so then farming would be abandoned."

sentences.zh: ”不許。

translations.literal: Not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Not permitted.

sentences.zh: 俄徙濠州。

translations.literal: Soon transferred to Haozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon transferred to Haozhou.

sentences.zh: 六年，上表謝事，授光祿少卿致仕，命未下，卒，年七十七。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he memorialized requesting retirement; granted Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments retired; before the order was issued he died, aged seventy-seven.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he memorialized requesting retirement. Granted Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments retired. Before the order was issued he died, aged seventy-seven.

sentences.zh: 慎知禮

translations.literal: Shen Zhili
translations.idiomatic: Shen Zhili

sentences.zh: 慎知禮，衢州信安人。

translations.literal: Shen Zhili, courtesy name unknown, was a man of Xin'an in Qu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Zhili was a native of Xin'an in Qu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父溫其，有詞學，仕錢俶，終元帥府判官。

translations.literal: Father Wenqi had literary learning; served Qian Chu and ended as marshal's office judge.
translations.idiomatic: Father Wenqi had literary learning. Served Qian Chu and ended as marshal's office judge.

sentences.zh: 知禮幼好學，年十八，獻書幹俶，署校書郎。

translations.literal: Zhili from youth loved learning; at eighteen presented a book to Chu and was appointed proofreader.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili from youth loved learning. At eighteen presented a book to Chu and was appointed proofreader.

sentences.zh: 未幾，命為掌書記。

translations.literal: Before long appointed chief secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Before long appointed chief secretary.

sentences.zh: 宋初，介俶子惟濟入覲，歸，署營田副使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Song when Chu's son Weiji entered audience and returned appointed deputy military colony commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Song when Chu's son Weiji entered audience and returned appointed deputy military colony commissioner.

sentences.zh: 太平興國三年，從俶歸朝，授鴻臚卿。

translations.literal: In the third year of Taiping Xingguo following Chu to court appointed Director of the Court of Imperial Banquets.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Taiping Xingguo following Chu to court appointed Director of the Court of Imperial Banquets.

sentences.zh: 歷知陳州、興元府。

translations.literal: Served successively as prefect of Chen Prefecture and Xingyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Served successively as prefect of Chen Prefecture and Xingyuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 知禮母年八十餘，居宛丘，懇求歸養。

translations.literal: Zhili's mother was over eighty and lived at Wanqiu; he earnestly requested return to nourish her.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili's mother was over eighty and lived at Wanqiu. He earnestly requested return to nourish her.

sentences.zh: 退處十年，縉紳稱其孝。

translations.literal: Retired ten years; officials praised his filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: Retired ten years. Officials praised his filial piety.

sentences.zh: 及母服除，表請納祿。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he memorialized requesting surrender of salary.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he memorialized requesting surrender of salary.

sentences.zh: 至道三年，以工部侍郎致仕。

translations.literal: In the third year of the Zhidao era retired as vice minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Zhidao era retired as vice minister of works.

sentences.zh: 知禮自幼至白首，歲讀《五經》，周而後止。

translations.literal: Zhili from youth to white hair annually read the Five Classics, stopping after one cycle.
